declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract: This document provides a comprehensive legal and quantitative analysis of the issue of structural overcrowding within Hungarian medical education, with particular emphasis on Semmelweis University. Utilizing administrative data regarding student admissions and withdrawals, along with international standards for cadaver-to-student ratios, it clarifies how excessive enrollment directly hampers access to essential resources and results in increased failure rates. According to legal obligations, universities are mandated to ensure conditions conducive to students completing their studies upon admission. Conversely, inflated enrollment figures are exploited as a revenue-generating measure, with high attrition rates serving as a filtering mechanism. Such practices constitute violations of Hungarian higher education legislation, EU Directive 2005/36/EC, and international accreditation standards.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文通过法律和数据分析揭露了匈牙利医学教育中的结构性过度招生问题，尤其是Semmelweis大学通过过高招生来获取收入并以高退学率作为筛选机制的违法行为

AI.motivation: 医学教育中的过度招生问题已成为一种利益驱动的收入渗透机制，这与大学保障学生完成学业的法律义务直接矛盾
AI.theoretical_framework: 高等教育法律规范、EU Directive 2005/36/EC、国际认证标准以及教育资源分配理论
AI.method: 采用行政数据分析（学生招生和退学数据）和定量标准对比（尸体与学生比例的国际标准）
AI.findings: 过高招生直接导致必要教学资源紧缺，失败率上升，高退学率被用作筛选机制，这些做法违反匈牙利高等教育法律、欧盟指令和国际认证标准
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了医学教育资源分配与法律义务的分析框架，为高等教育质量监管提供理论基础
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了证据基础来证明大学过度招生的违法性，为政策制定者和监管机构提供了可执行的改进建议

detail.title: Unveiling Natural Gas Consumption Sectoral Price Elasticities

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Italy Occasional Paper No. 941
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Italy Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper analyzes how natural gas consumption in Italy responded to supply-driven Title Transfer Facility (TTF) price shocks from 2012 to 2023. Leveraging a granular monthly dataset that captures sectoral and provincial gas consumption, and applying a panel local projections methodology, we find significant rigidity in short-run consumption, constrained by contractual and technological factors. In the medium term, gas consumption declines by 13% two years after a price doubling caused by supply disruptions. Sectoral differences are pronounced: gas-intensive industries, such as chemicals and metallurgy, exhibit lower elasticity due to limited substitutability, while electricity generation and non-gas-intensive sectors show greater responsiveness. The 2021-2022 European energy crisis amplified these effects, further increasing sectoral sensitivity to price changes. These findings highlight the importance of temporary targeted policy measures to mitigate the adverse effects of gas supply disruptions.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2012-2023年意大利天然气消费对TTF价格冲击的响应，发现短期消费粘性强，中期价格倍增导致2年内消费13%下降，行业差异显著，能源危机增强了价格敏感性。

title: The IASB Standard-Setting Literature: A Survey of Evidence and Future Research Opportunities
affiliations: Auckland University of Technology

detail.title: The IASB Standard-Setting Literature: A Survey of Evidence and Future Research Opportunities

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of International Accounting, Auditing and Taxation, Forthcoming

detail.abstract: This paper provides a systematic review of the evidence regarding the International Accounting Standards Board's (IASB) standard-setting behavior and constituent participation in its standard-setting process. This broad objective is broken down into specific research questions based on the phases of the IASB's formal standard-setting process, and the review is structured around these questions. The sample comprises 75 research studies published from 2002 through 2023. The private interest theory informs the analysis of the evidence. The findings suggest that the IASB's standard-setting practices and constituent participation behavior are aligned with this theory. The results indicate that three broad areas attracted the most scholarly attention: changes in the IASB's governance and due process, constituent participation in the IASB's standard-setting process, and constituent influence on the IASB's standard-setting. However, several areas remain relatively underexplored, including agendasetting, constituent positions on IASB proposals and their determinants, the arguments and language choices in comment letters, the IASB's internal process, the arguments and language choices in International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS), and post-implementation reviews. The evidence reviewed in this paper suggests that the IASB largely maintained its independence in standard-setting and obtained legitimacy from its constituents. Finally, the paper identifies opportunities for further enriching the literature.

AI.tldr: 本文系统回顾了2002-2023年间75项关于IASB准则制定行为和利益相关者参与的研究，基于私人利益理论分析发现IASB的实践与理论一致，研究热点集中在治理结构、参与行为和影响力三个方面，但议程设置等六个领域仍待深入探索。
AI.research_question: IASB准则制定行为及其利益相关者参与过程的证据系统回顾
AI.motivation: 系统梳理IASB准则制定过程中各利益相关方参与行为的研究现状，识别研究空白和未来方向

AI.theory_contributions: 验证私人利益理论在IASB准则制定情境下的适用性，为国际会计准则制定理论研究提供系统证据

title: Potassium-Deficient Nutrient Solution Affects the Yield, Morphology, and Tissue Mineral Elements for Hydroponic Baby Leaf Spinach (Spinacia oleracea L.)
affiliations: Graduate School of Agricultural and Life Sciences, University of Tokyo and Cornell University

detail.title: Potassium-Deficient Nutrient Solution Affects the Yield, Morphology, and Tissue Mineral Elements for Hydroponic Baby Leaf Spinach (Spinacia oleracea L.)

declarations.funderStatement: This research was funded by the Cornell University College of Agriculture and Life Sciences (CALS) Charitable Trust. Any opinions, findings, conclusions, or recommendations expressed in this publication are those of the authors and do not necessarily reflect the view of the CALS Charitable Trust.

detail.abstract: Nutrient supply in hydroponics can significantly influence the nutrition, taste, texture, color, and other characteristics of fruit and vegetable crops. Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is a global health problem that frequently restricts a patient’s consumption of high-potassium foods. CKD patients are advised to limit their consumption of many vegetables that are potassium (K)-rich. At the same time, reducing vegetable intake reduces the intake of healthy compounds such as vitamins, fibers and antioxidants, which are beneficial to CKD patients. In our study, we investigated the reduction of the K concentration in a hydroponic nutrient solution as a possible technique to decrease the K tissue concentration of baby leaf spinach, a dark green that is frequently recommended to be consumed in moderation for patients with CKD. A previously developed hydroponic fertilizer recipe that provides a platform to adjust individual nutrients was used to adjust K to 0, 10, 25, and 100% of the control K concentration. Tissue K levels were reduced by up to 91% with a consequent 61% reduction in dry weight and 76% reduction in fresh weight (yield) with respect to the control treatment. Overall, the results suggest that using a nutrient solution without K can significantly reduce K concentrations in baby spinach, although this will consequently reduce yields.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了在水培营养液中降低钾浓度来减少菠菜叶中钾含量的可行性，发现完全去除钾可使组织钾水平降低91%，但会导致产量显著下降。
AI.research_question: 如何通过调整水培营养液中的钾浓度来降低菠菜叶中的钾含量，为慢性肾病患者提供安全的蔬菜选择？
AI.motivation: 慢性肾病(CKD)患者需要限制高钾食物摄入，但减少蔬菜摄入会同时减少维生素、纤维和抗氧化剂等有益化合物的摄入，因此需要开发低钾蔬菜的生产方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于水培营养调控理论，通过精确控制营养液中钾元素的供应水平，影响植物对钾的吸收和积累。
AI.method: 使用可调节单个营养元素的水培肥料配方，设置钾浓度为对照组的0%、10%、25%和100%四个处理水平，测量菠菜叶的钾含量和产量指标。
AI.findings: 完全去除钾的处理使组织钾水平降低91%，但导致干重减少61%，鲜重(产量)减少76%。钾浓度降低与产量下降呈正相关关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实了通过水培营养液调控可以显著改变蔬菜作物的矿物质组成，为功能性蔬菜生产提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为慢性肾病患者开发低钾蔬菜提供了可行的生产技术方案，虽然产量会受到影响，但可以实现钾含量的有效控制。

title: Secure and Efficient Federated Learning for Predictive Modeling in Resource-Constrained Healthcare Systems
affiliations: Makerere University School of Public Health and University of Cape Town

detail.title: Secure and Efficient Federated Learning for Predictive Modeling in Resource-Constrained Healthcare Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for this study.

detail.abstract: Background: Predictive modeling in healthcare holds promise for improving clinical outcomes, but in many low-resource settings, data fragmentation, privacy concerns, and infrastructural limitations hinder centralized machine learning approaches. This is particularly relevant in HIV care, where accurately identifying patients at risk of viral load (VL) non-suppression is essential for timely intervention. Methods: We developed a privacy-preserving federated learning (FL) framework to predict HIV VL suppression using retrospective data from 50,000 patients and over one million visits across 30 health facilities in Uganda. The framework utilizes federated averaging for distributed training, secure multiparty aggregation, and differential privacy to ensure data confidentiality. To address cross-site heterogeneity, we integrated domain-adversarial neural networks to promote domain-invariant feature learning. A multilayer perceptron model was trained collaboratively across facilities using local data only. Results: The federated model achieved an area under the ROC curve (AUC) of 0.874, nearly matching a centralized baseline (AUC 0.881) and substantially outperforming sitespecific models (average AUC 0.758). Sensitivity (89.6%) and specificity (66.8%) demonstrate strong capability in identifying both suppressed and unsuppressed cases. Domain adaptation reduced inter-facility performance variability, and differential privacy imposed minimal accuracy degradation. Training was completed within one hour using modest hardware, which supported feasibility in low-resource settings. Conclusion: Our study demonstrates that FL can deliver robust, privacy-preserving predictive performance in HIV care without centralizing sensitive patient data. The proposed architecture is adaptable to other clinical prediction tasks and represents a practical pathway for scaling ethical AI across decentralized healthcare systems in lowand middle-income countries.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一种隐私保护的联邦学习框架，用于预测HIV病毒载量抑制情况，在乌干达30个医疗机构的5万名患者数据上验证了其有效性，在保护数据隐私的同时实现了接近集中式模型的性能。
AI.research_question: 如何在保护患者隐私的前提下，通过联邦学习框架准确预测HIV病毒载量抑制情况？
AI.motivation: 在资源匮乏地区，数据碎片化、隐私问题和基础设施限制阻碍了集中式机器学习方法在医疗预测中的应用，特别是在HIV护理中需要准确识别病毒载量非抑制风险患者。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于联邦学习理论，结合安全多方计算聚合和差分隐私技术，并整合领域对抗神经网络来处理跨站点异质性。
AI.method: 开发隐私保护联邦学习框架，使用联邦平均算法进行分布式训练，采用安全多方聚合和差分隐私确保数据机密性，整合领域对抗神经网络促进领域不变特征学习。
AI.findings: 联邦模型AUC达到0.874，接近集中式基线(0.881)，显著优于站点特定模型(平均0.758)；敏感性89.6%，特异性66.8%；领域适应减少了设施间性能变异，差分隐私仅带来最小精度损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了整合领域适应技术的隐私保护联邦学习框架，为处理医疗数据异质性和隐私保护提供了理论创新。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了适用于资源匮乏环境的实用解决方案，可在1小时内完成训练，为在中低收入国家分散医疗系统中扩展伦理AI提供了可行路径。

title: Carbon Pricing and the Affordability of Residential Heating: A Theoretical Model with Endogenous Technology Choice
affiliations: Leipzig University, University of Leipzig - Faculty of Economics and Management Science and University of Leipzig

detail.title: Carbon Pricing and the Affordability of Residential Heating: A Theoretical Model with Endogenous Technology Choice
detail.abstract: This paper analyses the impact of carbon pricing on residential heating affordability using a theoretical household model with endogenous choice of a renewable heating technology. We compare two compensation policies: a renewable heating subsidy and a lump-sum transfer. The subsidy is the most effective policy to reduce the household’s burden if the renewable heating technology is the optimal choice with carbon pricing alone. Otherwise, the relative effectiveness of the compensation policies depends on whether they shift the household’s choice towards renewable heating. Overall, our study emphasizes the need of considering technological adjustment when analyzing how carbon pricing affects heating affordability.

AI.tldr: 本文通过理论模型分析碳定价对居民供暖可负担性的影响，比较可再生能源供暖补贴和一次性转移支付两种补偿政策的有效性。研究发现补贴政策在特定条件下更有效，强调分析碳定价影响时需要考虑技术调整因素。
AI.research_question: 碳定价如何影响居民供暖可负担性？不同补偿政策（可再生能源供暖补贴 vs 一次性转移支付）的相对有效性如何？
AI.motivation: 碳定价政策可能对居民供暖负担产生重要影响，需要研究有效的补偿机制来缓解这种影响，同时促进向可再生能源供暖技术的转型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于内生选择可再生能源供暖技术的理论家庭模型，分析碳定价政策下家庭的最优技术选择行为。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建包含碳定价和补偿政策的家庭决策模型，通过比较静态分析评估不同政策组合的效果。
AI.findings: 1) 如果碳定价单独实施时可再生能源技术是最优选择，补贴政策最能减轻家庭负担；2) 否则，补偿政策的相对有效性取决于是否能促使家庭转向可再生能源供暖；3) 技术调整是分析碳定价影响的关键因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了考虑内生技术选择的家庭决策理论模型，为分析环境政策与家庭能源选择提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了设计碳定价补偿机制的具体指导：在促进可再生能源转型的背景下，定向补贴比普惠式转移支付更有效。

title: Bitcoin Price Dynamics: A Comprehensive Analysis of Macroeconomic Correlations, Halving Cycles, and Institutional Adoption Patterns
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Bitcoin Price Dynamics: A Comprehensive Analysis of Macroeconomic Correlations, Halving Cycles, and Institutional Adoption Patterns
detail.abstract: This comprehensive study examines the complex interplay between Bitcoin price movements and macroeconomic factors, with particular emphasis on M2 money supply dynamics, halving cycle effects, and institutional adoption patterns through Exchange-Traded Fund (ETF) inflows. Through extensive quantitative analysis spanning Bitcoin's inception in 2009 to August 2025, we investigate how global liquidity conditions, monetary policy shifts, regulatory developments, and mining ecosystem dynamics influence Bitcoin's valuation trajectory. Our empirical findings reveal evolving correlation patterns, with significant strengthening of relationships between global M2 money supply growth and Bitcoin price appreciation, exhibiting approximately 90day lag effects with correlation coefficients reaching 0.78 during the 2020-2023 period. The study incorporates comprehensive hashrate analysis, geographic mining distribution data, and institutional flow metrics to provide a holistic understanding of Bitcoin's transformation from a niche digital asset to a macro-sensitive financial instrument within the context of its predetermined four-year halving schedule.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过定量分析揭示了比特币价格与宏观经济因素（特别是M2货币供应量、减半周期和机构ETF流入）之间的复杂关系，发现全球M2增长与比特币价格存在约90天滞后效应，相关系数达0.78。
AI.research_question: 比特币价格变动与宏观经济因素（M2货币供应量、减半周期效应、机构ETF流入）之间存在怎样的复杂互动关系？
AI.motivation: 理解比特币从小众数字资产向宏观敏感金融工具转变的过程，以及全球流动性条件、货币政策变化、监管发展和挖矿生态系统动态如何影响比特币估值轨迹。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于货币供应理论、数字资产定价理论和机构投资行为理论，构建比特币价格与宏观经济指标的关联框架。
AI.method: 采用广泛的定量分析方法，涵盖2009年比特币诞生至2025年8月的数据，包括哈希率分析、地理挖矿分布数据和机构流量指标。
AI.findings: 全球M2货币供应增长与比特币价格升值之间存在显著强化的关系，表现出约90天的滞后效应，2020-2023年间相关系数达到0.78。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对比特币作为宏观敏感金融工具的理论认识，建立了比特币价格与宏观经济指标之间的定量关系模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者、政策制定者和金融机构提供了比特币价格预测和风险管理的实证依据，有助于理解数字资产在宏观经济环境中的行为特征。

title: A Compass for AI Management: Why Leaders Fail to Cross the Chasm, and How to make AI Prudent

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence this work. The author is affiliated with Mirai Quality Research Institute, Inc. (a single-shareholder corporation); this affiliation did not fund or shape the analysis. The author has no financial ties to EV manufacturers, charging-network operators, or AI-governance vendors mentioned in the paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is a conceptual synthesis based on publicly available sources and involves no human participants, personal data, or experiments. Therefore, institutional ethics approval and informed consent were not required.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received. The research and writing were self-funded by the author through Mirai Quality Research Institute, Inc. (single-shareholder corporation).

detail.abstract: Purpose — This paper redefines failure in crossing the chasm from early to mainstream markets as a failure of robustness, not merely of utility. It integrates the Dual-Triangle Model (commission/omission), which distorts leadership decision-making, with the Four Limits (biological, sociological, economic, and technological) that constrain ecosystem feasibility, to propose a cross-industrial meta-framework. • Design/methodology/approach — This is a conceptual integration study. Building upon the author's prior research—(1) the Dual-Triangle Model of commission and omission, (2) the dynamic transition process from omission to commission, and (3) the stratification of the Four Limits in the EV stall—this paper uses the EV market stall as a case study to elucidate the mechanism by which leadership failure leads to a "robustness failure" and connects to the Dual-Triangle Model and the Four Limits. • Findings — At the critical point of mainstream adoption, customers purchase the Whole Product (approximating robustness). When leadership's Triangle of Commission (motive, opportunity, and rationalization) and the organization's Triangle of Omission (ignorance, unthinking, and irresponsibility) mutually reinforce each other, a premature commitment occurs before robustness is satisfied. Consequently, the strategy collides with the wall of the Four Limits, leading to failure at the chasm. • Originality/value — This paper bridges diffusion theory (the chasm), governance pathology (the Dual-Triangle Model), and constraint conditions (the Four Limits) within a single hierarchical model. By doing so, it integrates technology strategy with organizational theory, offering more universal lessons on leadership failure.

AI.tldr: 本文重新定义了跨越早期市场到主流市场的失败为稳健性失败而非效用失败，整合了扭曲领导决策的双三角模型（作为/不作为）和约束生态系统可行性的四重限制，提出了一个跨行业的元框架。
AI.research_question: 领导力失败如何导致在跨越市场鸿沟时出现稳健性失败，以及双三角模型与四重限制如何相互作用导致战略失败？
AI.motivation: 重新定义市场跨越失败的本质，从单纯的效用失败转向稳健性失败，为理解领导决策失误与生态系统约束的相互作用提供理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合扩散理论（市场鸿沟）、治理病理学（双三角模型）和约束条件（四重限制）的层次模型，结合技术战略与组织理论。
AI.method: 概念整合研究，以电动汽车市场停滞为案例，基于作者先前研究的双三角模型、从疏忽到作为的动态过渡过程，以及四重限制的分层结构。
AI.findings: 在主流采纳关键点，客户购买近似稳健性的整体产品。当领导的作为三角（动机、机会、合理化）与组织的不作为三角（无知、无思、不负责任）相互强化时，会在稳健性满足前出现过早承诺，导致战略与四重限制碰撞而失败。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了连接扩散理论、治理病理学和约束条件的统一层次模型，为领导力失败研究提供了更普适的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业在跨越市场鸿沟时避免稳健性失败提供实践指导，帮助领导者识别决策偏差和生态系统约束，制定更稳健的市场进入策略。

title: Public Governance and Democracy: The Role of Brazil’s Office of the Comptroller General in the Promotion of Social Accountability
affiliations: Universidade de Brasília (UnB), University of São Paulo (USP) and Universidade de Brasília (UnB)

detail.title: Public Governance and Democracy: The Role of Brazil’s Office of the Comptroller General in the Promotion of Social Accountability

keywords: Brazil’s Office of the Comptroller General

detail.abstract: This  paper  aims  to  analyze  the  performance  of  Brazil’s  Office  Comptroller  General  (cgu)  in  the Bolsonaro Government concerning encouraging social accountability, as well as identifying the prospects for building democratic processes with civil society based on the new structure of the cgu, which has been changed since the beginning of the new Lula Government. In this sense, we also study three civil society organizations that have been working in partnership with the cgu,  such  as  the  Instituto  de  Fiscalização  e  Controle  (ifc),  the  Observatório  Social  do  Brasil (osb), and the Amigos Associados de Ribeirão Bonito (Amarribo). Furthermore, we use a qualitative methodolog y based on document analysis, literature review, and interviews with cgu bureaucrats and representatives of civil society organizations. Despite the progress, there are challenges generated by structural problems, funding difficulties, and the disarticulation of network actions, which has been aggravated by the Covid-19 pandemic and the dismantling of policies generated by the previous government. However, since 2023, cgu, with a new institu-tional structure, has been working to get closer to civil society, looking for ways and strategies to stimulate social accountability.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了巴西总审计长办公室在博索纳罗政府期间推动社会问责的表现，并探讨了卢拉政府新结构下与公民社会建立民主进程的前景。研究通过三个公民社会组织案例，发现尽管存在结构性挑战，但CGU正在努力加强与公民社会的联系。
AI.research_question: 巴西总审计长办公室在博索纳罗政府期间推动社会问责的表现如何？卢拉政府新结构下与公民社会建立民主进程的前景是什么？
AI.motivation: 研究CGU在不同政府时期的绩效变化，探讨公民社会参与在民主进程中的作用，以及新政府结构改革带来的机遇和挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会问责理论、民主治理理论、公民社会参与理论
AI.method: 定性研究方法，包括文献分析、文件分析和访谈（采访CGU官员和公民社会组织代表）
AI.findings: 博索纳罗政府期间CGU在社会问责方面面临挑战，但2023年后新制度结构开始加强与公民社会的联系；存在结构性问题和资金困难等挑战，疫情和前政府政策解体加剧了这些问题
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了社会问责和民主治理理论，提供了政府机构与公民社会互动的新视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为CGU改进社会问责机制提供实践建议，为公民社会组织与政府合作提供参考模式

title: Bring Your Own AI (BYOAI) in B-Schools: A Perspective on Institutional Readiness and Governance

detail.title: Bring Your Own AI (BYOAI) in B-Schools: A Perspective on Institutional Readiness and Governance

detail.abstract: A quiet but consequential shift is underway in Indian management education: students are independently integrating generative AI tools into their learning, often without institutional guidance or ethical framing. This paper introduces the concept of "Bring Your Own AI" (BYOAI) to describe this bottom-up trend and argues for a structured response that balances innovation with integrity. Drawing on classroom observations and early-stage field insights, the article presents two complementary frameworks-AWARE™ (a diagnostic readiness index) and EduEthics³™ (a governance scaffold anchored in ethical, equitable, and explainable principles). Together, these models offer a tiered strategy to help institutions move from reactive bans to proactive enablement. Use cases are discussed across curriculum alignment, faculty sensitization, onboarding, and placement credibility. The article concludes by urging Indian B-schools to demonstrate foresight, adopt anticipatory governance, and collaborate toward a shared standard for ethical GenAI integration in management education.

AI.tldr: 印度管理教育中出现了学生自主使用生成式AI工具的BYOAI现象，本文提出了AWARE™诊断框架和EduEthics³™治理框架，帮助院校从被动禁止转向主动引导的伦理AI整合策略。
AI.research_question: 如何有效应对印度管理教育中学生自主使用生成式AI工具（BYOAI）的现象，在促进创新的同时确保教育诚信？
AI.motivation: 印度管理教育中学生正在独立整合生成式AI工具进行学习，但缺乏机构指导和伦理框架，需要建立结构化应对策略
AI.theoretical_framework: BYOAI（自带AI）概念、主动治理理论、伦理AI框架
AI.method: 课堂观察和早期田野调查
AI.findings: 提出了AWARE™诊断准备度指数和EduEthics³™治理框架（基于伦理、公平和可解释性原则），为院校提供分层策略
AI.theory_contributions: 引入了BYOAI概念，建立了管理教育中生成式AI整合的理论框架和治理模型
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了课程调整、教师培训、学生引导和就业可信度等具体应用方案，帮助印度商学院实施前瞻性治理和伦理AI整合标准

title: Policy Requirements and Practical Constraints: The Tightrope of Private Daycare Centres in Addis Ababa
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Policy Requirements and Practical Constraints: The Tightrope of Private Daycare Centres in Addis Ababa
detail.abstract: This study examines the quality and regulatory challenges faced by private daycare centres in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, through the lens of Street-Level Bureaucracy theory. Interviews with 18 parents, three centre owners, and two managers across three socioeconomically diverse daycare centres reveal a misalignment between regulatory standards and the practical realities of childcare provision in urban, resource-constrained environments. Daycare operators exercise discretion in interpreting and adapting regulations to meet the needs of their business and parents. The regulations emphasise safety, sanitation, and spatial adequacy, yet centre owners struggle with limited space, financial constraints, and market shortages, making full compliance unattainable. Parents prioritise staff qualifications, nurturing care, and educational programs, but express concerns about overcrowding and inconsistent adherence to standards. Applying a feminist perspective to Street-Level Bureaucracy theory reveals how gendered power dynamics and the lived realities of women, as both care providers and users, influence the implementation and impact of childcare regulations. The study advocates for a flexible, tiered regulatory framework that accounts for the contextual challenges of urban childcare provision, empowering providers while safeguarding child development and parental trust. Reforms should strike a balance between feasibility and excellence, acknowledging the financial constraints, cultural differences, and infrastructure limitations affecting childcare quality in low-income countries like Ethiopia.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过街头官僚理论分析埃塞俄比亚亚的斯亚贝巴私立日托中心的质量和监管挑战，发现在资源受限的都市环境中监管标准与实际托育现实存在错位，日托经营者通过裁量权调整监管要求，研究主张建立考虑背景挑战的灵活分层监管框架。
AI.research_question: 埃塞俄比亚亚的斯亚贝巴私立日托中心面临哪些质量和监管挑战？监管标准与实际托育现实之间如何相互作用？
AI.motivation: 了解在资源受限的都市环境中，托育服务监管如何适应实际运营挑战，以及性别权力动态如何影响监管实施效果
AI.theoretical_framework: 街头官僚理论（Street-Level Bureaucracy Theory）结合女性主义视角
AI.method: 质性研究方法，对3个社会经济背景不同的日托中心的18位家长、3位中心所有者和2位管理者进行访谈
AI.findings: 监管标准强调安全、卫生和空间充足性，但中心面临空间有限、财务约束和市场短缺等挑战；家长重视员工资质、养育关怀和教育项目，但担忧过度拥挤和标准执行不一致；经营者通过裁量权调整监管要求
AI.theory_contributions: 将女性主义视角融入街头官僚理论，揭示性别权力动态和女性作为照护提供者与使用者的生活现实如何影响托育监管实施
AI.practical_contributions: 主张建立灵活的分层监管框架，平衡可行性与卓越性，考虑财务约束、文化差异和基础设施限制，在保障儿童发展和家长信任的同时赋权服务提供者

title: Presidential Tariffs
affiliations: University of Florida Levin College of Law

detail.title: Presidential Tariffs
detail.abstract:
The Constitution of the United States grants the power to lay and collect tariffs exclusively to Congress. Yet for almost a century, the President has gradually asserted control over the most significant aspects of the U.S. tariff policy.  This crescendo of presidential tariff power culminated in the imposition of worldwide “reciprocal” tariffs under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (“IEEPA”) by the second Trump Administration.  Legal actions challenging the President’s authority to impose such tariffs are currently pending before federal courts, with appeals widely expected to reach the U.S. Supreme Court.

This Article analyzes the proper contour of the presidential tariff power from the lenses of both statutory interpretation and constitutional separation of powers.  After situating the current tariff events in a historical context, the Article traces three major discretionary authorities over tariffs that Congress has delegated to the President: the trade agreements authority, the national security authority, and the international emergency authority.  This Article argues that these three discretionary authorities need to be analyzed holistically, across statutory schemes when dissecting whether Congress has delegated a tariff authority under the IEEPA and whether such delegation violates the nondelegation doctrine.

Utilizing this cross-statutory interpretative approach, this Article argues that when imposing the worldwide reciprocal tariffs under the IEEPA, the President is indeed negotiating and entering into trade agreements for the purpose of opening foreign markets for U.S. products.  Since 1934, Congress has specifically and repeatedly delegated to the President an authority to proclaim modifications of tariffs without congressional approval in precisely such a context, but that authority last expired on July 1, 2021.  This Article argues that the power to regulate importation under the IEEPA, which is ambiguous, should not be interpreted to allow the President to do what Congress has disallowed the President to do under other unambiguous statutes regulating the very same presidential action, given that Congress allowed the President’s tariff proclamation authority to expire.  This interpretation of the IEEPA, based on statutory interpretation alone, would avoid difficult constitutional separation-of-powers dilemmas.

AI.tldr: 本文分析美国总统关税权力的法律边界，认为特朗普政府依据《国际紧急经济权力法》实施的全球互惠关税超越了国会授权，应通过跨法规解释方法避免违宪问题。
AI.research_question: 美国总统依据《国际紧急经济权力法》实施全球互惠关税的权力边界是什么？这种权力是否违反宪法分权原则和非授权原则？
AI.motivation: 特朗普政府使用IEEPA实施全球关税引发法律争议，案件可能上诉至最高法院，需要明确总统关税权力的法律界限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宪法分权理论、非授权原则、法定解释理论、跨法规解释方法
AI.method: 历史分析、法定解释分析、跨法规比较分析
AI.findings: 总统在IEEPA下的关税权力应受限制，不能用于国会已通过其他明确法规禁止的贸易协定谈判目的
AI.theory_contributions: 提出跨法规解释方法，为分析总统权力委托提供新的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为法院审理相关案件提供法律分析框架，有助于界定总统关税权力的合法边界

title: Corporate Disclosure and Capital Markets
affiliations: University of Missouri at Columbia, Department of Economics

detail.title: Corporate Disclosure and Capital Markets
detail.abstract:
Corporate disclosures are critical for functioning of capital markets demanding financial information. Firms provide disclosures through structured and regulated reports, including financial statements, disclosure notes, management recommendations, other compliance filings. In addition, firms voluntarily communicate their proforma financial statements and business data arising from forecasts or corporate reports prepared for investors. Lastly, there are certain disclosures demanded by financial and market intermediaries, industry experts and media.

This paper introduces questions and empirical methods that are pertinent to capital markets research in accounting (hereinafter, CMRA). In section II, the literature review is discussed. Forces giving rise to demand for disclosures in modern capital-market economy, and the institutions increasing the credibility of disclosures are addressed. In the same section, I inform about the main research topics used for studying of financial reporting and disclosures associated with capital markets. I use the disclosure framework to identify research questions within each topic. Empirical evidence and research methodology related with CMRA are reviewed in section III. Section IV discusses reflections on constraints of studying financial reporting issues and their impact on capital markets. Previous studies in CMRA documented disclosures associated with stock performance, bid-ask spreads, transactions, cost of capital, analyst coverage, executive compensation and institutional ownership (Healy, P. et al. 2001). Also, section IV evaluates the previous studies falling short due to endogeneity and measurement error problems and complicating the interpretation of research findings. This paper will aid potential researchers in identification of many open, i.e. unanswered, questions in the CMRA field. Section V summarizes the main ideas, methodology and desired results for the research. Finally, section VI lists bibliography used for the references.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了资本市场会计研究(CMRA)领域的核心问题、研究方法和现有文献，重点关注企业披露对资本市场的影响，分析了该领域的研究框架、实证方法和未解决问题。
AI.research_question: 资本市场会计研究(CMRA)领域的关键研究问题是什么？如何通过实证方法研究企业披露对资本市场的影响？
AI.motivation: 企业披露对资本市场有效运作至关重要，但现有研究存在内生性和测量误差问题，需要系统梳理研究框架和方法论来指导未来研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息披露理论、资本市场有效性理论和代理理论，构建企业披露对资本市场影响的研究框架。
AI.method: 文献综述法，系统梳理CMRA领域的实证研究方法、测量指标和研究设计。
AI.findings: 识别了企业披露与股票表现、买卖价差、交易量、资本成本、分析师覆盖、高管薪酬和机构持股等多个资本市场变量的关联性。

title: Scalable Expertise: How Standardization Drives Scale and Scope
affiliations: Yale University, Northwestern University, Princeton University and New York University (NYU) - Leonard N. Stern School of Business, Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Minneapolis

detail.title: Scalable Expertise: How Standardization Drives Scale and Scope

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We develop and test a theory of firm size and scope centered on standardization: the extent to which a firm’s products are similar. Heterogeneous firms choose the number, quality and standardization of their products. Standardizing makes expanding scope less costly, which then increases the return to standardization. Standardized firms have endogenously higher marginal returns to scale—their marginal costs rise less sharply with scale—implying greater responsiveness to demand shifts. We construct a novel measure of standardization using detailed product characteristics and show support for the theory’s main predictions. We show that new product features from standardized firms diffuse more quickly.

title: Corporate Hierarchy
affiliations: Columbia Business School and Columbia University

detail.title: Corporate Hierarchy

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We introduce a novel measure of corporate hierarchies for over 2,500 U.S. public firms. This measure is obtained from online resumes of 16 million employees and a network estimation technique that allows us to identify hierarchical layers. Equipped with this measure, we document several facts about corporate hierarchies. Firms have on average ten hierarchical layers and a pyramidal organizational structure. More hierarchical firms have a more educated workforce, higher internal promotion rates, and longer employee tenure. Their operating performance is higher, but they face higher administrative costs. They are more active acquirers and produce more patents, but not higher-quality patents. They exhibit lower stock return volatility and more stable cash flows. We also examine how companies adjust their hierarchies in response to demand and knowledge shocks. We find that biotech companies increased their number of layers following the Covid-19 pandemic, while companies flattened their hierarchies following the adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) technologies. These findings are consistent with the theoretical predictions of existing models of corporate hierarchies.

title: College Application Mistakes and the Design of Information Policies at Scale
affiliations: Arizona State University (ASU), University of Texas at Dallas - Department of Information Systems & Operations Management, Institute for Fiscal Studies and Yale University

detail.title: College Application Mistakes and the Design of Information Policies at Scale

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We examine whether large-scale information interventions can improve college application outcomes in a centralized admissions system. Using nationwide surveys from Chile, we document widespread information frictions and frequent application mistakes, such as omitting attainable preferred programs or failing to include safety options. To address these frictions, we partnered with the Ministry of Education to implement a large-scale field experiment that provided applicants with personalized information on admission probabilities and program characteristics through customized online platforms. The intervention increased the probability that previously unmatched students received an assignment by 44% and improved placement into higher-ranked programs by 20%. Building on these results, the policy was scaled nationwide, reaching all applicants. The scaled-up version, evaluated via an encouragement design, confirmed substantial gains, including higher admission rates for initially unmatched students and persistent enrollment improvements. Our findings show that low-cost, personalized information policies, when integrated into centralized admissions platforms, can substantially reduce application mistakes and improve student outcomes at scale. The results also highlight how leveraging existing market design infrastructure can enable scalable, cost-effective interventions that enhance efficiency and equity in higher education access.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

title: Monte Carlo Simulations and Sensitivity Analysis for Developing Control Strategies in Hybrid Ventilation Systems
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Aalborg University, Aalborg University, Norwegian University of Life Sciences, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Aalborg University

detail.title: Monte Carlo Simulations and Sensitivity Analysis for Developing Control Strategies in Hybrid Ventilation Systems
detail.abstract: Hybrid ventilation hold substantial potential for minimising energy use while maintaining acceptable indoor air quality and thermal comfort, yet developing effective control strategies is challenging because many variables interact and objectives conflict. Widely used heuristics (rule-based, fuzzy logic) are simple but inflexible; optimal approaches (Model Predictive Control, Reinforcement Learning) need extensive high-quality data that are rarely available in early design. This study proposes a Monte-Carlo framework that couples global and local sensitivity analysis with multi-criteria decision-making to develop hybrid ventilation control strategies from limited early-stage information. A generic Oslo office building with three room types (open-plan office, conference room, cell office) serves as the case study. Inputs such as temperature setpoints, airflow rates, night ventilation schedules, are sampled within stakeholder-defined ranges; 10 000 simulations per room map the control space. Sensitivity analysis identifies mechanical ventilation airflow as the dominant driver of energy use, indoor air quality and thermal comfort metrics across all rooms. Interactive parallel coordinates plots with real-time sensitivity feedback allow stakeholders to filter and explore solutions, visualise trade-offs and converge on a small set of high-performing strategies. Imposing a single supply air temperature for all rooms worsens the cell office weighted score by 5 to 12 %, quantifying the trade-off of a centralised air handling unit constraint. The framework delivers a structured yet flexible method, requiring only envelope data and broad setpoint ranges. It can be rerun as design evolves, providing engineers with a transparent alternative to rule-of-thumb tuning or data reliant optimal control methods.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一个蒙特卡洛框架，通过全局和局部敏感性分析结合多标准决策，从有限的早期设计信息中开发混合通风控制策略，解决了传统方法在灵活性和数据需求方面的局限性。

detail.title: Economic Diplomacy in a Multipolar World: Assessment of the Changing Patterns of Infrastructure Financing in Africa

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the research reported in this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research did not involve human participants, clinical trials, or personal data requiring institutional ethics approval. All information used in the analysis was obtained from publicly available sources, official reports, and secondary literature.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This thesis examines how multipolar competition is reshaping the political economy of infrastructure financing in Africa. It evaluates the changing roles of traditional multilateral lenders, emerging sovereign financiers, and private capital—focusing on the implications for debt sustainability, bargaining power, and state capacity. Using a mixed-methods design, the study combines a structured review of infrastructure finance instruments (concessional lending, export credits, PPPs, and blended finance) with case-led comparative analysis to assess how funding terms, governance conditions, and strategic dependencies shape outcomes. The analysis situates infrastructure diplomacy within international political economy, identifying how competing models—rules-based, state-led, and market-driven—affect project selection, regulatory quality, and long-run development incentives. The thesis proposes a framework for assessing “effective sovereignty” in financing choices, linking procurement transparency, digital inclusion, and local capability-building to resilience and growth. Findings inform policy design for African governments negotiating complex financing mixes, and provide a basis for donors and lenders seeking credible, development-aligned instruments in a multipolar era. The contribution is both conceptual—clarifying the mechanisms of economic diplomacy—and practical—outlining reform levers that raise infrastructure quality while reducing vulnerability to debt and geopolitical shocks.

title: Misinformation and Mistrust: The Equilibrium Effects of Fake Reviews on Amazon.Com
affiliations: University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) - Anderson School of Management, University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) - Anderson School of Management and Northwestern University

detail.title: Misinformation and Mistrust: The Equilibrium Effects of Fake Reviews on Amazon.Com

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Fake product reviews—and the manipulation of reputation systems by sellers more broadly—are a widespread issue for two-sided platforms. We study two primary channels through which such manipulation can affect market outcomes: (i) creating misinformation about the reviewed product, and (ii) breeding mistrust in ratings system overall. To examine these in the Amazon.com marketplace, we measure misinformation by observing products purchasing fake reviews and measure mistrust by eliciting shoppers’ beliefs about the prevalence of fake reviews on Amazon through an incentivized survey experiment. We incorporate these into a structural model of demand in which consumers form beliefs about product quality based on observed reviews and perceptions about their trustworthiness. Counterfactual policy simulations indicate that fake reviews reduce consumer welfare, shift sales from honest to dishonest sellers, and ultimately harm the platform. Welfare losses arise primarily from misinformation that leads to worse purchases. While mistrust also leads to purchasing mistakes, the consumer harms of mistrust are largely offset by increased price competition under a weakened ratings system. Finally, we identify key limitations in platforms’ incentives to police manipulation and evaluate enforcement alternatives.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了亚马逊平台上虚假产品评论对市场结果的影响，主要通过两个渠道：产品信息误导和评分系统信任破坏。研究发现虚假评论降低消费者福利，使销售从不诚实卖家转移，最终损害平台利益。信息误导是福利损失的主要原因，而信任破坏的影响被价格竞争部分抵消。
AI.research_question: 虚假产品评论如何通过信息误导和信任破坏两个渠道影响市场结果？
AI.motivation: 虚假评论和卖家对声誉系统的操纵是双边平台普遍存在的问题，需要研究其对市场结果的具体影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于消费者形成产品质量信念的结构需求模型，消费者根据观察到的评论和对评论可信度的感知来判断产品质量。
AI.method: 在亚马逊市场进行实证研究：通过观察购买虚假评论的产品来测量信息误导，通过激励性调查实验测量消费者对虚假评论普遍性的信任度，并建立结构模型进行分析。
AI.findings: 虚假评论降低消费者福利，使销售从不诚实卖家转向不诚实卖家，最终损害平台利益。福利损失主要来自信息误导导致的购买错误，信任破坏的影响被价格竞争部分抵消。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了虚假评论影响市场的双渠道理论框架（信息误导和信任破坏），并量化了各自的影响程度。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别了平台监管操纵的激励限制，评估了执法替代方案，为平台治理提供了实践指导。

title: Military Spending and War
affiliations: Northwestern University - Kellogg School of Management and Einaudi Institute for Economics and Finance (EIEF)

detail.title: Military Spending and War

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We revisit the theory of critical deterrence—the idea that military spending may reduce the risk of conflict by increasing its expected costs. To test this theory, we assemble a new cross-national dataset combining information on armed conflicts and defense spending over a 75-year period. We find that increases in military spending have no effect on short-run conflict risk—contrary to concerns that buildups may provoke escalation—but that they do lead to a small and persistent decline in conflict over the long run. Although the effect of spending on conflict is modest, its effect on the cost of war is large: higher military spending raises the scale of battlefield casualties. The effect of military spending on conflict is more pronounced for democracies, which are less likely to use force offensively, and is concentrated in internal conflicts involving nonstate actors. The deterrent power of military spending is strongest in ethnically polarized societies—precisely where the threat of civil war is most acute. Last, using dyadic data, we find that higher military spending causes a decrease in bilateral interstate conflict, and that this effect may be larger than the one we document for intrastate conflict using panel data. Taken together, our results point to a low pass-through from the cost of war to its incidence: even sharp increases in military spending yield only modest gains in deterrence.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 军事开支增加在短期内不影响冲突风险，但长期会小幅降低冲突概率。军事开支显著提高战争伤亡成本，威慑效果在民主国家和种族分裂社会更明显。
AI.research_question: 军事开支是否能够通过提高战争预期成本来有效威慑冲突？
AI.motivation: 重新审视关键威慑理论，验证军事开支对冲突风险的实质性影响

AI.method: 构建新的跨国数据集，结合75年间的武装冲突和国防开支数据，使用面板数据和双边数据分析
AI.findings: 1) 军事开支增加在短期内不影响冲突风险；2) 长期来看军事开支小幅持续降低冲突概率；3) 军事开支显著提高战场伤亡规模；4) 威慑效果在民主国家和种族分裂社会更明显；5) 双边数据显示军事开支对国际冲突的威慑效果可能强于国内冲突
AI.theory_contributions: 为关键威慑理论提供实证支持，但表明威慑效果有限，战争成本向冲突发生率传递率低

title: Model Uncertainty and Measures of Inequality of Opportunity
affiliations: Department of Law - University of Naples Federico II, University of Chicago - Stone Center for Research on Wealth Inequality and Mobility, University of Cyprus - Department of Economics and University of North Dakota - Nistler College of Business & Public Administration - Department of Economics & Finance

detail.title: Model Uncertainty and Measures of Inequality of Opportunity

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Inequality of opportunity has great normative importance. This has led to a literature on measuring the part of overall inequality that is due to circumstances outside of a person’s control. We contribute to such studies by evaluating the implications of uncertainty about circumstance variables and linear versus nonlinear transmission of circumstances on inequality of opportunity estimates. Applying linear Bayesian model averaging methods and three ensemble tree-based machine learning approaches to data from 31 European Union countries, we find that ignoring model uncertainty can lead to substantial overstatement of levels of inequality of opportunity.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，在机会不平等测量中忽略模型不确定性会导致对机会不平等水平的高估。通过应用线性贝叶斯模型平均方法和三种集成树机器学习方法对欧盟31国数据进行分析，评估了环境变量不确定性和线性/非线性传递对机会不平等估计的影响。
AI.research_question: 环境变量的不确定性和环境因素的线性与非线性传递如何影响机会不平等的估计？
AI.motivation: 机会不平等具有重要的规范意义，现有文献在测量由个人无法控制的环境因素造成的不平等时，往往忽略模型不确定性对估计结果的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机会不平等理论、贝叶斯模型平均理论、机器学习方法在社会科学中的应用
AI.method: 使用线性贝叶斯模型平均方法和三种集成树机器学习方法，分析欧盟31个国家的数据
AI.findings: 忽略模型不确定性会显著高估机会不平等的水平
AI.theory_contributions: 为机会不平等测量提供了考虑模型不确定性的新方法框架，强调了线性与非线性传递机制的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更准确的机会不平等估计方法，避免基于有偏估计制定政策

title: Robinson Meets Roy: Monopsony Power and Comparative Advantage
affiliations: University of Rochester, Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland and Pennsylvania State University

detail.title: Robinson Meets Roy: Monopsony Power and Comparative Advantage

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We provide a number of insights into the nature and consequences of monopsony power through the lens of comparative advantage, where employers’ power in wage setting stems from match-specific rents. Chief among them is that employers will apply larger wage markdowns to workers with greater comparative advantage at their firm. This leads to stronger monopsony power over more productive workers, provided the workers’ comparative advantage aligns with their absolute advantage. Using Brazilian administrative data, we confirm this prediction: monopsony disproportionately affects high-wage workers within firms and workers at high-paying firms. The model, calibrated to our estimates for Brazil, predicts that minimum wages increase both wages and formal employment for more productive workers while pushing less productive workers out of formal employment.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文通过比较优势视角研究买方垄断权力，发现雇主对具有更大比较优势的工人施加更大的工资折扣，导致对高生产率工人的更强买方垄断权力。使用巴西行政数据证实了这一预测，并发现最低工资政策对高生产率工人有利但会挤出低生产率工人。
AI.research_question: 买方垄断权力的本质和后果是什么？特别是雇主如何基于工人的比较优势来实施工资折扣？
AI.motivation: 理解买方垄断权力在不同类型工人中的分布及其对劳动力市场的影响，为政策制定提供理论依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于比较优势理论的买方垄断模型，强调匹配特定租金是雇主工资设定权力的来源。
AI.method: 理论建模结合巴西行政数据的实证分析，通过校准模型验证理论预测。
AI.findings: 雇主对具有更大比较优势的工人施加更大的工资折扣；买方垄断权力主要影响高工资工人和高薪企业的工人；最低工资政策增加高生产率工人的工资和正式就业，但挤出低生产率工人。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于比较优势的买方垄断理论框架，解释了为什么高生产率工人面临更强的买方垄断权力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为最低工资政策设计提供了重要启示，表明政策效果在不同生产率工人中存在显著差异。

title: Hopping on an Earlier Flight: Optimal Waiting with Multiple Flights
affiliations: University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management

detail.title: Hopping on an Earlier Flight: Optimal Waiting with Multiple Flights

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
When should travellers leave for the airport? This paper develops a model for optimal airport arrival timing when travellers face uncertain travel times and can potentially board earlier flights. We show that access to earlier flights creates a ``recourse option" that fundamentally changes optimal behaviour. While earlier flights always reduce the probability of missing one's scheduled departure, they may paradoxically increase expected waiting time when travellers adjust their arrival strategies. Using renewal theory, we establish that with frequent service, the expected waiting time converges to half the headway between flights—a fundamental limit that cannot be improved through better planning. We connect the problem to newsvendor theory, showing how the fixed penalty for missing flights (rather than linear costs) leads to distinct optimality conditions. Our results explain why rational travellers should occasionally miss flights and provide practical guidelines for airlines designing standby policies and for travellers making departure decisions.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个机场到达时间优化模型，考虑了旅行时间不确定性和可能搭乘更早航班的机会。研究发现更早航班虽然降低误机概率，但可能增加预期等待时间，并确立了预期等待时间收敛于航班间隔一半的理论极限。
AI.research_question: 旅行者应该在什么时间出发前往机场？当面临不确定的旅行时间和可能搭乘更早航班的机会时，如何确定最优的机场到达时间？
AI.motivation: 旅行者在前往机场时面临旅行时间不确定性和可能搭乘更早航班的机会，这种"追索选择"如何影响最优到达时间决策是一个重要的实际问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 更新理论（Renewal Theory）和新供应商理论（Newsvendor Theory），用于分析不确定条件下的最优决策问题。
AI.method: 建立数学模型分析旅行者在面临旅行时间不确定性和可能搭乘更早航班机会时的最优到达时间决策，运用理论推导和数学证明。
AI.findings: 1) 更早航班虽然降低误机概率，但可能增加预期等待时间；2) 在航班服务频繁时，预期等待时间收敛于航班间隔的一半；3) 固定误机惩罚（而非线性成本）导致独特的优化条件；4) 理性旅行者有时应该故意误机。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了考虑"追索选择"的机场到达时间优化模型；2) 建立了预期等待时间的理论极限；3) 将问题与新供应商理论联系起来，揭示了固定惩罚成本下的独特优化条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为航空公司设计候补政策提供指导；2) 为旅行者制定出发决策提供实用指南；3) 解释了为什么理性旅行者有时应该接受误机。

title: Green Intelligence Bangladesh: A Student-Led Initiative to Integrate AI and Environmental Education
affiliations: Hajera-Taju Degree College

detail.title: Green Intelligence Bangladesh: A Student-Led Initiative to Integrate AI and Environmental Education

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest in relation to this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research did not involve human participants, interviews, or the collection of sensitive data. Hence, formal ethical approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for this research. The project was independently conceptualized by the author.

detail.abstract: Bangladesh faces an urgent need to integrate environmental awareness into mainstream education, as climate change threatens both rural and urban communities. This paper introduces Green Intelligence Bangladesh (GIB), a conceptual student-led initiative designed to merge artificial intelligence (AI) with environmental education for school students. The project aimed to use AI-driven learning tools, gamified modules, and community workshops to raise awareness of sustainability among young learners. Although GIB could not progress beyond the pilot stage due to resource limitations, the initiative reflects the potential of youth-led innovation in addressing the climate crisis. The experience of conceptualizing GIB provided valuable lessons that later influenced other projects, including EcoSnap and the Balcony Garden Oxygen Simulation. This paper highlights the vision, objectives, challenges, and future possibilities of GIB, while underscoring the role of students in driving sustainability-focused innovation.

title: General Laws and the Emergence of Durable Political Parties: The Case of Pennsylvania
affiliations: National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER), Yale University and University of Maryland - Department of Economics

detail.title: General Laws and the Emergence of Durable Political Parties: The Case of Pennsylvania

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
In previous work we have highlighted the importance of revisions to state constitutions that mandated that laws be general and uniform throughout the state. Indiana (in 1851) was the first state to adopt a general-law mandate, but most other states followed suit by the end of the century—most of them in the 1870s. This paper focuses on Pennsylvania, one of the states that made the change in the 1870s. We show that the movement to revise the state constitution was led by Republican party bosses seeking to suppress factional strife they thought was threatening their party’s dominance and perhaps even its existence. Their effort succeeded. We argue that it was the shift to general laws in Pennsylvania and other states that led to the emergence of a party system in the United States dominated by two durable political organizations.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究宾夕法尼亚州在1870年代通过州宪法修正案要求法律必须普遍适用的政治动机和影响，发现这是共和党领导人为了压制党内派系斗争而推动的，最终导致美国两党制的形成。

AI.findings: 宾夕法尼亚州的宪法改革由共和党领导人推动，目的是压制威胁其统治地位的党内派系斗争；这种向普遍适用法律的转变促进了美国两党制体系的形成。

title: Practical Finance: An Approximate Solution to Lifecycle Portfolio Choice
affiliations: Yale School of Management, Yale University and Yale University

detail.title: Practical Finance: An Approximate Solution to Lifecycle Portfolio Choice

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Research on normative household financial choices almost always gives quantitative guidance in one of two forms: a simple formula for an unrealistic setting, or numerical solutions for only a few parameter sets in a realistic setting. We propose a middle-ground approach we call practical finance: analytic approximations to optimal solutions as a function of relevant parameters in realistic settings that are easily computed in a spreadsheet. We provide such an approximation for lifecycle portfolio choice with labor income. Across 5,103 parameter sets, our approximation results in welfare that is on average only 0.06% lower than that of the optimal solution.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个名为"实用金融"的中间方法，通过解析近似为现实环境中的生命周期投资组合选择提供易于计算的解决方案，在5103个参数集中平均福利损失仅为0.06%

title: Religion in Emerging and Developing Regions
affiliations: University of California, San Diego (UCSD), Boston University and University of Chicago

detail.title: Religion in Emerging and Developing Regions

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This paper examines the evolving relationship between religion and economic development in emerging and developing countries (EDCs). Building on large-scale survey data and recent scholarship, we document persistent and, in many regions, increasing levels of religiosity. First, we present global trends in religious beliefs and practices, highlighting a religious divergence between EDCs and high-income countries, as well as the continued prevalence of traditional belief systems alongside major world religions. Second, we analyze the determinants and consequences of religious behavior, showing how income volatility, financial insecurity, and cultural transitions sustain demand for religion. Third, we explore the institutional and political dimensions of religion in EDCs, emphasizing the role of religious institutions as public goods providers and as politically influential actors. This discussion offers a framework for understanding religious organizations as adaptive, competing platforms in pluralistic religious marketplaces. Overall, our findings suggest that religious adaptation, rather than decline, is central to understanding the future of religion and its economic implications in the developing world.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨新兴和发展中国家宗教与经济发展的演变关系，发现宗教适应而非衰退是理解宗教未来及其经济影响的关键

title: How Much Tax Do US Billionaires Pay? Evidence from Administrative Data

detail.title: How Much Tax Do US Billionaires Pay? Evidence from Administrative Data

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We estimate income and taxes for the wealthiest group of US households by matching Forbes 400 data to the individual, business, estate, and gift tax returns of the corresponding group in 2010–2020. In our benchmark estimate, the total effective tax rate—all taxes paid relative to economic income—of the top 0.0002% (approximately the “top 400”) averaged 24% in 2018–2020 compared with 30% for the full population and 45% for top labor income earners. This lower total effective tax rate on the wealthiest is substantially driven by low taxable individual income relative to economic income. First, the C-corporations owned by the wealthiest distributed relatively little in dividends, limiting their individual income tax unless they sell their stocks. Second, top-owned passthrough businesses reported negative taxable income on average in spite of positive book income, further limiting their individual income tax. The top-400 effective tax rate fell from 30% in 2010–2017 to 24% in 2018–2020, explained both by a smaller share of business income being taxed and by that income being subject to lower tax rates. Estate and gift taxes contributed relatively little to their effective tax rate. Top-400 decedents paid 0.8% of their wealth in estate tax when married and 7% when single. Annual charitable contributions equalled 0.6% of wealth and 11% of economic income in 2018–20.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文通过将福布斯400富豪与税放数据匹配，发现美国最富有家庭的总有效税率仅为24%，远低于普通家庭的30%和高薪资收入者的45%，主要原因是财富增长主要来自于未实现的资本利得和企业丟亏报告。
AI.research_question: 美国最富有家庭（约前400名）的实际有效税率是多少？与普通家庭和高薪资收入者相比有何差异？何种因素导致这些差异？
AI.motivation: 传统的收入税收数据往往无法准确反映最富有家庭的真实税负情况，因为这些家庭的财富增长主要来自于资本利得和企业收益，而非薪资收入。有必要通过结合福布斯400排名和税放数据来更准确地估算这些超富人群的实际税负水平。

AI.method: 将2010-2020年度Forbes 400富豪名单与对应的个人所得税、企业税、遗产税和赠与税申报进行匹配，计算经济收入与所缴纳各种税费的比例来得出有效税率。
AI.findings: 1）最富有0.0002%家庭的平均有效税率为24%（2018-2020），较全体人口的30%和高薪资收入者的45%明显低争2）主要原因是资本利得实现税较少和企业报告丟亏3）2018-2020年间有效税率从之前的30%下降到24%4）遗产税和赠与税的负担较少5）年度恨善捐派占财富的0.6%和经济收入的11%
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一种更全面认识超富人群实际税负的方法论框架，证明了传统所得税统计在超富人群方面的差异，为财富不平等和税收改革提供了重要的理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于超富人群真实税负情况的精准数据，有助于评估现行税制的公平性问题，为财富税、资本利得税等政策改革提供了实证基础。

publicationDetails.detailsText: In Krasniqi, A, and Lory, A. (Eds) Reconsidering 'Transition': Albania 1999-2020 and the Promise of Democracy. Tirana: Konrad Adenauer Stiftung, pp.  pp. 195-210

detail.abstract: Albania formally fits all the boxes to be a best example of the transformative power of European integration. The country is subject of an elaborate and increasingly specific EU conditionality targeting key areas of reform, since at least since 2000s when the EU extended its policy of enlargement and related rewards to all Balkan countries. All the rewards that the EU can offer –membership, targeted assistance and intermediate rewards in between - are on the table. Furthermore, a set of innovations on enlargement tools, the recent one being the new methodology announced in February 2020, have further improved both the credibility and the consistency of EU promises. Specifically, they have honed the EU’s monitoring mechanisms and better connected the results with the associated rewards. Last but not least, European Integration is the major stated goal of all political groups and commands wide consensus across the spectrum of Albanian society and politics. Yet, the theoretical expectations on the transformative power of conditionality don’t match the reality on the ground.  BTI’s biannual assessments confirm that throughout the application of EU conditionality, various scores of RoL have remained rather stagnant.

title: Selection Bias and Racial Disparities in Police Use of Force
affiliations: University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) - Department of Economics, Dartmouth College and University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) - Luskin School of Public Affairs

detail.title: Selection Bias and Racial Disparities in Police Use of Force

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We study racial disparities in police use of force. A pervasive issue in studies of policing is that the available data are selected by the police. As a result, disparities computed in the observed sample may be biased if selection into the data differs by race. We develop a framework and econometric strategy for correcting this bias, using variation across officers in enforcement intensity to identify the racial composition of the unobserved population at risk of selection. Using detailed administrative data on arrests and force incidents from Chicago and Seattle, we find that Black civilians comprise 56 percent of arrestees but about 49 percent of potential arrestees. Correcting for sample selection doubles our measure of the racial disparity in force rates. Decompositions of the corrected force disparity reveal that about 70 percent is unexplained by other demographic and incident characteristics, suggesting an important role for officer discrimination. Our selection bias estimates meaningfully impact the conclusions drawn in the existing literature.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

title: Aggregate Efficiency with Heterogeneous Agents
affiliations: University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) and University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) - Department of Economics

detail.title: Aggregate Efficiency with Heterogeneous Agents

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We study aggregate efficiency when households have heterogeneous preferences and outcomes. We generalize the consumption-equivalent variation of Lucas (1987) to a multi-agent setting, asking: how much can the consumption-possibility set shrink while keeping every agent at least as well off as in their status-quo allocation? The resulting scalar — resources left over after compensating everyone — is our measure of aggregate efficiency. Efficiency rises whenever the same status-quo welfare can be achieved with fewer resources. We show how to convert this problem into an equivalent utility-maximization problem, enabling the use of tools and results normally applicable only in representative agent settings. We characterize changes in aggregate efficiency in terms of observables, like expenditures and price elasticities, and apply our results to study, among other things, the effects of productivity shocks, the costs of misallocation, and the gains from trade, both with and without costly redistribution.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个多智能体环境下的聚合效率衡量方法，将Lucas(1987)的消费等价变异推广到异质性偏好家庭情境，通过计算在保持所有个体福利不变的前提下可缩减的资源量来评估效率。

title: Reserves, Sanctions and Tariffs in a Time of Uncertainty
affiliations: University of Wisconsin, Madison - Robert M. La Follette School of Public Affairs and Department of Economics, Harvard University - Harvard Kennedy School (HKS) and Portland State University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Reserves, Sanctions and Tariffs in a Time of Uncertainty

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We analyze the determinants of individual central bank holdings of international reserves, as shares of gold, dollar, euro, pound, yen and yuan, over the 1999-2022 period. We augment standard economic determinants of size, exchange rate volatility, currency pegs and bilateral trade with bilateral political/economic variables such as disagreement in UN voting, military alliances, and financial and trade sanctions. These variables augment uncertainty measures such as global Economic Policy Uncertainty, US monetary and trade policy uncertainty, and the VIX. In addition, we investigate whether the US imposition of tariffs in 2018 had any measurable impact on dollar and other holdings. We conclude that financial sanctions and trade policy uncertainty have a statistically and economically significant effect on holdings of the US dollar. US tariffs had an economically – but not statistically – significant impact on shares of foreign exchange reserves: dollar shares fell by 2.1% and other shares rose by 0.8%. These findings can inform the debate regarding some of the benefits and costs of using such geo-economic policies.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

title: Outsourcing, Labor Market Frictions, and Employment
affiliations: Yale University and The University of Hong Kong - Faculty of Business and Economics

detail.title: Outsourcing, Labor Market Frictions, and Employment

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We estimate the labor market impacts of Brazil’s 1993 outsourcing legalization using North-South variation in pre-legalization court permissiveness, and comparing security guards to less-affected occupations. We find that outsourcing legalization persistently reallocated jobs from older incumbent guards to younger entrants. Total employment of guards and their entry from informality persistently increased, while average demographic-adjusted wages remained constant. Meanwhile, a wave of occupational layoffs displaced some incumbent guards from high-wage firms. The evidence suggests that the rise of non-core activity outsourcing reduced labor market frictions, facilitated by firm-level economies of scale in human resources and spillovers to non-adopting firms.

title: How Retrainable are AI-Exposed Workers?
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of New York, New York University (NYU) - New York University, Harvard University and Duke University

detail.title: How Retrainable are AI-Exposed Workers?

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We document the extent to which workers in AI-exposed occupations can successfully retrain for AI-intensive work. We assemble a new workforce development dataset spanning over 1.6 million job training participation spells from all US Workforce Investment and Opportunity Act programs from 2012–2023 linked with occupational measures of AI exposure. Using earnings records observed before and after training, we compare high AI exposure trainees to a matched sample of similar workers who only received job search assistance. We find that AI-exposed workers have high earnings returns from training that are only 25% lower than the returns for low AI exposure workers. However, training participants who target AI-intensive occupations face a penalty for doing so, with 29% lower returns than AI-exposed workers pursuing more general training. We estimate that between 25% to 40% of occupations are “AI retrainable” as measured by its workers receiving higher pay for moving to more AI-intensive occupations—a large magnitude given the relatively low-income sample of displaced workers. Positive earnings returns in all groups are driven by the most recent years when labor markets were tightest, suggesting training programs may have stronger signal value when firms reach deeper into the skill market.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
