title: Streaking to Success? The Effects of Highlighting Streaks on Student Effort and Learning
affiliations: Bocconi University, Inter-American Development Bank, Group for the Analysis of Development (GRADE) and Northwestern University

detail.title: Streaking to Success? The Effects of Highlighting Streaks on Student Effort and Learning

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We examine whether highlighting streaks—instances of repeated and consecutive behavior when completing learning tasks—encourages 4th to 6th grade students in Peru to increase their use of an online math platform and improve learning. 60,000 students were randomly assigned to receive messages that (i) highlighted streaks, (ii) provided personalized reminders with positive reinforcement, (iii) provided generic reminders, or (iv) to a control group. Highlighting streaks and providing personalized reminders significantly increased platform use compared to generic reminders and the control group, with streaks more effective on the intensive margin and personalized reminders more effective on the extensive margin. Highlighting streaks also significantly improved math achievement compared to the control group among the 1,500 students who took an endline test, although differences with other treatment arms were not significant.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 通过在线数学平台强调连续完成任务的戳记行为，能够有效提升密鲁4-6年级学生的平台使用率和数学成绩。连续戳记消息在寂中强度方面更有效，而个性化提醒在广度方面更有效。
AI.research_question: 强调连续完成学习任务的戳记行为是否能够鼓励学生增加在线数学平台的使用并提高学习效果？
AI.motivation: 引导学生持成良好的学习习惯和增强学习持久性是教育干预的重要目标，而戳记行为作为一种形式化的激励机制可能具有潜在效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为经济学和心理学的激励机制理论，重点考察戳记行为对学生学习行为的影响。
AI.method: 对60,000名密鲁4-6年级学生进行随机控制实验，分为四组：(1)接收戳记强调消息，(2)接收个性化提醒和积极强化，(3)接收通用提醒，(4)对照组。通过平台使用数据和1,500名学生的末期测试进行效果评估。
AI.findings: 强调戳记和个性化提醒都显著提高了平台使用率，其中戳记在寂中强度方面更有效，个性化提醒在广度方面更有效。强调戳记还显著提高了学生的数学成绩。
AI.theory_contributions: 为戳记行为在教育干预中的作用提供了实证支撑，丰富了行为干预理论在教育领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种简单有效的干预方法，通过强调连续学习戳记来提升学生的学习动机和成绩，对于在线教育平台的设计具有实践指导意义。

title: Emergency Lending and Moral Hazard
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Emergency Lending and Moral Hazard
detail.abstract: In recent decades, central banks have increasingly addressed potential and emerging financial crises by establishing emergency lending facilities. Although these facilities may often be justified if they interrupt negative feedback loops that result in financial and real economic losses, concomitant moral hazard issues can have destabilizing effects that increase the likelihood and severity of future crises. In this paper, we examine the moral hazard associated with the emergency response to the banking turmoil that erupted in the U.S. in March of 2023. Specifically, we estimate how banks' access to the Federal Reserve's Bank Term Funding Program (BTFP) affected their subsequent funding diversification and resilience to liquidity shocks. We find that banks with more access to the BTFP were less likely to follow policymakers' directives to expand their access to different types of funding and boost their contingency funding preparedness. To obtain causal estimates, we measure bank access to the BTFP with the confidential volume of collateral placed at the facility, and instrument for this access with the amount of BTFP-eligible collateral that banks had previously placed at the Discount Window. Our IV estimates reveal that banks with less access to the BTFP increasingly tapped private funding markets relative to other banks by issuing more time deposits, boosting brokered deposits and wholesale funding, and engaging in more reciprocal deposit arrangements. Further, although one goal of the BTFP was to help banks avoid selling (underwater) securities, we find that BTFP access led banks to draw down their securities portfolios via sales. Finally, we observe relatively less contingency funding preparedness among the banks that were more able to rely on the BTFP. These banks were less likely to boost their collateral pledged to the discount window, and less likely to perform a test of discount window borrowing in the months after SVB's failure. In sum, our results demonstrate the moral hazard consequences of emergency lending. Policymakers should consider these consequences when evaluating future emergency facilities, and our results argue in favor of bolstering standard crisis-prevention tools, including standing lender-of-last-resort backstop facilities and certain microprudential standards.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了美联储银行定期融资计划（BTFP）带来的道德风险问题，发现获得更多BTFP融资渠道的银行更不愿意遵循政策制定者的指导来多样化融资渠道和提升应急资金准备，反而更多地出售证券资产，表现出较差的应急准备能力。
AI.research_question: 银行获得美联储紧急贷款计划（BTFP）的渠道如何影响其后续的融资多样化能力和对流动性冲击的抵御能力？
AI.motivation: 尽管央行紧急贷款设施可以中断负面反馈循环，避免金融和经济损失，但伴随的道德风险问题可能会增加未来危机的可能性和严重性，需要实证研究其具体影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 道德风险理论、银行流动性管理理论、央行最后贷款人理论
AI.method: 使用工具变量法（IV），以银行之前在贴现窗口存放的合格抵押品数量作为BTFP渠道的工具变量，测量银行对BTFP的实际使用情况
AI.findings: 1）获得更多BTFP渠道的银行更不愿意多样化融资渠道；2）这些银行更多地出售证券资产；3）应急资金准备相对较差，较少增加贴现窗口抵押品和进行借款测试
AI.theory_contributions: 为央行紧急贷款计划的道德风险效应提供了实证证据，丰富了道德风险理论在央行干预情境下的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估未来紧急贷款设施提供了重要参考，支持加强标准危机预防工具，如常备最后贷款人支持设施和微观审慎标准

title: Attitude Of Nigerian Courts in the Interpretation of Taxation Statutes Vis-A-Vis Global Best Practices; Review of Selected Cases
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Attitude Of Nigerian Courts in the Interpretation of Taxation Statutes Vis-A-Vis Global Best Practices; Review of Selected Cases
detail.abstract: The controversy surrounding the interpretation of taxing statutes arises from the approaches taken by the Nigerian courts. This research, investigates the judicial attitude towards the interpretation of taxing statutes, addressing the complexities inherent in tax laws and the potential conflicts between taxpayers and the government emphasizing the complexity of English-drafted statutes and the crucial need for interpretative canons to bridge literal text and legislative purpose. The interpretation of taxation statutes in Nigeria holds significance for its impact on revenue generation, economic growth, and the overall-business environment. This research aims to examine the Nigerian Courts' approaches to interpreting taxing statutes, identify factors influencing judgement, and deciphering legislative intent. The research adopts a doctrinal methodology, conducting an in-depth analysis of legal texts, landmark decided cases, and scholarly writings related to statutory interpretation in tax matters. The findings reveal a distinct and cautious judicial approach that prioritizes strict construction, primarily due to the expropriatory nature of tax statutes and their direct impact on individual property rights. Despite recent shifts towards a more flexible interpretation, a practical and stringent approach remains favored to balance legislative intent. Based on these findings, the study recommends a balanced approach to statutory interpretation, emphasizing the need for more clarity in legislation to reduce ambiguity. It advocates for harmonization and international alignment of interpretative principles, highlighting the importance of technological integration to enhance efficiency in legal processes. Furthermore, the research suggests periodic review and amendment of tax statutes to adapt to evolving economic realities and ensure a coherent and equitable taxation framework in-line with the global best practices.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨尼日利亚法院对税收法规解释的司法态度，发现法院倾向于严格解释以平衡立法意图与纳税人权利，建议采用平衡解释方法并加强立法清晰度。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚法院如何解释税收法规？影响判决的因素有哪些？如何解读立法意图？
AI.motivation: 税收法规解释的争议源于尼日利亚法院的不同解释方法，涉及税收法律的复杂性、纳税人与政府之间的潜在冲突，以及英文起草法规的复杂性需要解释准则来弥合字面文本与立法目的之间的差距。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于法定解释理论，特别是严格解释原则和灵活解释方法的对比，关注税收法规的征收性质及其对个人财产权的直接影响。
AI.method: 采用教义学方法论，深入分析法律文本、具有里程碑意义的判例以及有关税收事项法定解释的学术著作。
AI.findings: 研究发现尼日利亚法院采取谨慎的司法态度，优先考虑严格解释，这主要是由于税收法规的征收性质及其对个人财产权的直接影响。尽管最近出现向更灵活解释的转变，但实际和严格的解释方法仍然受到青睐以平衡立法意图。
AI.theory_contributions: 为税收法规解释理论提供了尼日利亚的实证证据，丰富了严格解释原则在征收性法律中的应用研究，促进了法定解释理论在税收领域的发展。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议采用平衡的法定解释方法，强调需要提高立法清晰度以减少模糊性；倡导解释原则的协调和国际统一；强调技术整合以提高法律流程效率；建议定期审查和修订税收法规以适应不断变化的经济现实。

title: Freedom-Types and Life Satisfaction: Empirical Evidence on the Role of Individual and Civic-Oriented Values
affiliations: University of Rome Tor Vergata - Faculty of Economics, University of Rome Tor Vergata - Faculty of Economics and NEXT Group

detail.title: Freedom-Types and Life Satisfaction: Empirical Evidence on the Role of Individual and Civic-Oriented Values

declarations.ethicsApproval: Our study uses survey data from a sample of more than 5000 individuals. Those who answered the survey gave consent to use information. Individual information is used only for econometric analysis and there is no possibility to associate data to individual identities of participants

detail.abstract: This paper examines the relationship between four freedom orientations-libertarian, utilitarian, civic-oriented, and communitarian-and subjective well-being. We conceptualize liberty orientations as varying in their prioritization of individual autonomy relative to the general interest referring to political philosophers. Using nationally representative survey data, we estimate a recursive generalized structural equation model (GSEM) with instrumental variables to address potential endogeneity between liberty orientations and well-being. Falsification tests confirm the validity of our instruments. The results indicate that civic oriented and communitarian orientations are positively and significantly associated with higher levels of life satisfaction compared to libertarian and utilitarian orientations. These findings suggest that value systems emphasizing voluntary alignment with, or prioritization of, the general interest foster higher well-being, consistent with research strands highlighting the importance of social relationships, generativity, and collective purpose discussed in our paper. Our contribution is both theoretical, by refining the typology of liberty orientations, and empirical, by providing causal evidence of their effects on subjective well-being.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实证研究发现，强调集体利益的价值取向（公民导向和社群主义）比个人主义取向（自由主义和功利主义）更能提升主观幸福感，为自由取向与幸福的关系提供了因果证据。
AI.research_question: 不同自由取向（自由主义、功利主义、公民导向、社群主义）如何影响主观幸福感？
AI.motivation: 探讨价值体系中个体自主性与集体利益优先性的平衡如何影响个人福祉，填补自由取向与幸福感关系的实证研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于政治哲学理论构建自由取向分类框架：自由主义（强调个人自主）、功利主义（效用最大化）、公民导向（自愿集体参与）、社群主义（集体利益优先）。
AI.method: 使用全国代表性调查数据，采用递归广义结构方程模型（GSEM）和工具变量法处理内生性问题，并进行证伪检验验证工具有效性。
AI.findings: 公民导向和社群主义取向与生活满意度显著正相关，而自由主义和功利主义取向的幸福感较低。强调集体利益的价值体系更能促进幸福感。
AI.theory_contributions: 完善了自由取向的类型学理论框架，将政治哲学概念操作化为可测量的价值取向维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和个人提供了实证依据，表明促进集体价值和社会联系的价值体系有助于提升社会整体幸福感。

title: Agricultural Schemes Implementation in the State of Telangana: Stakeholders Satisfaction
affiliations: Osmania University (OU)

detail.title: Agricultural Schemes Implementation in the State of Telangana: Stakeholders Satisfaction
detail.abstract: The development and implementation of farmers schemes helps in any state economic growth and living standards of the public in general and farmers in particular. The study analyzed the agriculture and its impacts on livelihoods and incomes, household members residing in rural areas of in the selected sample districts of Nalgonda and Mahabubnagar in the state of Telangana. Farmers development has been considered as an important input for increasing agricultural production and the socioeconomic development of the farmers in respect of livelihoods and incomes. In order to increase the maximum implementation of agricultural schemes helps in utilization of water resources to the maximum advantage for crop production and resulting the overall socioeconomic development of the farming community. The success of agriculture needs management of in the selected sample districts of Nalgonda and Mahabubnagar in the state of Telangana to reach the economic growth and development of rural youth and women by cultivating remunerative crops and conducting dairying activities to improve the income generation among the farmers.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文分析了印度特拉广纳部州Nalgonda和Mahabubnagar区农业发展计划对农民生计和收入的影响，重点关注水资源利用、收益作物种植和奶业活动对农民收入增长的作用
AI.research_question: 农业发展计划如何影响特拉广纳部巎农村地区农民的生计水平和收入增长
AI.motivation: 农业发展计划对子经济增长和农民生活水平提升具有重要作用，需要研究其具体影响机制和效果
AI.theoretical_framework: 农业发展理论、农村经济学、生计政策分析框架
AI.method: 定性研究方法，选择特拉广纳部巎Nalgonda和Mahabubnagar区作为样本地区进行案例分析
AI.findings: 农业发展计划通过最大化水资源利用、种植收益作物和发展奶业活动，有效提高了农民收入水平和生计能力
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了发展中国家农业政策实施效果的理论研究，提供了农村经济发展的实证分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为特拉广纳部巎和相似地区的农业政策制定提供实践指南，推动农民收入增长和农村经济发展

title: Agriculture Development Schemes and Socio-Economic Development of Farmers
affiliations: Osmania University (OU)

keywords: Agricultural Infrastructure and Farmer Service Facilities

detail.abstract: In the current scenario the Indian Agriculture has focused on the transformation process to enhancing agricultural production and sustainability economy development through improving the agricultural infrastructure and farmer service facilities. No doubt the Indian Agriculture has achieved tremendous growth in respect of farmer development and focusing towards enhancing farm productivity not only in India bust also in the newly formed state of Telangana. The research study covers the implementation of Agricultural schemes in the selected sample districts of Nalgonda and Mahabubnagar in the state of Telangana. The study helps in improving and encouraging farm development by implementation of irrigation schemes to accelerating the development with increased focus on innovative farming methods and financing the agriculture sector in the state of Telangana.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文研究印度特别是特拉安那州的农业发展，通过分析Nalgonda和Mahabubnagar地区的农业计划实施情况，探讨如何通过水利演进、农业资金支持和创新农业技术来提高农业生产力和可持续发展。
AI.research_question: 如何通过农业计划的有效实施来提高特拉安那州的农业生产力和可持续发展？
AI.motivation: 印度农业正在进行转型过程，需要通过改善农业基础设施和农民服务来提高农业生产和可持续发展，特别是在新建的特拉安那州。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于农业发展理论和可持续发展理论，重点关注农业基础设施、水利工程、农业资金和创新农业技术对农业生产力的影响。
AI.method: 采用定性研究方法，选取特拉安那州的Nalgonda和Mahabubnagar地区作为样本，分析该地区农业计划的实施情况。
AI.findings: 研究发现通过水利计划的实施、农业资金支持和创新农业技术的应用，能够有效提高农业生产力，促进农业发展和可持续性。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了农业发展理论，特别是在发展中国家农业转型和可持续发展方面的研究，提供了具体地区的实证分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为特拉安那州和其他相似地区的农业政策制定者提供了实践建议，如何通过水利建设、资金支持和技术创新来推动农业发展。

title: Similar Trade Dress in Pharmaceuticals: Legal Justifications Under Trademark and Fair Competition Principles
affiliations: O. P. Jindal Global University, Jindal Global Law School (JGLS)

detail.title: Similar Trade Dress in Pharmaceuticals: Legal Justifications Under Trademark and Fair Competition Principles

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: Privately funded by the author

detail.abstract: This article critically discusses the boundaries of trade dress protection under law in the pharmaceutical sector and the extent to which trademark law alone can govern visual similarity between branded and generic drugs and over-the-counter (OTC) products. Similar trade dress such as pill colour, shape, and packaging used by generic or OTC companies poses doctrinal challenges regarding distinctiveness, non-functionality, and likelihood of consumer confusion. Although such convergence is often analysed through competition law, this paper shifts the focus by asserting that trademark law, if properly interpreted, has adequate doctrinal tools to address the complexities of pharmaceutical and OTC trade dress. Through a comparative study of Indian and U.S. jurisprudence, the paper examines how courts have interpreted trade dress protections in light of public health necessities like medication compliance and therapeutic recognition. Using interdisciplinary research from behavioural science and public health, the study calls for a doctrinal realignment in trademark law, one capable of distinguishing deceptive consumer confusion from patient-oriented therapeutic familiarity. The analysis culminates in a proposed three-factor model to guide judicial interpretation and legislative reform.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨药品行业商业外观保护的法律边界，分析商标法如何应对仿制药和OTC产品与品牌药之间的视觉相似性问题，提出通过商标法而非竞争法来解决这一复杂问题。
AI.research_question: 商标法是否具备足够的理论工具来规范品牌药与仿制药/OTC产品之间的商业外观相似性问题？
AI.motivation: 仿制药和OTC公司使用相似的药片颜色、形状和包装等商业外观，在显著性、非功能性和消费者混淆可能性方面提出了理论挑战，需要重新审视商标法在此领域的适用性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 商标法理论（显著性、非功能性、混淆可能性）、公共健康理论（药物依从性、治疗识别）、行为科学理论
AI.method: 比较研究方法（印度和美国判例法分析）、跨学科研究（行为科学和公共健康领域的整合）
AI.findings: 商标法如果得到正确解释，具备足够的理论工具来处理药品和OTC商业外观的复杂性；法院在解释商业外观保护时需要考虑公共健康需求
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了商标法的理论重新调整，能够区分欺骗性消费者混淆与患者导向的治疗熟悉性；建立了三因素模型来指导司法解释和立法改革
AI.practical_contributions: 为司法实践提供了具体的判断框架，有助于平衡知识产权保护与公共健康需求，为药品行业的商业外观保护提供了实用指导

title: Discussion of “Dynamic Causal Effects in a Nonlinear World: the Good, the Bad, and the Ugly”
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Discussion of “Dynamic Causal Effects in a Nonlinear World: the Good, the Bad, and the Ugly”

publicationDetails.detailsText: Finance and Economics Discussion Series, issue 2025-058, 2025[10.17016/FEDS.2025.058]

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: This comment discusses Kolesár and Plagborg-Møller's (2025) finding that the standard linear local projection (LP) estimator recovers the average marginal effect (AME) even in nonlinear settings. We apply and discuss a subset their results using a simple nonlinear time series model, emphasizing the role of the weighting function and the impact of nonlinearities on small-sample properties.

AI.tldr: 本文讨论Kolesár和Plagborg-Møller(2025)的发现，即标准线性局部投影(LP)估计量即使在非线性设置中也能恢复平均边际效应(AME)。我们应用并讨论了他们的部分结果，使用一个简单的非线性时间序列模型，重点分析了权重函数的作用以及非线性对小样本性质的影响。
AI.research_question: 标准线性局部投影(LP)估计量在非线性设置中是否能够恢复平均边际效应(AME)？权重函数在其中的作用是什么？非线性如何影响小样本性质？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为线性LP估计量在非线性设置中会产生偏差，但Kolesár和Plagborg-Møller(2025)的最新发现挑战了这一观点，需要进一步验证和讨论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Kolesár和Plagborg-Møller(2025)的理论框架，使用局部投影方法和平均边际效应的概念，分析非线性时间序列模型中的估计问题。
AI.method: 应用简单的非线性时间序列模型，通过理论分析和数值模拟来验证线性LP估计量在非线性设置中的表现，特别关注权重函数的作用。
AI.findings: 确认了Kolesár和Plagborg-Møller的发现，即标准线性LP估计量确实能够恢复AME，即使存在非线性。权重函数在确定估计量的性质方面起着关键作用，非线性会影响小样本性质。
AI.theory_contributions: 为非线性设置中线性估计量的有效性提供了进一步的理论支持，深化了对LP估计量稳健性的理解，特别是在权重函数作用机制方面。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实证研究者提供了重要启示：在某些非线性情况下，仍可使用简单的线性LP方法估计平均效应，但需要注意小样本性质可能受到非线性影响。

title: Collateral Easing and Safe Asset Scarcity: How Money Markets Benefit from Low-Quality Collateral
affiliations: Deutsche Bundesbank, European Central Bank (ECB) and Frankfurt School of Finance & Management

detail.title: Collateral Easing and Safe Asset Scarcity: How Money Markets Benefit from Low-Quality Collateral

publicationDetails.journalName: Deutsche Bundesbank Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: We show that central bank lending against lower quality collateral can improve conditions in the repo market. For identification we take advantage of a pandemic-related temporary extension of the collateral framework of the European Central Bank (ECB), which allows banks to pledge previously ineligible credit claims as collateral for refinancing operations. We use a difference-in-differences approach and exploit banks that do not mobilize credit claims ex ante as a control group. We find that banks affected by the temporary extension pledge newly eligible credit claims in order to reduce the encumbrance of high-quality marketable assets. Treated banks lend out these marketable assets as collateral in the repo market, which helps to alleviate asset scarcity.

AI.tldr: 欧洲央行在疫情期间临时扩大抵押品范围，允许银行使用之前不合格的信贷债权作为抵押品，这有助于缓解回购市场的资产稀缺问题。
AI.research_question: 中央银行接受低质量抵押品的贷款是否能够改善回购市场条件？
AI.motivation: 疫情期间金融市场面临资产稀缺问题，需要研究央行抵押品框架扩展对回购市场的影响

title: Harmonized Population and Labor Force Statistics

publicationDetails.detailsText: Finance and Economics Discussion Series, issue 2025-057, 2025[10.17016/FEDS.2025.057]

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: The official labor force statistics often exhibit discontinuities in January, when updated population estimates are incorporated into the Current Population Survey (CPS) for the current year but are not revised backward through history. We construct harmonized population estimates spanning five decades and produce new weights for the CPS microdata that are benchmarked to these estimates. Using these weights, we estimate harmonized labor force statistics that reflect the latest available information about the population and its characteristics. The harmonized labor force series are free from the discontinuities in the historical data and show a notably larger labor force shortfall in the post-pandemic period.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建跨越五十年的人口估计数据并重新加权CPS微观数据，消除了官方劳动力统计数据中的不连续性，发现在疫情后时期劳动力短缺比官方数据显示的更为严重。
AI.research_question: 如何消除官方劳动力统计数据中的不连续性，并准确评估疫情后劳动力市场的真实状况？
AI.motivation: 官方劳动力统计数据在每年1月更新人口估计时会出现不连续性，因为新的人口估计只应用于当前年份而不对历史数据进行修订，这影响了数据的连续性和准确性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人口统计学和劳动力市场测量理论，强调人口估计更新对劳动力统计准确性的重要性。
AI.method: 构建跨越五十年的人口估计数据，为CPS微观数据生成新的权重，使数据与最新的人口估计和特征信息相匹配。
AI.findings: 使用协调权重后的劳动力统计数据显示，疫情后时期的劳动力短缺比官方数据显示的要大得多。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了消除劳动力统计数据不连续性的方法论框架，为长期劳动力市场分析提供了更准确的数据基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和研究人员提供了更准确的劳动力市场指标，特别是在评估疫情对劳动力市场影响方面具有重要实践价值。

title: Corporate Tax Shaming
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management, University of North Carolina (UNC) at Chapel Hill - Accounting Area and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Corporate Tax Shaming
detail.abstract: This paper serves two purposes. First, it is a tribute to Joel Slemrod from tax accountants. Joel worked with many accounting researchers, and we honor this work. Second, we review a literature Joel helped start: the literature on the reputational costs of tax avoidance and tax shaming's effectiveness in increasing tax compliance. We explore the evidence that consumers, employees, politicians, suppliers, or investors impose meaningful reputational costs on firms engaged in tax avoidance. We conclude that, while firms often perceive reputational risks and adjust behavior to avoid public scrutiny, the empirical evidence does not provide strong support for actual meaningful stakeholder responses.

AI.tldr: 本文是对Joel Slemrod的致敬，同时回顾了他开创的关于避税声誉成本和税收羞辱有效性的文献，发现虽然企业感知到声誉风险并调整行为，但实证证据不支持利益相关者实际有意义的反应。

title: Indirect Credit Supply: How Bank Lending to Private Credit Shapes Monetary Policy Transmission
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Pennsylvania State University and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Indirect Credit Supply: How Bank Lending to Private Credit Shapes Monetary Policy Transmission

publicationDetails.detailsText: Finance and Economics Discussion Series, issue 2025-059, 2025[10.17016/FEDS.2025.059]

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: This paper examines how banks’ financing of nonbank lenders affects monetary policy transmission. Using supervisory bank loan-level data and deal-level private credit data, we document an intermediation chain: Banks lend to Business Development Companies (BDCs)—large private credit providers—which then lend to firms. As monetary tightening restricts bank lending, firms turn to BDCs for credit, prompting BDCs to borrow more from banks. This intermediation chain raises borrowing costs, as banks charge BDCs higher rates, which BDCs pass on to firms. Consistent with this pass-through, bank-reliant BDCs respond more strongly to monetary tightening, and BDC-dependent firms grow more but exhibit weaker interest coverage ratios. Overall, while bank lending to nonbanks mitigates credit contraction and supports investment during tightening, it amplifies monetary transmission by elevating borrowing costs and financial distress risk.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文研究了银行向非银行借贷机构提供资金如何影响货币政策传导。通过监管数据发现了一个中介链条：银行借贷给商业发展公司（BDCs），这些公司再借贷给企业。货币政策紧缩时，这种中介链条会推高借贷成本并增加金融压力风险。
AI.research_question: 银行向非银行借贷机构提供资金如何影响货币政策传导机制？
AI.motivation: 理解货币政策传导的新途径，特别是在金融中介链条复杂化的背景下，银行与非银行机构之间的互动如何影响货币政策效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融中介理论、货币政策传导机制、借贷成本转移理论
AI.method: 使用监管级别银行贷款数据和交易级别私动借贷数据进行实证分析
AI.findings: 货币政策紧缩时，企业转向BDCs获得信贷，导致BDCs增加从银行的借款；银行向BDCs放贷的利率更高，BDCs将这些成本转移给企业；依赖银行的BDCs对货币政策紧缩反应更强烈；依赖BDCs的企业增长更快但利息复盖倍数更弱
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了银行-非银行中介链条的货币政策传导机制，丰富了金融中介理论在货币政策传导中的应用

title: Recession Shapes of Regional Evolution: Factors of Hysteresis
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Department of Economics, Korea University

detail.title: Recession Shapes of Regional Evolution: Factors of Hysteresis

publicationDetails.detailsText: Finance and Economics Discussion Series, issue 2025-062, 2025[10.17016/FEDS.2025.062]

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: This paper empirically investigates sources of hysteresis, focusing on downward nominal wage rigidity and the gender gap in the labor market, using U.S. state-level payroll employment data. Employing a Bayesian Markov-switching model of business cycles, we identify U-shaped and L-shaped recessions, which correspond to quick recoveries and hysteresis, respectively. Both U-shaped and L-shaped recessions are driven by supply and demand shocks; however, U-shaped recessions are associated with recessionary shocks that raise labor productivity, whereas L-shaped recessions are also driven by shocks that reduce labor productivity. Following L-shaped recessions, recoveries in employment, output, and labor productivity are sluggish and accompanied by declining inflation. In contrast, U-shaped recoveries feature stronger rebounds without significant changes in inflation. Greater downward nominal wage rigidity and a larger gender employment gap both increase the likelihood of L-shaped recessions and hysteresis. Downward nominal wage rigidity enhances the effectiveness of both expansionary monetary and tax policies. While expansionary monetary policy becomes more effective with a larger gender gap, the effectiveness of tax cuts remains unaffected.

AI.tldr: 本文通过贝叶斯马尔可夫转换模型分析美国州级就业数据，发现L型衰退（伴随迟滞现象）与U型衰退（快速复苏）的区别。研究发现向下名义工资刚性和性别就业差距都会增加L型衰退和迟滞的可能性，并影响货币和财政政策的有效性。
AI.research_question: 向下名义工资刚性和性别差距如何影响经济衰退的类型（U型vs L型）以及政策有效性？
AI.motivation: 理解经济衰退后迟滞现象的来源，特别是工资刚性和性别差距在形成不同类型经济衰退中的作用
AI.theoretical_framework: 迟滞理论、名义工资刚性理论、性别就业差距理论、贝叶斯马尔可夫转换模型
AI.method: 使用美国州级工资就业数据的贝叶斯马尔可夫转换业务周期模型
AI.findings: L型衰退伴随生产力下降和缓慢复苏，U型衰退伴随生产力提升和快速复苏；工资刚性和性别差距增加L型衰退可能性；工资刚性增强货币和税收政策效果，性别差距只增强货币政策效果
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了迟滞现象的新解释机制，明确了工资刚性和性别差距在经济周期中的不同作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了针对不同类型衰退的差异化政策建议，特别是货币和财政政策有效性的条件

title: Linear and Nonlinear Econometric Models Against Machine Learning Models: Realized Volatility Prediction
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Linear and Nonlinear Econometric Models Against Machine Learning Models: Realized Volatility Prediction

publicationDetails.detailsText: Finance and Economics Discussion Series, issue 2025-061, 2025[10.17016/FEDS.2025.061]

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: This paper fills an important gap in the volatility forecasting literature by comparing a broad suite of machine learning (ML) methods with both linear and nonlinear econometric models using high-frequency realized volatility (RV) data for the S&P 500. We evaluate ARFIMA, HAR, regime-switching HAR models (THAR, STHAR, MSHAR), and ML methods including Extreme Gradient Boosting, deep feed-forward neural networks, and recurrent networks (BRNN, LSTM, LSTM-A, GRU). Using rolling forecasts from 2006 onward, we find that regime-switching models—particularly THAR and STHAR—consistently outperform ML and linear models, especially when predictors are limited. These models also deliver more accurate risk forecasts and higher realized utility. While ML models capture some nonlinear patterns, they offer no consistent advantage over simpler, interpretable alternatives. Our findings highlight the importance of modeling regime changes through transparent econometric tools, especially in real-world applications where predictor availability is sparse and model interpretability is critical for risk management and portfolio allocation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过比较多种机器学习方法和计量经济模型在标普500高频波动率预测中的表现，发现状态转换模型（特别是THAR和STHAR）在预测精度、风险预测和实际效用方面均优于机器学习模型和线性模型

detail.abstract: There was a banking panic in New Mexico in early 1924 when about one-fourth of the banks in the state closed temporarily or permanently amid widespread runs. The Federal Reserve used both high profile and behind the scenes operations to calm the panic. This paper provides a history of this episode and explores how conspicuous and inconspicuous aspects of the Federal Reserve’s response interacted to bolster confidence in the banking system.

title: The Biosecurity Collective-Risk Social Dilemma: Simulating the Prevention of a Rapidly Spreading Pest
affiliations: Lancaster University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Government of the Commonwealth of Australia - CSIRO Health & Biosecurity and The University of Western Australia

detail.title: The Biosecurity Collective-Risk Social Dilemma: Simulating the Prevention of a Rapidly Spreading Pest
detail.abstract: Protection against pest invasion is a collective-risk social dilemma. The overall protection in a region of actors depends on the biosecuring actions they each adopt. If too few take protective measures, then the entire region is at risk, since if a pest colonises one property it can quickly spread to neighbouring properties, causing catastrophic economic losses for all. In this paper, we introduce an experimental game—the biosecurity collective-risk social dilemma—for simulating the problem of collective pest management. In the game, four-player groups interact over a series of rounds. In each round, players must decide whether to pay a private cost to take biosecurity action to protect a value at risk. The game is based on a one-shot game-theoretic model of collective pest management developed by Hennessy (2008). According to the model, the incentive to biosecure increases as the invasion risk rises. The opportunity for actors to communicate with one another—so they may provide assurances that they will biosecure if others will do so too—should increase engagement in risk-reducing action. We tested these predictions in an experiment where we manipulated the risk of an outbreak occurring and whether group members could communicate on certain rounds. Consistent with the model, both a higher background risk and communication facilitated biosecurity investments. Communication was effective because it increased trust and provided opportunities to strategically coordinate biosecurity investment strategies. The results suggest additional effort should be directed to improving risk communication and ensuring biosecurity schemes include a strong element of communication.

title: Participation, Transparency, and Cost Asymmetry in Common-Pool Resource Governance: Evidence from a Laboratory Experiment
affiliations: Chulalongkorn University and Prince of Songkla University

detail.title: Participation, Transparency, and Cost Asymmetry in Common-Pool Resource Governance: Evidence from a Laboratory Experiment
detail.abstract: This study explores the governance of common pool resources, focusing on fisheries, where not all players/stakeholders are involved in setting usage rules. Motivated by real world challenges in inclusive decision making, we rely on a computer-based laboratory experiment to investigate how resource use is affected by different rule setting scenarios. We find that externally set resource-use rules (such as from government agencies) lead to resource usage that is closer to the social optimum than rules solely set by users. Additionally, the involvement of only a subset of players in rule setting significantly affects common resource use, particularly when cost structures differ among users. Players who are excluded from the decision-making process, especially those with lower extraction costs, tend to exploit the resource more aggressively, resulting in both overuse and increased inequality. These findings highlight the interaction between institutional exclusion and economic heterogeneity. By systematically testing these dynamics, this study provides robust empirical evidence for the critical role of inclusive and transparent rule setting in promoting equitable participation and sustainable resource management.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过计算机实验发现，外部机构制定的资源使用规则比用户自定规则更接近社会最优水平。决策过程中排除部分参与者（特别是低提取成本者）会导致资源过度使用和不平等加剧，强调了包容性规则制定对可持续资源管理的重要性。

title: Navigating the Water-Energy-Food-Ecosystem Nexus in the Mediterranean: Archetypes and Complexities
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Independent, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Washington, American University of Beirut, University of Bologna, University of Bologna, University of Almeria, affiliation not provided to SSRN, NOVA School of Science and Technology, CENSE - Center for Environmental and Sustainability Research, NOVA School of Science and Technology, NOVA University Lisbon and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Navigating the Water-Energy-Food-Ecosystem Nexus in the Mediterranean: Archetypes and Complexities
detail.abstract: The Mediterranean region is grappling with escalating socio-environmental challenges driven by climate change, resource overexploitation, and fragmented sectoral governance in the Water, Energy, Food, and Ecosystems (WEFE nexus). This study uses Systems Thinking to explore the intricate interdependencies within the WEFE Nexus in three case studies: Portugal, Italy, and Lebanon. Participatory workshops enabled stakeholders to collaboratively develop Causal Loop Diagrams, which were subsequently analysed using system archetypes and leverage points to identify recurring feedback structures and transformative intervention strategies. Archetypes provided a means to distil complex dynamics into recognizable behavioural patterns, revealing systemic failures such as “Fixes that Fail” or “Shifting the Burden”. These were linked to leverage points across four domains: system variables, feedback loops, design structures, and underlying intent. Additionally, the iceberg model was employed to uncover deep-rooted paradigms and mental models shaping decision-making processes. The findings underscore the value of participatory system mapping and archetypal analysis in fostering more resilient and context-sensitive policy responses. By bridging theoretical frameworks with practical governance, this integrative approach supports the co-creation of targeted solutions that address both visible symptoms and structural root causes of identified challenges within the WEFE Nexus.

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: We find that an increase in policy rate uncertainty is associated with an increase in MMF portfolio allocations towards assets with shorter-dated maturities. We also find that the direction of uncertainty matters: MMF portfolio maturity is more sensitive to uncertainty when it relates to changes in expectations for a larger increase or a smaller decrease in the policy rate than when it relates to changes in expectations for a smaller increase or a larger decrease in the policy rate. Furthermore, for MMF that are eligible to participate at the Federal Reserve's Overnight Reverse Repurchase Agreement (ON RRP) facility, we find that when policy rate uncertainty increases, MMF adjust their portfolio composition by increasing their take-up at the facility. This suggests that the ON RRP facility helps smooth fluctuations in short-term funding markets.

title: The Case for Collective Autonomy in Work Time Reduction Research
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Case for Collective Autonomy in Work Time Reduction Research
detail.abstract: Work time reduction (WTR) is a policy that has been actively studied over the past decades. There is already substantial evidence that WTR can enhance individual well-being and life-satisfaction, while also contributing to lower consumption and greater environmental sustainability. As one of the core proposals of the degrowth discourse, WTR embodies a broad spectrum of transformative changes envisioned for a convivial society. This article makes a case for collective autonomy as an essential dimension of WTR research. It is a concept deeply embedded in degrowth vision yet underexplored in academic literature on work time reduction. The article offers conceptual development and outlines potential research agenda for interdisciplinary research to advance the knowledge of the collective dimension in reducing work time.

title: Food, Fuel, and Facts: Distributional Effects of Global Price Shocks
affiliations: University of Texas at Austin - Department of Economics, UNSW Business School and Reserve Bank of India

detail.title: Food, Fuel, and Facts: Distributional Effects of Global Price Shocks

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: International Finance Discussion Papers (Topic)

detail.abstract: We estimate distributional implications of global food and oil price shocks by utilizing monthly panel data on consumption and income from India, and an IV strategy that removes variation coming from global demand shocks. While both shocks lead to stagflationary aggregate dynamics, they differ in terms of distributional consequences. Consumption of lower income deciles is affected more by exogenous increases in food prices, while consumption of both tails of the income distribution is affected similarly by exogenous increases in oil prices. These heterogeneous negative consumption responses largely mirror the pattern of heterogeneity in wage income responses. Increases in relative expenditure of food, despite a rise in the relative local price of food, provides clear evidence for non-homothetic demand in non-durable consumption. Estimating the slopes of the Engel curve by impulse response matching, we find that food, compared to fuel, is a necessary consumption good for all income groups. Comparing the model predictions with the empirical consumption responses, we decompose the role played by wage income, relative price changes, and non-homotheticity in explaining our results.

AI.tldr: 本文使用印度消费和收入面板数据，通过工具变量方法分析全球食品和油价冲击的分配效应。研究发现食品价格冲击对低收入群体影响更大，而油价冲击对收入分布两端影响相似，这些差异主要源于工资收入的异质性反应。

title: Danish Organic Farmers’ Willingness to Pay for a Novel Marine-Based Organic Fertilizer – a Choice Experiment
affiliations: University of Copenhagen, University of Copenhagen, University of Copenhagen, University of Stavanger, University of Copenhagen and University of Copenhagen

detail.title: Danish Organic Farmers’ Willingness to Pay for a Novel Marine-Based Organic Fertilizer – a Choice Experiment
detail.abstract: The growing organic agricultural sector in Denmark faces a critical challenge in that it lacks suitable fertilizing products of biological origin. Processed marine-based fertilizers, derived from fish residues, algae waste and other marine biomass, represent a novel product group that is not yet available on the market, but could offer a promising solution to this challenge. Using a discrete choice experiment (DCE) among 183 Danish arable organic farmers, this study estimates the willingness to pay (WTP) for such products.The results indicate that farmers are willing to pay between 1.83€ and 5.11€ per kg of nitrogen (N) for marine-based fertilizers, depending on the form and level of odour present. They generally prefer solid over liquid forms, neutral levels of odour over those negatively affecting themselves and their neighbouring farmers, and plant- and animal-based inputs over marine-based inputs. Latent class analysis reveals that younger farmers in regions with low availability of livestock manure expressed the highest willingness to adopt novel processed organic fertilizers.Our findings suggest a prevailing scepticism towards marine-based fertilizers among arable farmers. Concerns about their perceived safety and application feasibility may need to be addressed for broader adoption. By exploring the potential of marine-based fertilizers, this study provides insights that can inform the development of organic farming across Europe, particularly in regions facing nutrient shortages.

title: Will Americans Be Able to Prove Konrad Adenauer Was Wrong?
affiliations: Seton Hall University

detail.title: Will Americans Be Able to Prove Konrad Adenauer Was Wrong?
detail.abstract: Americans' election of a man like Donald Trump as their president twice reminds me of the late West German Chancellor Konrad Adenauer's lament: "God limited the intelligence of man but did not also limit his stupidity." Germans proved their beloved and revered Konrad Adenauer was wrong when they forced the Berlin Wall to fall in November 1989. Will Americans become welleducated and wise enough to prove Adenauer was wrong by demolishing America's 'Berlin Wall'a plutocracy pretending to be a democracy? Or will many of them remain stultified by what Mark Twain called "three kinds of lies" (or a paraphrased version-"lies, damned lies, and dissembling") and continue to align only with either MAGA's Coca-Cola or Democratic Party's Diet Coke? If they remain so, they will most likely slit the throat of American democracy in the act of "democide," foreboding the demise of American civilization.

title: Job Quality in Illinois | Disparities by Gender, Race, and Education
affiliations: University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign, University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign and Pennsylvania State University - Abington College

detail.title: Job Quality in Illinois | Disparities by Gender, Race, and Education

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign | School of Labor and Employment Relations (LER) Labor Education Program (LEP) May 1, 2025

detail.abstract:
In this report, researchers at the University of Illinois’ Project for Middle Class Renewal examine differences in access to quality jobs in Illinois by gender, education, and ethnicity. Using our Employment Quality in Illinois 2.0 (EQ-IL 2.0) survey data of over 5,000 workers across Illinois, we created a measure of job quality that utilizes 30 job quality components from our ten core dimensions of employment quality we defined in our EQ-IL 2.0 report. We aggregated the data by occupation and assigned a score for each component by quintile. We grouped occupations by composite scores into five groupings ranging from high-quality, to medium-high, medium, medium-low to low-quality jobs.

Our multi-dimensional measure of job quality suggests significant and impactful gender and racial disparities in employment in higher-quality occupations that offer higher incomes, more employer-provided benefits, and greater work schedule control, job security, and advancement opportunities. Our report extends the extensive evidence of gender and racial pay gaps and research that men and white workers tend to have access to specific advantageous job benefits (e.g., paid leave, health insurance, schedule control, advancement opportunities). Below are highlights from our report.

Gender Differences in Access to Quality Jobs: 

Out of every 100 high-quality jobs, men occupy 62, while women only occupy 38. Meanwhile, men and women are equally represented in the lowest-quality occupations.

Education is NOT the great equalizer: Two-thirds of men with a master’s or other advanced degree are employed in the highest quality occupations, compared to just 46% of women; Technical/associate degrees may increase access to medium-high quality occupations (e.g., health technician, equipment installation, & construction) - particularly for White workers.
Recommendations

Racial/Ethnic Differences in Access to Quality Jobs: White workers have more access to high-quality jobs compared to others.

Thirty-five percent of White workers are employed in the highest-quality occupations, followed by 32% of Hispanic workers and 27% of Black workers.

Our report suggests that in addition to the traditional focus on pay gaps by gender and race/ethnicity, there is also an overall job quality gap – with women and Black and Hispanic workers less likely to be employed in the higher quality occupations that offer key features of better benefits, work schedules, job security, and advancement opportunities critical factors for worker well-being. Policymakers and employers can help expand opportunities in accessing good quality jobs and jobs with good qualities.

State agencies and private sector employers should adopt a multi-dimensional framework like EQ-IL to assess employment quality to help pinpoint specific jobs and job features that could improve job quality across the board, especially among medium and low-quality jobs.

Since college degrees and technical education expand access to higher-quality jobs, reducing barriers and costs to enrollment and degree completion could improve worker well-being.

Occupational segregation is apparent, likely due to persistent rigid job demands that constrain worker choices of occupation and education. Policies and practices that increase employee control over their work schedule, or at least predictability and stability, and work-life reconciliation benefits, would be particularly helpful to workers with caregiving responsibilities.

AI.method: 使用伊利诺伊州就业质量2.0调查数据，对5000多名工人进行调查，通过30个就业质量组成部分构建综合评分体系，按五分位数对职业进行分组（从高质量到低质量）。
AI.findings: 1) 性别差异：每100个高质量工作中，男性占62个，女性仅占38个；2) 种族差异：35%白人员工在高质量职业，西班牙裔32%，黑人27%；3) 教育并非平等器：拥有硕士学位的男性中2/3在高质量职业，女性仅46%；4) 技术/副学士学位可能增加中等质量职业机会。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个多维度的就业质量评估框架，超越了传统的薪酬差距研究，为理解就业不平等提供了更全面的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和雇主提供了具体建议：采用多维框架评估就业质量、降低教育门槛、改善工作日程控制和稳定性、促进工作与生活平衡，特别有助于有照顾责任的工人。

title: Foreign Exchange Regimes in (Normal Times and) Times of War: Insights from Ukraine
affiliations: University of Liverpool - Management School (ULMS)

detail.title: Foreign Exchange Regimes in (Normal Times and) Times of War: Insights from Ukraine
detail.abstract: On February 24, 2022, as Russia invaded, the National Bank of Ukraine switched from a flexible to a fixed exchange rate regime. Was this policy response optimal? To answer this, we develop an open-economy model with both nominal rigidities and frictions in borrowing on international financial markets. We find that the carefully calibrated model can rationalize the NBU's decision: the optimal response to small shocks is to allow exchange rate flexibility, whereas in response to large shocks-such as an invasion-currency depreciation is suboptimal. For robustness, we consider tradable endowment, risk-premium, and non-tradable supply shocks, and add subsistence consumption.

AI.tldr: 乌克兰央行在俄罗斯入侵时从浮动汇率转向固定汇率，通过开发开放经济模型分析发现，对小冲击应保持汇率灵活性，但对大规模冲击如入侵，货币贬值是次优选择，支持了央行的决策。
AI.research_question: 乌克兰央行在俄罗斯入侵时从灵活汇率转向固定汇率的政策是否最优？
AI.motivation: 分析在极端冲击（如军事入侵）下，汇率政策的最优应对策略，为类似危机情况下的货币政策提供理论依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 开放经济模型，包含名义刚性和国际金融市场借贷摩擦
AI.method: 开发并校准开放经济模型，考虑多种冲击类型（可贸易禀赋、风险溢价、非贸易供给冲击）和生存消费
AI.findings: 模型能够合理解释乌克兰央行的决策：对小冲击应保持汇率灵活性，但对大规模冲击（如入侵），货币贬值是次优的
AI.theory_contributions: 为极端危机情况下的汇率政策选择提供了理论框架，扩展了传统最优汇率政策理论的应用边界
AI.practical_contributions: 为面临类似大规模冲击的国家提供了汇率政策制定的参考依据，支持危机时期采取固定汇率制度的合理性

title: An Empirical Analysis of Conventional and Game based Pedagogical approaches on Learner Motivation and Engagement
affiliations: The Shri Ram School Delhi, Students

detail.title: An Empirical Analysis of Conventional and Game based Pedagogical approaches on Learner Motivation and Engagement

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest and acknowledges that the research was conducted without external funding that could have influenced the study design or interpretation of results.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research adhered to rigorous ethical standards throughout the data collection process. All participants were comprehensively informed about the study's objectives, methodology, and intended use of the collected data. A detailed confidentiality and data-handling policy was provided to ensure transparency regarding data protection measures. Students were notified of this research’s prohibition on data sharing with third parties for commercial, non- commercial and non-academic purposes. Prior to participation, students were required to review comprehensive terms of participation that outlined their rights, responsibilities, and the permanent nature of the data submission. Informed consent was obtained through an embedded clause in the data collection instrument requiring explicit acknowledgment: "By continuing with this survey, you affirm that you have read and understood the terms set forth in this document, and you consent to participate under these conditions. If you do not accept these terms in full, you are advised to discontinue your participation immediately and exit the form." All identifying information, including names, email addresses, were excluded from the analysis and publication to ensure participant anonymity. Data was immediately aggregated and anonymized upon analysis to prevent individual identification. The research protocol emphasized voluntary participation while requiring complete responses to maintain data integrity. Participants were informed that digital transmission inherently carries minimal security risks, which they accepted as part of their consent to participate.
declarations.funderStatement: The author declares no conflicts of interest and acknowledges that the research was conducted without external funding that could have influenced the study design or interpretation of results.

detail.abstract: Despite India's pressing educational deficits, with over 25% of adolescents lacking basic literacy and numeracy, empirical studies on instructional effectiveness remain limited. This study evaluates how game-based learning (GBL) and conventional pedagogies influence motivation and engagement among Indian students. By isolating their differential impacts, the research aims to inform scalable, evidencebased strategies for improving science learning outcomes in resource-constrained classrooms. The findings are positioned to advance both academic literature and policy dialogue on pedagogical reform in non-Western, digitally evolving education systems. Employing a purposive sampling methodology across 93 government schools, the study analyzed 1,816 valid participants aged 13-18 years following systematic exclusion criteria. Data collection utilized linguistically adapted, psychometrically validated instruments including the Student Motivation Scale and Student Engagement Instrument, alongside custom-developed conventional and game-based learning preference assessments. Statistical analyses revealed robust positive correlations between game-based learning preferences and both student motivation (r = 0.67, p < 0.001) and engagement (r = 0.71, p < 0.001). Multiple regression models demonstrated that GBL preferences accounted for 45% of variance in motivation (R² = 0.45) and 50% of variance in engagement (R² = 0.50), with standardized beta coefficients of 0.67 and 0.70 respectively. Conversely, conventional learning preferences showed negligible correlations with motivational outcomes (r =-0.02, p= 0.36). Significant age-related patterns emerged, with younger adolescents (13-15 years) demonstrating substantially higher GBL preferences and motivation levels compared to older peers. These findings provide compelling empirical support for integrating game-based pedagogical strategies in under-resourced educational environments.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文研究了游戏化学习在印度资源突出教育环境中对学生动机和参与度的影响，发现游戏化学习偏好与动机（r=0.67）和参与度（r=0.71）呈显著正相关，能解释45%-50%的变异量，而传统教学方法效果微小。
AI.research_question: 游戏化学习和传统教学法对印度学生动机和参与度的影响有何差异？
AI.motivation: 印度过去25%青少年缺乏基础读写能力，但关于教学效果的实证研究有限，需要找到可扩展的教学策略来改善资源突出班级的科学学习效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于游戏化学习理论和动机理论，探讨游戏化教学对学生学习动机和参与度的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用目的性抽样法，在93所政府学校调查1,816名13-18岁学生，使用语言适配、心理测量验证的学生动机量表、学生参与度量表以及自制的传统和游戏化学习偏好评估工具进行数据收集。
AI.findings: 统计分析显示游戏化学习偏好与学生动机（r=0.67, p<0.001）和参与度（r=0.71, p<0.001）呈显著正相关。多元回归模型显示游戏化学习偏好能解释52%的动机变异量和50%的参与度变异量。而传统学习偏好与动机效果相关性微小（r=-0.02, p=0.36）。年纪较小的青少年（13-15岁）游戏化学习偏好和动机水平显著高于年长同伴。
AI.theory_contributions: 为非西方数字化教育体系中的教学效果研究提供了实证支撑，扩展了游戏化学习理论在资源突出环境中的应用，进一步丰富了动机理论在不同文化背景下的实证研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度等资源突出教育环境提供了具体的游戏化教学实施建议，为教育政策制定者提供了基于证据的教学改革方案，将有助于提高资源限制条件下的科学教育质量。

title: Distributional Patterns in U.S. Monetary Transmission: Quantile Cointegration Evidence
affiliations: Universidad de Piura, Universidad del Pacifico and Universidad de Piura

detail.title: Distributional Patterns in U.S. Monetary Transmission: Quantile Cointegration Evidence
detail.abstract: This study challenges the conventional assumption of uniform monetary policy transmission by examining interest rate pass‑through across the conditional distribution using quantile cointegration. Using U.S. data from 1994–2024, we estimate long‑run relationships between the federal funds rate and both lending rates and Treasury yields at quantiles 0.1–0.9, employing the Phillips–Hansen fully modified quantile estimator with quantile CUSUM stability tests. We find that transmission is fundamentally asymmetric and varies systematically with economic conditions. Under conventional policy measures, pass‑through mechanisms display marked instability, with cointegration frequently breaking down in crisis periods when policy effectiveness is most crucial. The prime rate remains stably linked to the policy rate only at select quantiles, while Treasury yields show clear maturity‑dependent patterns—medium‑term maturities are generally more resilient than short‑ or long‑term yields. Temporal robustness checks reveal that transmission was more unstable during the pre‑Global Financial Crisis era than often assumed, but markedly more stable in the pre‑COVID period, consistent with institutional learning and enhanced policy frameworks. Using the Wu‑Xia shadow rate in place of the federal funds rate delivers complete stability for the prime rate. This indicates that many breakdowns observed under conventional measures reflect policy‑measurement limitations at the zero lower bound rather than genuine transmission failures. The results suggest central banks should adopt state-contingent frameworks that recognize transmission asymmetries and deploy unconventional tools proactively in stressed conditions.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用分位数协整方法挑战了货币政策传导均匀性的传统假设，发现利率传导在经济条件不同时存在系统性不对称。政策传导机制在危机时期经常失效，而使用影子利率替代传统政策利率可显著改善传导稳定性。
AI.research_question: 货币政策传导机制在不同经济条件下是否呈现系统性不对称？利率传导在条件分布的不同分位数上如何变化？
AI.motivation: 传统研究假设货币政策传导是均匀的，但实际中传导效果可能因经济状况而异。特别是在危机时期，政策有效性最为关键时，传导机制可能出现不稳定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于分位数协整理论，采用Phillips-Hansen完全修正分位数估计量和分位数CUSUM稳定性检验，分析政策利率与市场利率之间的长期关系。
AI.method: 使用1994-2024年美国数据，在0.1-0.9分位数上估计联邦基金利率与贷款利率、国债收益率之间的长期关系，并进行时间稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 传导机制存在根本性不对称：危机时期协整关系经常中断；最优利率仅在特定分位数与政策利率稳定关联；国债收益率呈现明显的期限依赖模式；使用影子利率可完全稳定最优利率传导。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了货币政策传导均匀性的传统假设，提出了状态依存的传导框架，为理解非对称传导机制提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议央行采用状态依存的政策框架，在压力条件下主动部署非常规工具，并改进政策测量方法以准确评估传导效果。

title: onetary Economics at 30: A Reexamination of the Relevance of Money in Cashless Limiting Monetary Economies
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - Department of Economics

detail.title: onetary Economics at 30: A Reexamination of the Relevance of Money in Cashless Limiting Monetary Economies

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
The well-known cashless-limiting result in Woodford (1998) has become the theoretical foundation for a large body of work that treats the costs and benefits of holding money as irrelevant for monetary transmission. I reexamine this result and find that it relies on a peculiar credit-market structure consisting of perfectly competitive, zero-interest deferred payment arrangements. I show that the result breaks down when the microstructure is generalized to allow for an endogenous interest rate and market power in credit intermediation. The tenuousness of this influential result should give pause to the widespread practice of basing monetary policy advice on models without money.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视Woodford(1998)的无现金限制理论，发现该理论依赖于完美竞争、零利率延期支付的特殊信贷市场结构。当允许内生利率和信贷中介市场力量时，该理论失效。
AI.research_question: Woodford(1998)的无现金限制理论是否稳健？该理论对货币政策建议的适用性如何？
AI.motivation: 无现金限制理论已成为大量货币政策研究的基础，但该理论可能建立在特殊假设之上，需要重新检验其稳健性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于货币经济学和信贷市场微观结构理论，分析无现金限制理论的前提假设和局限性。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，通过推广信贷市场微观结构（引入内生利率和市场力量）来检验原理论的稳健性。
AI.findings: 无现金限制理论依赖于完美竞争、零利率延期支付的特殊信贷市场结构。当允许内生利率和信贷中介市场力量时，该理论不再成立。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了无现金限制理论的脆弱性，挑战了该理论作为货币政策分析基础的普遍适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒政策制定者谨慎使用不含货币的模型进行货币政策建议，强调了货币持有成本与收益在货币政策传导中的重要性。

title: Food Price Changes, Household Food and Nutrition Security in Ethiopia: Evidence From Household Level Analysis through a Gender Lens
affiliations: Ethiopian Economics Association (EEA), Ethiopian Economics Association (EEA) and Ethiopian Civil Service University

detail.title: Food Price Changes, Household Food and Nutrition Security in Ethiopia: Evidence From Household Level Analysis through a Gender Lens
detail.abstract: This study investigates the impact of food price changes on food security and diet quality in Ethiopia using recent Living Standard Measurement Surveys. Household-level food security and diet quality were assessed using the Household Diet Diversity Score, Food Insecurity Experience Scale, and proportion of food consumption expenditure. Employing a random effects panel regression and Oaxaca-Blinder decomposition, this study examined the differential effects of price changes across household types, guided by the Harvard gender analysis framework. The results of the study show that food prices significantly influence household food expenditure shares. Rising prices force households to allocate a greater income portion to food, often reducing nonfood expenditures, especially for vulnerable groups such as female-headed and low-income households. Urban households with better access to diverse food and higher incomes exhibit lower foods expenditure shares than rural households. Dietary diversity declined, particularly among female-headed households and those aged 26-49, highlighting the influence of household size, income, and resource access. The findings of this study underscore the critical importance of addressing food price rises and their consequences for household food security in Ethiopia. Policy interventions aimed at stabilizing food prices, promoting sustainable agricultural practices, and enhancing social safety nets are crucial for mitigating the adverse impacts of food price shocks on vulnerable populations. Furthermore, targeted interventions aimed at empowering women and addressing gender inequalities in access to resources and decision-making can help improve food security and nutrition outcomes for female-headed households.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用埃塞俄比亚生活水平调查数据，通过面板回归和Oaxaca-Blinder分解方法，分析了食品价格变化对不同类型家庭食物安全和饮食质量的影响。研究发现价格上涨导致家庭食品支出比例增加，饮食多样性下降，女性户主和低收入家庭受影响最严重。
AI.research_question: 食品价格变化如何影响埃塞俄比亚不同家庭类型的食物安全和饮食质量？
AI.motivation: 食品价格波动对家庭食物安全具有重要影响，特别是在发展中国家如埃塞俄比亚，需要了解价格变化对不同脆弱群体的差异化影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 哈佛性别分析框架，用于分析价格变化对不同性别户主家庭的差异化影响
AI.method: 使用随机效应面板回归和Oaxaca-Blinder分解方法，基于生活标准测量调查数据，采用家庭饮食多样性评分、食物不安全体验量表和食品消费支出比例等指标
AI.findings: 食品价格显著影响家庭食品支出份额；价格上涨迫使家庭将更多收入用于食品，减少非食品支出；女性户主和低收入家庭受影响最严重；城市家庭食品支出份额低于农村家庭；饮食多样性下降，特别是女性户主和26-49岁人群
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了基于性别分析框架的食品价格影响差异化研究，丰富了食物安全研究的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定提供实证依据，建议稳定食品价格、促进可持续农业、加强社会安全网，以及针对女性赋权和性别平等的针对性干预措施

title: Global Geopolitical Risk and Asset Pricing: Evidence from the Financial Sector in European and Asian Markets Comparative Analysis using the Fama-French Five-Factor Model
affiliations: The University of Lahore Islamabad Campus

detail.title: Global Geopolitical Risk and Asset Pricing: Evidence from the Financial Sector in European and Asian Markets Comparative Analysis using the Fama-French Five-Factor Model

declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics Approval This study did not involve human participants, animals, or personal identifiable data; therefore, ethics approval was not required. All secondary data used were obtained from publicly available and credible sources, including official bank reports, World Bank databases, IMF statistics, and other recognized financial data repositories

detail.abstract: This study investigates the impact of global geopolitical risk (GPR) on asset pricing in the financial sector across European and Asian markets, employing the Fama-French Five-Factor Model as the primary analytical framework. Using monthly data from 2010 to 2024, the analysis integrates GPR, sourced from the Caldara and Iacoviello index, into the model to assess its incremental explanatory power beyond traditional risk factors-market, size, value, profitability, and investment. The sample comprises listed financial sector firms from major European and Asian economies, enabling a robust cross-regional comparison. Regression results reveal that GPR exerts a statistically significant influence on asset returns in both regions, but with notable differences in magnitude and direction. In Europe, the effect is generally muted, reflecting more mature market structures and stronger institutional resilience. In contrast, Asian markets display heightened sensitivity to geopolitical uncertainty, particularly in emerging economies with higher exposure to cross-border capital flows and trade dependencies. The inclusion of GPR improves the model's explanatory power (R²) in both regions, with a more pronounced improvement in Asia. These findings underscore the importance of integrating geopolitical risk into asset pricing models, especially for portfolio management and risk assessment in globally interconnected financial systems. The study contributes to the literature by providing comparative evidence on the role of geopolitical risk in shaping financial sector returns across diverse market environments, offering practical implications for investors, policymakers, and risk managers.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨全球地缘政治风险对欧亚金融市场资产定价的影响，发现地缘政治风险在两个地区都具有统计显著性，但在亚洲市场影响更显著，特别是在新兴经济体。研究强调了将地缘政治风险纳入资产定价模型的重要性。
AI.research_question: 全球地缘政治风险如何影响欧亚金融部门的资产定价？
AI.motivation: 随着全球地缘政治不确定性增加，理解其对金融市场的影响对于投资组合管理和风险评估至关重要
AI.theoretical_framework: Fama-French五因子模型，整合地缘政治风险作为额外风险因子
AI.method: 使用2010-2024年月度数据，基于Caldara和Iacoviello地缘政治风险指数，对欧亚主要经济体金融部门上市公司进行回归分析
AI.findings: 地缘政治风险在两个地区都具有统计显著性影响，欧洲影响相对温和，亚洲市场敏感性更高，特别是在新兴经济体；加入GPR后模型解释力提升，亚洲改善更明显
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了资产定价理论，证实地缘政治风险是重要的定价因子，特别是在全球互联的金融体系中
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者、政策制定者和风险管理者提供实用指导，强调在投资决策和风险管理中考虑地缘政治风险的重要性

title: Assessing the Impact of Remedial Education: Evidence from Chile
affiliations: Universidad Andrés Bello

detail.title: Assessing the Impact of Remedial Education: Evidence from Chile
detail.abstract: This study provides causal evidence on the effects of remedial exams on subsequent academic performance among first-year university students. Using a fuzzy regression discontinuity design, we find that students who pass critical courses via remedial exams achieve substantial academic gains in subsequent coursework. Specifically, passing the remedial exam increases subsequent course grades by 0.74 standard deviations. The intervention operates not through additional instructional reinforcement, but via corrective behavioral feedback: facing the risk of failure, students offered a second-chance exam receive a salient signal that adjusts their academic beliefs and effort allocation. These findings contribute to international debates on scalable, cost-effective academic support mechanisms in higher education systems facing massification, fiscal constraints, and growing student heterogeneity.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过模糊断点回归设计，发现补考通过能显著提升大学生后续学业表现0.74个标准差，其作用机制是行为反馈而非教学强化
AI.research_question: 补考对学生后续学业表现有何因果影响？其作用机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 高等教育面临规模化、财政紧缩和学生异质性增加的挑战，需要寻找可扩展且成本效益高的学业支持机制
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学中的信念调整和努力分配理论，重点关注风险信号对学术行为的影响
AI.method: 模糊断点回归设计（Fuzzy Regression Discontinuity Design），分析补考通过与否对后续课程成绩的影响
AI.findings: 通过补考的学生在后续课程中成绩提升0.74个标准差；作用机制是行为反馈（风险信号调整学术信念和努力分配）而非教学强化
AI.theory_contributions: 为学术支持机制的行为经济学解释提供因果证据，深化对风险信号和信念调整机制的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为高等教育机构提供了成本效益高的学业干预方案，证明补考作为学术支持工具的有效性

title: Polycentric Status Contests
affiliations: University of Arizona - Department of Political Economy and Moral Science

detail.title: Polycentric Status Contests
detail.abstract: As societies become richer, and basic needs are satisfied, zero-sum positional contests gain more prominence, while the regular positivesum benefits of markets subside in the background. As long argued by Hirsch, Frank and others, the institutions for managing resource scarcity and spurring economic growth, i.e. the institutions of capitalism, may not be particularly well-suited for managing the type of scarcity associated with positional goods. The long-term equilibrium of rich societies may not be as peaceful as many assume if they become overrun by status competitions. This paper provides a typology of positional goods, explaining why some positional competitions are worse than others, and a rent-seeking model of the supply response to positional goods' price changes. The model leads to surprisingly optimistic predictions: markets tend to fragment the worst kinds of positional goods into competing hierarchies of status, tend to dissipate and eliminate some positional goods, and tend to turn the most damaging status competitions into more beneficial prestige competitions. Government interventions, by contrast, often attempt to prop-up monopolistic status hierarchies.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨富裕社会中地位竞争的问题，认为市场机制能够有效缓解有害的地位竞争，将其转化为更有益的声望竞争，而政府干预往往适得其反。
AI.research_question: 富裕社会中地位竞争的性质及其对长期社会均衡的影响是什么？市场机制和政府干预在管理地位商品方面分别起到什么作用？
AI.motivation: 随着社会变富和基本需求得到满足，零和地位竞争变得更加突出，而资本主义制度可能不适合管理地位商品相关的稀缺性，这可能导致富裕社会的长期均衡不如预期和平。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Hirsch和Frank等人的地位商品理论，构建地位商品的类型学框架和租金寻求模型来分析价格变化对供给反应的影响。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建租金寻求模型来分析地位商品价格变化对市场供给的动态响应机制。
AI.findings: 市场倾向于将最有害的地位商品分裂成竞争性的地位层级，消散和消除某些地位商品，并将最具破坏性的地位竞争转化为更有益的声望竞争。政府干预往往试图维持垄断性的地位层级。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了地位商品的类型学框架，发展了租金寻求模型来解释地位商品市场的动态机制，挑战了传统对地位竞争的悲观看法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于如何更好管理地位竞争的理论指导，建议减少政府干预，让市场机制自然调节地位竞争，从而实现更优化的社会结果。

title: Biodiversity Risk and Corporate Default Probability
affiliations: VinUniversity

detail.title: Biodiversity Risk and Corporate Default Probability
detail.abstract: The study examines the impact of biodiversity risk on default probability. The study shows that biodiversity risk increases the likelihood of default. The impacts are significant for firms with lower access to credit and cash reserves. Firms with leverage jumps for operating needs present a significantly increased 5-year-ahead default risk. As firms reserve sufficient liquidity, leverage jumps decrease default risk. Local risk climate factors moderate the impact of biodiversity on default risk. Treated firms that are prone to transitional and physical risk factors experience a significantly increased default probability. There is a bright side for firms with higher attention from management boards and analysts to climate change exposure. Local climate action maintains a firm's growth prospects through the mitigated effects of biodiversity risk on default probability. The findings offer timely contributions to corporate biodiversity finance, which is crucial to future studies.

AI.motivation: 随着生物多样性风险日益受到关注，需要研究其对企���财务稳定性的影响，特别是在违约风险方面的作用机制。
