title: Breaking the Night Barrier: Night-shift Reforms and Women's Work in India
affiliations: Vidhi Centre for Legal Policy and University of Luxembourg

detail.title: Breaking the Night Barrier: Night-shift Reforms and Women's Work in India

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.

detail.abstract: Female labor force participation (FLFP) in India has remained stubbornly low, defying the expectation that women's employment would rise alongside economic growth. While supply-side constraints such as gendered norms and care responsibilities are well documented, the role of demand-side institutional barriers has received less empirical attention. We study whether the removal of one such barrier-legal prohibitions on employing women in night-shifts improved female employment outcomes. We exploit the variation in the timing of state-wise reforms in service sector labour laws in India between 2016 and 2024 to employ a staggered difference-in-differences design. We find that women in treated states increased time allocated to night hours, while overall hours worked declined, possibly toward more flexible or better-compensated shifts. We also find evidence of increased formalization among women in more organized firms and higher socioeconomic groups, consistent with bargaining responses to improved legal rights. The effects of lifting gendered legal barriers appear strongest where employers are willing to hire, infrastructure supports mobility, and women have bargaining power, while in more precarious settings, gains are limited. In India's heterogeneous and often informal services sector, such reforms can shift employment patterns, but their reach and quality may depend on complementary institutional and infrastructural support.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文研究了印度取消女性夜班工作禁令对女性就业的影响，发现改革在企业愿意雇用、基础设施支持和女性询价能力强的地区效果更好，而在更脆弱的环境中收益有限
AI.research_question: 取消女性夜班工作的法律禁令是否改善了女性就业结果？
AI.motivation: 印度女性劳动力参与率持续低水平，违背了经济增长带动女性就业增长的预期，需要研究需求端制度性障碍的作用
AI.theoretical_framework: 需求端制度性障碍理论，法律改革对劳动市场影响的理论
AI.method: 采用锐步双重差分法（staggered difference-in-differences），利用2016-2024年印度各州服务业劳工法改革时间的差异
AI.findings: 受处理州女性增加了夜间工作时间，但总体工作时间减少，可能转向更灵活或更高报酬的班次；在组织化程度高的企业和高社会经济组织中女性正式化程度提高
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了需求端制度性障碍在女性劳动力市场中的重要作用，补充了供给端约束研究的不足
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于法律改革在不同环境下效果差异的实证依据，建议配套制度和基础设施支持以提高改革效果

title: The Risk Protection Value of Moral Hazard
affiliations: Boston University and Yale University

detail.title: The Risk Protection Value of Moral Hazard

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Health insurance lowers the out-of-pocket price of healthcare, and it is well-established that this leads to higher utilization of care. This type of "moral hazard" is typically viewed as a social cost of insurance. Within a standard model, we show that there are two important ways in which the consumer's ability to change her behavior in response to insurance can play a central role in the ability of insurance to protect her from risk. These are (i) by allowing optimal exploitation of real income gained in bad states, and (ii) by enabling more resources to be shifted to bad states than otherwise could be. We provide a theoretical characterization of these cases and quantify their importance empirically. Under standard parameterizations of demand for healthcare and health insurance, estimates in the literature imply that moral hazard accounts for as much as half of the total value of risk protection derived from insurance. Preventing consumers from changing their behavior in response to insurance would lower costs, but also result in a major loss of risk protection, on-net reducing consumer welfare in the population we study. Our results suggest that under-utilization of healthcare may thus be an equally important threat to welfare as over-utilization.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视医疗保险中的道德风险问题，认为传统上被视为社会成本的道德风险实际上可能是保险风险保护价值的重要组成部分。研究发现道德风险占保险风险保护总价值的近一半，阻止消费者根据保险调整行为虽然会降低成本，但会导致重大的风险保护损失。
AI.research_question: 道德风险在医疗保险风险保护中扮演什么角色？它是否如传统观点认为的那样纯粹是社会成本？
AI.motivation: 传统观点将医疗保险中的道德风险视为纯粹的社会成本，但作者认为消费者根据保险调整行为的能力可能在风险保护中发挥重要作用，需要重新评估道德风险的福利含义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 标准保险模型，分析消费者在获得保险后改变医疗保健利用行为的能力如何影响保险的风险保护功能。
AI.method: 理论建模和实证量化相结合的方法。首先建立理论框架，然后在标准医疗需求和健康保险参数化下进行实证量化。
AI.findings: 道德风险占保险风险保护总价值的近一半（高达50%）。阻止消费者根据保险调整行为虽然会降低医疗成本，但会导致重大的风险保护损失，总体上降低消费者福利。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新概念化道德风险的作用，提出消费者行为调整能力是保险风险保护机制的重要组成部分，挑战了传统将道德风险视为纯粹社会成本的观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定提供新视角：医疗保健利用不足可能与过度利用同等重要地威胁福利，保险设计需要平衡成本控制和风险保护功能。

title: Greener Pastures on the Other Side: Addressing Climate Migration and Its Impacts on Sustainable Development. A Case Study of the Northern Region of Nigeria
affiliations: Charles III University of Madrid

detail.title: Greener Pastures on the Other Side: Addressing Climate Migration and Its Impacts on Sustainable Development. A Case Study of the Northern Region of Nigeria
detail.abstract:
“Nigeria’s 800 km coastline is increasingly threatened by rising sea levels and severe storms, displacing growing numbers of people due to environmental hazards such as droughts, floods, and coastal erosion (UNFCCC, 2021; UNHCR, 2024).”
Human migration, both internal and cross-border, has long been influenced by multiple factors. In recent years, climate change has emerged as a critical driver of human mobility, particularly in regions experiencing environmental degradation and socioeconomic vulnerabilities. This thesis examines climate-induced migration in Northern Nigeria, focusing on how environmental stressors, such as desertification, drought, and land degradation, interact with socioeconomic factors to shape migration patterns. Using a mixed-methods approach, including a literature review and quantitative analysis of secondary data, the study identifies the main drivers of migration, assesses its impacts on sustainable development, and explores existing policy gaps surrounding climate migration.
The findings reveal that climate migration in Northern Nigeria is predominantly involuntary, driven by declining agricultural productivity, water scarcity, and the collapse of traditional livelihoods. This migration intensifies pressure on urban infrastructure, contributes to intercommunal conflict, and disrupts social cohesion. Although migration often exacerbates pre-existing vulnerabilities, it also functions as a survival strategy, offering short-term relief and alternative income through remittances. Nonetheless, broader consequences, such as increased resource competition and social instability, pose significant long-term challenges to sustainable development in the region.
Policy recommendations include mainstreaming climate migration into national climate and development frameworks, enhancing urban planning, restoring degraded ecosystems, and improving data collection and governance systems. Proactive policies can help Nigeria build resilience, mitigate conflict, and promote equitable and sustainable development pathways for vulnerable populations.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨尼日利亚北部气候引起的移民问题，发现环境压力与社会经济因素相互作用导致非自愿移民，对城市基础设施和社区稳定造成压力，同时提出将气候移民纳入政策框架的建议。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚北部气候引起的移民模式如何受到环境压力和社会经济因素的共同影响？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚800公里海岸线面临海平面上升和严重风暴威胁，环境灾害导致人口流离失所，气候变化已成为人类流动的关键驱动因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 气候移民理论，环境退化与社会经济脆弱性相互作用框架
AI.method: 混合研究方法，包括文献综述和二手数据的定量分析
AI.findings: 尼日利亚北部气候移民主要是非自愿的，由农业生产力下降、水资源短缺和传统生计崩溃驱动；移民加剧城市基础设施压力、导致社区冲突和社会凝聚力破坏；移民既是生存策略也带来长期可持续发展挑战
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对气候移民驱动机制的理解，特别是环境压力与社会经济因素相互作用的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 提出将气候移民纳入国家气候和发展框架的政策建议，包括加强城市规划、恢复退化生态系统、改进数据收集和治理系统

title: The Passthrough of Treasury Supply to Bank Deposit Funding
affiliations: University of Southern California - Marshall School of Business, Columbia University - Columbia Business School and Amazon.com, Inc.

detail.title: The Passthrough of Treasury Supply to Bank Deposit Funding

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We demonstrate the passthrough of Treasury supply to bank deposits through bank market power. We show that a larger Treasury supply crowds out deposits with disproportionate effects in more competitive deposit markets. A larger Treasury supply further curtails bank lending and affects bank funding structure. The explanatory power of Treasury supply is not driven by other shocks to deposit demand and supply. In comparison, monetary policy rate hikes have a larger impact on deposit funding in more concentrated markets, consistent with the deposits channel of monetary policy. Our empirical findings are rationalized in a model of imperfect deposit competition.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文通过银行市场力量展示了国债供应对银行存款的传导机制，发现在竞争更激烈的存款市场中，国债供应增加会不成比例地挤出存款，并进一步限制银行贷款和影响银行融资结构。
AI.research_question: 国债供应如何通过银行市场力量影响银行存款和贷款？
AI.motivation: 理解国债供应对银行体系的传导机制，特别是在不同市场竞争程度下的差异化影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不完全存款竞争模型，基于银行市场力量的理论框架。
AI.method: 实证分析，使用银行和市场层面的数据，控制存款需求和供给的其他冲击。
AI.findings: 1) 更大的国债供应挤出存款，在竞争性市场中影响更大；2) 限制银行贷款并改变融资结构；3) 与货币政策相比，国债供应的影响在市场集中度不同的情况下表现不同。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了国债供应通过银行市场力量传导的理论模型，丰富了货币政策传导机制的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于国债发行对银行体系影响的实证证据，有助于优化财政政策和货币政策的协调。

title: Which Individuals Create Jobs? Managerial Talent and Occupational Skills
affiliations: University of California, San Diego (UCSD) - Department of Economics, University of California, San Diego (UCSD) - Department of Economics and Government of the Federative Republic of Brazil - Central Bank of Brazil

detail.title: Which Individuals Create Jobs? Managerial Talent and Occupational Skills

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We consider founders of limited liability firms who previously held jobs in the formal sector of Brazil. Managers are five percent of former job holders but their startups account for 27 percent of new firm employment. Relatively little of their overrepresentation as founders or the larger size of their startups is explained by their previous wages or other standard human capital variables. Among non-managerial former occupations we examined those clearly connected to demand (sales) and to supply (technology, purchasing). Only purchasing was comparable to managerial occupations in entrepreneurship and new firm size. Further examination suggests that a key to greater entrepreneurship and larger initial firm size is that workers’ former jobs entailed building relationships with other businesses: in demand-side occupations, they sold to other businesses; in supply-side occupations, they bought from other businesses.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 己经在巴西正规部门就业的创业者中，管理者属于少数群体（5%）但创造了新创企业27%的就业。研究发现他们的创业成功主要来自于之前工作中建立的商业关系网络，而非传统人力资本因素。
AI.research_question: 为什么来自巴西正规部门的管理者在创业活动中过度代表，以及他们的创业为什么创造了更多的就业机会？
AI.motivation: 理解不同职业背景的工人在创业时的表现差异，并探索使某些工人在创业方面更成功的关键因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以企业家精神和人力资本理论为基础，重点考察职业经验中构建的商业关系网络对创业成功的影响。
AI.method: 利用巴西正规部门就业数据，分析不同职业群体的创业活动和新创企业规模，通过回归分析控制传统人力资本变量。
AI.findings: 管理者虽仅占5%，但创造了新企业27%的就业。这种过度代表性主要来自于他们之前工作中建立的商业关系网络（如销售和采购），而非薪资或其他标准人力资本变量。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了企业家精神理论，突出了商业关系网络作为重要的无形资本对创业成功的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和创业者提供了实践指导，明确了在职业发展中构建商业关系网络的重要性，以及如何通过职业训练提升创业能力。

title: Slaughterhouse Closures and Reduced Crime Rates: Evidence from Colombia
affiliations: Economic and Social Research Institute (ESRI)

detail.title: Slaughterhouse Closures and Reduced Crime Rates: Evidence from Colombia
detail.abstract: This paper examines the effect of slaughterhouse closures on crime rates in Colombian municipalities between 2005 and 2024. Using a quasi-experimental design that leverages exogenous variation from a 2007 sanitary reform, which led to the closure of over 400 slaughterhouses, I estimate the impact of the regional presence of slaughterhouses on interpersonal crime. The identification strategy relies on the staggered implementation of closures and Local Projection Difference-inDifferences (LP-DiD) models to compare changes in crime rates across treated and control municipalities. I find that municipalities where all slaughterhouses closed experienced sustained and significant reductions in assault and theft rates-the most prevalent forms of interpersonal crime. Additional analysis shows no evidence of major changes in property crime or unemployment among young men, supporting both green criminology and economic displacement theories as mechanisms linking slaughterhouses to crime.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2005-2024年间哥伦比亚屠宰场关闭对犯罪率的影响，发现屠宰场全部关闭的市镇袭击和盗窃率显著持续下降，支持了绿色犯罪学和经济替代理论。
AI.research_question: 屠宰场关闭对哥伦比亚市镇人际犯罪率有何影响？

title: Testing Environmental Kuznets Curve Hypothesis for Sub-Saharan African Countries: The Role of Income Inequality and Economic Freedom
affiliations: Ethiopian Civil Service University, Salale University - Department of Economics and Salale University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Testing Environmental Kuznets Curve Hypothesis for Sub-Saharan African Countries: The Role of Income Inequality and Economic Freedom
detail.abstract: The rise in atmospheric carbon dioxide (CO2) concentrations has become a critical global environmental concern, primarily driven by increased economic activities. This has prompted numerous scholars to investigate the determinants of CO2 emissions within the framework of the environmental Kuznets curve. However, many researchers have overlooked the roles of income inequality and economic freedom in their analyses of the environmental Kuznets curve in Sub-Saharan African countries. This study focuses on 16 countries, selected based on data availability, to examine the impact of economic freedom and income disparity on CO2 emissions under the environmental Kuznets curve hypothesis, utilizing balanced quarterly data from 2000 to 2015. Pre-estimation tests were conducted using second-generation panel crosssectional dependence, slope homogeneity, and unit root tests. Cointegration and Granger tests, which account for heterogeneity, were applied to assess the cointegration and causality direction among the variables under investigation. The pooled mean group autoregressive distributed lag estimation technique was employed to estimate the long-run coefficients. The results indicate that the variables in question are cointegrated, and economic freedom does not have a statistically significant effect on CO2 emissions. This finding supports the environmental Kuznets curve hypothesis. In the long run, income inequality, industrialization, and non-renewable energy consumption positively affect CO2 emissions. Economic freedom does not impact environmental quality in the panel of countries studied. The Granger causality analysis results suggest that economic freedom, income inequality, renewable energy consumption, urbanization, industrialization, non-renewable energy consumption, and economic growth Granger cause CO2 emissions with a feedback effect, except for economic freedom and industrialization. Policies aimed at reducing income inequality can improve environmental quality.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了撒哈拉以南非洲16个国家在环境库兹涅茨曲线框架下，经济自由和收入不平等对CO2排放的影响。研究发现经济自由对排放无显著影响，支持EKC假说；收入不平等、工业化和不可再生能源消费长期正向影响排放；多数变量与CO2排放存在双向因果关系。
AI.research_question: 经济自由和收入不平等在环境库兹涅茨曲线框架下如何影响撒哈拉以南非洲国家的CO2排放？
AI.motivation: 现有研究在分析环境库兹涅茨曲线时往往忽视收入不平等和经济自由的作用，特别是在撒哈拉以南非洲国家背景下需要更全面的分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境库兹涅茨曲线(EKC)理论框架，探讨经济发展与环境质量之间的倒U型关系。
AI.method: 使用2000-2015年16个国家的平衡季度数据，采用第二代面板横截面依赖性检验、斜率同质性检验、单位根检验，以及考虑异质性的协整检验和格兰杰因果检验，运用 pooled mean group ARDL 估计技术计算长期系数。
AI.findings: 变量存在协整关系；经济自由对CO2排放无显著统计影响，支持EKC假说；收入不平等、工业化和不可再生能源消费长期正向影响排放；多数变量与CO2排放存在双向格兰杰因果关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 将收入不平等和经济自由纳入环境库兹涅茨曲线分析框架，丰富了EKC理论在非洲背景下的应用，提供了更全面的解释视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 政策启示：减少收入不平等的政策可以改善环境质量；为撒哈拉以南非洲国家制定环境政策提供了实证依据，特别是在控制工业化进程和能源消费模式方面。

title: Towards Epistemic Equity in Economics: A Meta-Analytical Synthesis of Methodological Evolution, Regional Disparities, and Pluralistic Futures
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Towards Epistemic Equity in Economics: A Meta-Analytical Synthesis of Methodological Evolution, Regional Disparities, and Pluralistic Futures

declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A

detail.abstract: This article presents a comprehensive qualitative meta-analysis exploring the evolution of economic methodology, tracing its development from normative classical foundations rooted in moral philosophy to contemporary empirical and computational paradigms that emphasize precision and data-driven insights. By synthesizing over 150 peer-reviewed publications, institutional reports, and philosophical critiques, the study maps significant methodological shifts, evaluates persistent epistemic tensions, and investigates how structural inequities, particularly in the Global South, influence access to and legitimacy of economic methodologies. The analysis advocates for a pluralistic, inclusive, and context-sensitive methodological framework that integrates theoretical depth, empirical rigor, and local relevance to advance epistemic justice and enhance the discipline's robustness. It critically engages with recent critiques of the credibility revolution in economics and explores emerging frameworks for ontological pluralism, addressing the complex global challenges of an era characterized by polycrisis-a convergence of interconnected crises such as climate change, inequality, and financial instability.

AI.tldr: 本文通过定性元分析探讨经济方法论的演变，从基于道德哲学的规范性古典基础发展到强调精确性和数据驱动的当代实证与计算范式，主张建立多元包容、情境敏感的方法论框架以促进认知公正。
AI.research_question: 经济方法论如何从古典规范性基础演变为当代实证计算范式？结构性不平等如何影响经济方法论的获取和合法性？
AI.motivation: 探索经济方法论的历史演变轨迹，分析全球南方结构性不平等对方法论获取的影响，应对多危机时代复杂挑战，促进认知公正和学科稳健性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于道德哲学的古典规范性理论、实证主义、计算经济学、认知公正理论、本体多元主义框架
AI.method: 综合性定性元分析方法，整合150+同行评审出版物、机构报告和哲学批判
AI.findings: 识别出显著的方法论转变，评估了持续的认知张力，发现结构性不平等影响方法论获取和合法性，需要多元包容的方法论框架
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了整合理论深度、实证严谨性和地方相关性的多元方法论框架，推进了认知公正理论，探索了本体多元主义新框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为经济学科提供更具包容性和情境敏感性的方法论指导，帮助应对多危机时代的复杂全球挑战，促进全球南方的方法论公平获取

title: The Decentralized Monetary Index - Risk (DMIR): An Early Warning System for Central Banks in a Decentralized Financial Landscape
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Decentralized Monetary Index - Risk (DMIR): An Early Warning System for Central Banks in a Decentralized Financial Landscape
detail.abstract: Central banks globally are grappling with the profound implications of decentralized finance (DeFi) on monetary and financial stability. The rapid evolution of DeFi protocols introduces novel risks that traditional supervisory frameworks may not adequately capture. This paper introduces the Decentralized Monetary Index-Risk (DMI-R), a sophisticated composite indicator designed to function as an early warning system for central banks. The DMI-R aims to quantify and monitor the potential vulnerabilities arising from the increasing decentralization of financial activities, including the erosion of conventional monetary policy transmission mechanisms, the emergence of new liquidity risks, and the growing interconnectedness between traditional and decentralized financial systems. By providing a robust, data-driven framework, the DMI-R empowers policymakers to proactively identify, assess, and mitigate systemic risks, thereby safeguarding financial stability in an increasingly complex and decentralized monetary environment.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了DMI-R指数作为央行预警系统，用于监控去中心化金融(DeFi)对货币金融稳定的风险
AI.research_question: 如何有效量化和监控去中心化金融(DeFi)对货币金融稳定性的系统性风险？
AI.motivation: 全球央行面临DeFi快速发展带来的新型风险，传统监管框架难以充分捕捉这些风险，需要新的监测工具
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于系统性风险理论、金融稳定理论和早期预警系统理论，结合DeFi特有的风险特征
AI.method: 开发复合指标DMI-R(去中心化货币指数-风险)，整合多维度数据构建预警系统
AI.findings: DMI-R能够有效识别和量化DeFi带来的潜在脆弱性，包括货币政策传导机制弱化、新型流动性风险和传统与去中心化金融系统互联性增强等风险
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了专门针对DeFi风险监测的理论框架，扩展了系统性风险理论在去中心化金融环境下的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行提供了实用的数据驱动预警工具，帮助政策制定者主动识别、评估和缓解系统性风险，维护金融稳定

title: Composition Beats Collapse: Insights from the Bisin–Verdier Model on Endogenous Fertility Reversal
affiliations: University of Maryland - Department of Economics and University of San Andres (UdeSA)

detail.title: Composition Beats Collapse: Insights from the Bisin–Verdier Model on Endogenous Fertility Reversal

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Fertility rates have fallen below replacement in most countries, fueling predictions of demographic collapse and even human extinction. These forecasts overlook a crucial fact: societies are not homogeneous. Using the Bisin–Verdier model of cultural transmission with endogenous fertility and direct socialization, calibrated to U.S. and global religion data, we identify an evolutionary counterforce. Subpopulations with persistently high fertility survive, expand their share, and push the total fertility rate (TFR) upward over time. Even if every country’s TFR reaches a below-replacement level, the persistence of above-replacement groups makes extinction unlikely. Our simulations point to a future of growth with pronounced compositional change—driven above all by high-fertility religious communities—rather than collapse. In particular, in our baseline ten-generation world calibration, Muslims become the largest tradition by share.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过文化传播模型分析发现，尽管全球生育率普遍低于更替水平，但高生育率的亚群体（特别是宗教群体）会持续存在并扩大份额，从而推动整体生育率回升，避免了人口崩溃的预测。
AI.research_question: 在大多数国家生育率低于更替水平的情况下，人口是否会走向崩溃和灭绝？
AI.motivation: 现有的人口预测忽视了社会的异质性，没有考虑到高生育率亚群体的持续存在和扩张效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Bisin-Verdier文化传播模型，包含内生生育率和直接社会化机制。
AI.method: 使用美国和全球宗教数据进行模型校准，并进行多代模拟分析。
AI.findings: 高生育率亚群体会生存下来并扩大其人口份额，推动整体生育率随时间上升；穆斯林群体在基线十代校准中将成为最大传统群体。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了考虑社会异质性的人口演化理论框架，挑战了传统的人口崩溃预测。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了新的人口预测视角，表明人口结构将发生显著变化而非崩溃，高生育率宗教社区将成为主要驱动力。

title: Truly Nonpartisan Deficit Management via Proof-of-Stake Voting for Bondholders
affiliations: University of Texas at Austin - College of Natural Sciences

detail.title: Truly Nonpartisan Deficit Management via Proof-of-Stake Voting for Bondholders
detail.abstract:
What if the financiers of public debt had a say in how governments spent their loans? Persistent fiscal deficits in many democracies have eroded long-term economic stability and increased the risk of default-driven debt crises. Existing constitutional and institutional checks, such as independent central banks, separation of powers, and ``nonpartisan'' fiscal watchdogs, can be weakened by political polarization or single-party dominance, especially when populist leaders promise short-term payouts to their base.

This paper thus proposes a novel constitutional mechanism inspired by governance experiments in the blockchain sector. The ``Bondholder's House'' is an unelected, non-partisan body empowered to veto deficit-financed budgets unless overridden by a legislative supermajority. Voting rights in this chamber would be proportional to staked holdings of government bonds, weighted by stake size, maturity, and lock-up period, ensuring that those with greater exposure to a government's long-term fiscal health have more influence in approving or vetoing deficit spending. This proposal could stabilize deficit spending by populist administrations, counterbalance short-term electoral politics with the interests of long-term, low-risk investors, and offer a bailout mechanism for governments facing debt crises with enforcible reform conditions.

Proof-of-Stake systems on the blockchain, where voting power scales with a participant's financial stake, already demonstrate the empirical viability of this proposal. Case studies of Ethereum, EOS, and Steem illustrate both the potential and pitfalls of stake-based governance, including scalability gains, enhanced security incentives, and risks of wealth concentration or collusion between large stakers. By incorporating safeguards---such as prohibiting the sale or delegation of voting rights, restricting participation to citizens, and limiting scope strictly to deficit control---the Bondholder's House could align fiscal decision-making with long-term economic stability without undermining core democratic principles.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于区块链权益证明机制的新型宪法机制"债券持有人议院"，通过赋予长期国债持有者预算否决权来遏制民粹主义政府的赤字支出，平衡短期选举政治与长期经济稳定。
AI.research_question: 如何设计有效的制度机制来约束民主国家的财政赤字支出，防止民粹主义政策导致的债务危机？
AI.motivation: 许多民主国家持续的财政赤字侵蚀了长期经济稳定性，增加了债务违约危机风险，现有宪法和制度制衡机制在政治极化和民粹主义兴起时容易被削弱。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于区块链权益证明治理机制的理论框架，将金融利益相关者的长期经济利益与财政决策权相结合。
AI.method: 理论构建和案例研究方法，分析以太坊、EOS和Steem等区块链项目的权益证明治理实践，并设计"债券持有人议院"的制度架构。
AI.findings: 权益证明治理机制在区块链领域已证明其可行性，能够实现规模扩展、增强安全激励，但也存在财富集中和大持有者串通的风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将区块链治理机制引入传统财政制度设计的创新理论框架，为财政约束机制研究提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 设计了具体的"债券持有人议院"制度方案，包括投票权分配规则、安全保障措施和实施范围限制，为实际政策制定提供了可操作的制度设计。

title: Monetary Policy, Prudential Regulations, and Domestic Credit: The Role of Commercial Banks in Pakistan
affiliations: Federation Pakistan Chambers of Commerce and Industry

detail.title: Monetary Policy, Prudential Regulations, and Domestic Credit: The Role of Commercial Banks in Pakistan

publicationDetails.journalName: Asian Development Bank Institute Publications

detail.abstract: The objective of this study is to test the impacts of significant monetary policy devices and prudential regulations on the ability of banks to invest and lend. The interconnectedness of the banking sector, public sector debt, and financing for private sector business activities in Pakistan is also an important concern of this study. It was presumed that the effects of prudential regulations are transformed through mandatory magnitudes of equity and cash requirements. The significant positive and robust impact of equity on investment, advances, deposits, and liquidity was ascertained, and the conclusion was drawn that prudential regulations do not discourage lending or investment. This study is based on 5 years of data from 33 commercial banks in Pakistan, and the random effect models (REM) and seemingly unrelated regression estimation (SURE) techniques were adopted to estimate the parameters.

AI.tldr: 本研究检验货币政策工具和审慎监管对巴基斯坦银行投资和贷款能力的影响，发现股权要求对投资、贷款、存款和流动性有显著正面影响，审慎监管不会抑制银行放贷和投资
AI.research_question: 货币政策工具和审慎监管如何影响巴基斯坦银行的投融资能力？
AI.motivation: 探讨银行业、公共部门债务和私营部门融资活动之间的相互关联性，以及审慎监管通过股权和现金要求对银行行为的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于银行监管理论和货币政策传导机制，重点关注审慎监管要求（股权和现金要求）对银行投融资行为的影响机制
AI.method: 使用巴基斯坦33家商业银行5年数据，采用随机效应模型（REM）和似不相关回归估计（SURE）技术进行参数估计
AI.findings: 股权对投资、贷款、存款和流动性具有显著正面且稳健的影响，审慎监管不会抑制银行的贷款或投资活动
AI.theory_contributions: 为审慎监管政策效果提供了实证证据，挑战了审慎监管可能抑制银行信贷的传统观点
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴基斯坦银行业监管政策制定提供参考，表明适当的股权要求可以促进银行稳健经营和信贷投放

title: Financial and Policy Shocks: An Application of Topic Modeling on Central Banks’ SDG-Driven Policy Predilection for Asia and Pacific Economies
affiliations: Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Kanpur

detail.title: Financial and Policy Shocks: An Application of Topic Modeling on Central Banks’ SDG-Driven Policy Predilection for Asia and Pacific Economies

publicationDetails.journalName: Asian Development Bank Institute Publications

detail.abstract: Financial inclusion (FI) plays a determining role in achieving inclusive and sustainable macroeconomic policy outcomes, one of the fundamental premises of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Further, economies' central banks formulate related policies and contribute as enablers to the transmission pathway from inclusive policymaking to sustainable and equitable economic growth. Economy-specific studies, mostly restricted to a specific financial inclusion scheme/initiative, have examined the role of financial inclusion in shaping SDG deliverables, with a particular focus on poverty alleviation and equitable income generation. Also, no empirical exploration has yet been performed to ascertain the role of the policy biases/priorities of central banks in expediting the attainment of sustainable macroeconomic targets. By deploying a fixed-effect panel regression strategy and an instrumental variable technique on 15 major economies in the Asia and Pacific region over a period of 31 years, this study negates the solitary role of FI factors in influencing the changing spectrum of SDG targets. This research further explores Millennium Development Goals (MDGs), SDGs, the Asian financial crisis of 1997, and the global financial crisis of 2008 as policy shocks/interventions and observes their positive contribution in shaping the results of sustainable economic development targets. Further, this study uniquely deploys a natural language processing (NLP) technique on central banks’ annual reports, monetary policy statements, and press releases for the 15 economies from 2000 to 2022 and analyzed 1,815 documents through topic Modeling. This paper concludes that the policy inclination of central banks toward sustainable macroeconomic development has increased over the years and substantially improved with the emergence of policy shocks. With the economy clustering/grouping observed in this exploration, it is evident that the central banks of Asia and Pacific economies have a unidirectional, though heterogeneous, intent to contribute to the broader national objectives of attaining SDGs.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过面板回归和NLP技术分析亚太15个经济体31年数据，发现金融包容性单独作用有限，政策冲击（如金融危机、SDGs）对可持续发展目标实现有积极贡献，央行政策倾向随时间增强且存在异质性。
AI.research_question: 金融包容性因素是否单独影响可持续发展目标？央行政策偏向在促进可持续宏观经济目标实现中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多局限于特定金融包容计划，缺乏对央行政策偏好在促进可持续发展目标中作用的实证探索，需要系统性分析政策冲击和央行政策倾向的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融包容性理论、可持续发展目标框架、政策冲击理论，结合央行货币政策传导机制，构建金融包容-政策干预-可持续发展目标的理论联系。
AI.method: 固定效应面板回归和工具变量法（31年15个亚太经济体数据），自然语言处理技术分析1815份央行文件（2000-2022年），主题建模分析政策倾向。
AI.findings: 金融包容性因素单独作用有限；政策冲击（MDGs、SDGs、金融危机）对可持续发展目标有积极贡献；央行可持续政策倾向随时间增强且存在经济体集群异质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了金融包容性理论，引入政策冲击和央行政策倾向作为关键调节变量，建立了更完整的金融包容-可持续发展目标理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行制定促进可持续发展的货币政策提供实证依据，帮助政策制定者理解政策冲击的积极作用，推动亚太经济体央行协调可持续发展目标实现。

title: The Future of Digital Financial Inclusion in Brunei Darussalam
affiliations: Universiti Brunei Darussalam

detail.title: The Future of Digital Financial Inclusion in Brunei Darussalam

publicationDetails.journalName: Asian Development Bank Institute Publications

detail.abstract:
We explore the future of digital financial inclusion in Brunei Darussalam, emphasizing the interplay between technological advancement and access to finance. We provide an overview of Brunei Darussalam's financial technology landscape and outline future scenarios related to digital financial inclusion. Brunei Darussalam presents a unique case as a small, open, and resource-rich economy grappling with an uneven digital divide. Despite a high internet penetration rate of 95% and universal 4G coverage, digital financial inclusion remains limited by structural and socioeconomic barriers. Although the government has introduced various policies aimed at promoting digital financial inclusion, adoption rates and transaction values remain low.

Our analysis reveals that only 65.7% of Brunei Darussalam's population hold a bank account, with even lower rates of online banking use and debit card ownership. Although the digital payment market has expanded significantly, the average transaction value per user has declined, underscoring disparities in adoption. We also highlight connectivity gaps, particularly in rural areas, where only 70% of households have reliable internet access. We identify five key drivers of change aimed at building inclusive digital ecosystems and offer policy recommendations for economies grappling with an uneven digital divide. Future research should further explore how inclusive digital ecosystems can advance full financial inclusion.

title: Working from Home After Hours? Right to Disconnect Laws, Firm Profitability and Employee Work-Life Balance
affiliations: University of Pittsburgh - Katz Graduate School of Business, University of Pittsburgh - Katz Graduate School of Business and University of Pittsburgh - Katz Graduate School of Business

detail.title: Working from Home After Hours? Right to Disconnect Laws, Firm Profitability and Employee Work-Life Balance
detail.abstract: Telecommuting technologies have enabled widespread remote work but have also made it easier for employees to be contacted outside normal working hours, blurring the boundary between work and personal life. Many countries have adopted right to disconnect (RTD) laws that allow employees to disengage from work-related communications after their regular hours without facing negative consequences. This study examines the consequences of RTD laws by using a sample of firms in the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) countries. Our difference-in-differences analyses find a significant positive effect of RTD laws on firm profitability. Further analyses are consistent with the higher firm profitability resulting from an increase in employee productivity. We also find that enforcement mechanisms (e.g., fines for non-compliance and dispute resolution guidance) and labor market conditions moderate the effect of RTD laws on firm profitability. In addition, using Glassdoor reviews for a sample of Canadian firms, we find a significant increase in employee satisfaction with work-life balance in Ontario after the province adopted its RTD law. Overall, our study contributes to the ongoing debate over RTD laws by documenting significant benefits of such policies for both firms and employees.

detail.title: From Bank Lending Standards to Bank Credit Conditions: An SVAR Approach

publicationDetails.detailsText: Finance and Economics Discussion Series, issue 2025-055, 2025[10.17016/FEDS.2025.055]

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: This paper uses a structural vector autoregressive (SVAR) model—identified with an external monetary policy instrument and sign restrictions—to derive a measure of bank credit conditions from changes in bank lending standards.  The model incorporates data on interest rates, bank credit, and survey-based measures of bank lending standards to identify monetary policy, credit demand, and credit supply shocks.  Using these identified shocks, we construct a novel measure of bank credit conditions that corresponds to the component of credit growth that would occur if credit demand remained unchanged, reflecting solely the impacts of monetary policy and credit supply shocks.  Using this measure, we find that credit supply–driven changes in bank credit conditions have a stronger impact on real outcomes in the euro area, whereas monetary policy–driven changes play a larger role in the U.S. economy.

affiliations: Australian National University (ANU) - Crawford School of Public Policy, Australian National University (ANU) - Centre for Applied Macroeconomic Analysis (CAMA) and Independent

detail.title: Rapid Productivity Growth in Asia: Internal and External Financing

publicationDetails.journalName: Asian Development Bank Institute Publications

detail.abstract: Developing Asia has achieved remarkable economic growth in the last several decades but faces challenges moving from middle-income to high-income status. We examine the macroeconomic impacts of future productivity growth in developing Asia on the region and the world, focusing on the responses of private investment. We consider five scenarios of productivity growth driven by catch-up mechanism, with our results showing that Asia’s transition to high-income status requires continued rapid productivity growth and massive private investment. The increase in investment would significantly raise real interest rates domestically, resulting in international capital flows. Quantitatively, increased investment would be financed mainly through domestic saving, but international capital markets would also play a critical role. Productivity growth in one region generates spillover effects in others through two channels, namely international trade and capital flows. Spillover effects tend to be modestly negative in the medium term because capital flows would increase interest rates, but positive in the long term because regions with rising productivity would increase imports from other regions. Thus, competition among Asian economies and with other developing regions is not a zero-sum game as they benefit from each other in the long term. Continuous improvement in policies, institutions, and governance in developing Asia is required to achieve rapid productivity growth and to reduce the risks among economies in attracting international capital flows. Additionally, we examine two climate change scenarios and show that climate change will negatively impact productive investment and economic growth both in developing Asia and globally, as it will reduce productivity.

AI.tldr: 亚洲发展中经济体要实现向高收入国家转型，需要持续的快速生产率增长和大规模私人投资。投资增加会推高实际利率，引发国际资本流动。生产率增长通过国际贸易和资本流动产生溢出效应，长期来看亚洲经济体间的竞争不是零和游戏。气候变化会负面影响生产性投资和经济增长。

AI.findings: 1) 亚洲转型需要持续快速生产率增长和大规模私人投资；2) 投资增加会显著推高国内实际利率，引发国际资本流动；3) 投资主要通过国内储蓄融资，但国际资本市场也起关键作用；4) 生产率增长通过贸易和资本流动产生溢出效应；5) 气候变化会负面影响生产性投资和经济增长。

AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了实现高收入转型需要持续改善政策、制度和治理的建议，强调了吸引国际资本流动的风险管理，以及应对气候变化对经济增长负面影响的重要性。

title: Debt, Climate, and Development in Asia and the Pacific: Breaking the Vicious Circle
affiliations: University of London - School of Oriental and African Studies (SOAS) - Economics, Independent and SOAS University of London

detail.title: Debt, Climate, and Development in Asia and the Pacific: Breaking the Vicious Circle

publicationDetails.journalName: Asian Development Bank Institute Publications

detail.abstract:
Developing countries in the Asia and Pacific region are at the forefront of climate change, and addressing urgent climate challenges requires substantial financial commitment. At the same time, the region is struggling under mounting debt burdens. The external sovereign debt of developing Asia and Pacific nations excluding the People’s Republic of China (PRC), has more than doubled since 2008. Rising debt burdens are becoming increasingly costly, with average debt servicing expenses over the past 3 years exceeding their pre-2020 levels by more than 40% as a share of government revenue. We analyze the region’s worsening debt dynamics and the additional strain posed by climate challenges, highlighting how unsustainable debt burdens threaten sovereign fiscal stability and undermine the ability of the developing Asia and Pacific region to meet its climate goals.

We provide an overview of debt and development challenges in the region and discusses the risk it faces of an accelerating vicious circle of debt, climate change, and underdevelopment. And finally, it makes the case for concerted efforts to proactively tackle sovereign debt problems, which in some cases will require significant debt relief as a pathway to sustainable growth.

title: The Theory of Financial Stability Meets Reality

detail.title: The Theory of Financial Stability Meets Reality

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: A large literature at the intersection of economics and finance offers prescriptions for regulating banks to increase financial stability. This literature abstracts from the discretion that accounting standards give banks over financial reporting, creating a gap between the information assumed to be available to regulators in models of optimal regulation and the information available to regulators in reality. We bridge insights from the economics, finance, and accounting literatures to synthesize knowledge about the design and implementation of bank regulation and identify areas where more work is needed. We present a simple framework for organizing the relevant ideas, namely the externalities that motivate bank regulation, the rationales for allowing accounting discretion, and the use of discretion to circumvent regulation. Our takeaway from reviewing work in these areas is that academic studies of bank regulation and accounting discretion require a more unified approach to design optimal policy for the real world.

detail.abstract: This work sets out the participation of Italian regions in the international economy using indicators proposed in the empirical intercountry input-output literature. First, it examines how foreign demand contributes to regional value added through direct and indirect trade (via other regions or countries) in goods and services. It shows that the relative importance of direct and indirect ‘pathways’ in bilateral value-added exports is associated with regional and destination countries’ features. Indirect ‘pathways’ through other regions are proportionally more important for the South, smaller regions and destination countries, and direct ones for territories of larger size and large and contiguous countries. Secondly, it evaluates the types of regional participation in international value chains and their possible common traits. It finds that regions that participate by supplying a higher proportion of domestic value added, compared with foreign, are those for which, in addition to the manufacturing sector, advanced services and innovative activities are significant in their productive structures. They are mainly the major central and northern regions and a few southern ones.

detail.abstract: We examine the responsiveness of labor participation, unemployment and labor migration to exogenous variations in labor demand. Our empirical approach considers four instruments for regional labor demand commonly used in the literature. Empirically, we find that labor migration is a significant margin of adjustment for all our instruments. Following an increase in regional labor demand, the initial increase in employment is mainly accounted for by a reduction in unemployment. Over time, however, net labor in-migration becomes the dominant factor contributing to increased regional employment. After five years, roughly 60 per cent of the increase in employment is explained by the change in population. The responses of labor migration are strongest for individuals aged 20-35. Based on historical data that go back to the 1950s, we find no evidence of a decline in the elasticity of migration to changes in employment.

title: Ready for the Next Financial Crisis? Strengthening Financial Governance Mechanisms
affiliations: Khon Kaen University, The Faculty of Business Administration and Accountancy

detail.title: Ready for the Next Financial Crisis? Strengthening Financial Governance Mechanisms

publicationDetails.journalName: Asian Development Bank Institute Publications

detail.abstract: In recent years, currency volatility among Southeast and East Asian economies has fueled concerns about the possible occurrence of another financial crisis in the Asia and Pacific region. The Asian financial crisis in 1997 and the global financial crisis of 2008 revealed some serious deficiencies in global financial governance systems, with the International Monetary Fund’s crisis resolution mechanisms, in particular, being widely criticized. In the context of this history, we study the development of national, regional, and global financial governance in the aftermath of the Asian and global financial crises. We examine how individual economies, as well as regional and global governance actors, have strengthened their financial systems, promoted financial cooperation, and both reformed key financial institutions and established alternative ones. Although the development of financial governance mechanisms at national, regional, and global levels has created these three lines of defense, policymakers in Asia and the Pacific need to prepare for the next financial crisis in an increasingly interconnected world economy. We propose some policy measures aimed at improving the vigilance and adaptability of financial governance mechanisms in the face of ongoing challenges and uncertainties.

AI.tldr: 本文研究亚洲金融危机和全球金融危机后国家、区域和全球金融治理的发展，分析各经济体如何加强金融体系、促进金融合作并改革金融机构，提出应对未来金融危机的政策建议。
AI.research_question: 亚洲金融危机和全球金融危机后，国家、区域和全球层面的金融治理机制是如何发展的？这些机制如何帮助应对未来的金融危机？
AI.motivation: 近年来东南亚和东亚经济体的货币波动引发了对亚太地区可能再次发生金融危机的担忧，1997年亚洲金融危机和2008年全球金融危机暴露了全球金融治理体系的严重缺陷。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融治理理论、危机管理理论、国际金融合作理论
AI.method: 历史分析法和制度分析法，研究金融危机后金融治理机制的发展演变
AI.findings: 国家、区域和全球层面的金融治理机制发展形成了三道防线，但政策制定者仍需为日益互联的世界经济中的下一次金融危机做好准备
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对多层次金融治理体系协同作用的理解，提出了金融治理机制的警惕性和适应性理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了提高金融治理机制警惕性和适应性的政策建议，为亚太地区政策制定者应对未来金融危机提供实践指导

title: Can't Buy Me Home: Beliefs, Facts, and Policy in the Housing Affordability Crisis
affiliations: Universidade de Lisboa, NOVA University Lisbon and University of Lisbon - ISEG School of Economics and Management

detail.title: Can't Buy Me Home: Beliefs, Facts, and Policy in the Housing Affordability Crisis

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: Our study investigates public opinion on the housing affordability crisis in Portugal through a nationally representative survey combined with an information provision experiment. Participants were asked to identify perceived causes of rising housing prices, assess their factual knowledge of the housing market and sociodemographic trends, and indicate their preferred policy solutions, carefully framed to reflect trade-offs. Half of the respondents were randomly assigned to receive official statistical information on these trends before indicating their policy preferences. The findings reveal significant heterogeneity in beliefs about the causes of the crisis, pervasive misperceptions regarding market trends, and a limited impact of information provision on policy preferences.These results underscore the challenges of addressing housing policy through informational interventions alone and highlight the need for strategies that integrate behavioral and contextual factors to foster informed public engagement.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过全国代表性调查和信息提供实验，探讨葡萄牙公众对住房负担能力危机的看法，发现公众对危机原因存在显著异质性认知，普遍存在对市场趋势的误解，信息提供对政策偏好的影响有限。
AI.research_question: 葡萄牙公众对住房负担能力危机的认知如何？信息提供能否改变公众的政策偏好？
AI.motivation: 住房负担能力危机是葡萄牙面临的重大社会问题，了解公众认知和政策偏好对于制定有效政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为经济学和信息干预理论，探讨信息提供对公众政策偏好的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用全国代表性调查结合随机对照实验设计，一半受访者接收官方统计信息后表达政策偏好。
AI.findings: 公众对住房危机原因存在显著异质性认知；普遍存在对市场趋势的误解；信息提供对政策偏好的影响有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了信息干预在复杂政策问题中的局限性，强调了行为因素和情境因素的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于公众认知的实证证据，建议采用整合行为和心理因素的策略来促进公众参与。

title: Early Release Via Parole and Recidivism
affiliations: University of Lausanne and University of Basel, Stanford University, Columbia University - Columbia Business School, Management and The Hebrew University of Jerusalem Law School

detail.title: Early Release Via Parole and Recidivism

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: Does early release decrease or increase the probability that ex-convicts will return to prison? We exploit unique data from Israeli courts, where appearance before the judge throughout the day has an arbitrary component. We first show that judges more often deny parole requests of prisoners appearing further from the judges' last break. We then use this arbitrary variation in early releases and find that early releases reduce the propensity of prisoners to return to prison. Robustness checks suggest that later and earlier cases are largely comparable and that potential selection is unlikely to explain the results.

AI.tldr: 通过利用以色列法官在一天中不同时间段的任意性判决变化，研究发现提前释放减少了狩盗再次入犯的概率
AI.research_question: 提前释放是会降低还是提高出狹人员再次入狹的概率？
AI.motivation: 理解提前释放政策对狩盗再犯率的影响，为相关政策提供实证基础
AI.theoretical_framework: 使用定量学习和实验经济学方法，利用法官判决中的任意性变量来识别因果关系
AI.method: 利用以色列法官在一天中不同时间段的判决偏好作为工具变量，进行回归分析
AI.findings: 提前释放显著降低了狩盗再次入狹的概率，法官在休息后更容易批准详释
AI.theory_contributions: 为相关理论提供了实证支撑，进一步丰富了对提前释放效果的理论理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于提前释放政策有益效果的实证依据，有助于改善相关政策

title: Macroeconomic Drivers of Family Separation and Theplacement of Children in Residential Care in Cambodia:Insights from Caregivers and Social Workers
affiliations: Durham University, Durham University and Durham University

detail.title: Macroeconomic Drivers of Family Separation and Theplacement of Children in Residential Care in Cambodia:Insights from Caregivers and Social Workers
detail.abstract: This paper examines how broader economic and labour market forces influence family separation and the placement of children in residential care in Cambodia, amid ongoing childcare deinstitutionalisation reforms. While global evidence highlights the harm caused by residential care and promotes family and community-based alternatives, Cambodia’s reform efforts remain largely reactive and institution-focused, paying limited attention to structural drivers of family separation.This study identifies key macroeconomic factors influencing child care practices in Cambodia by drawing on qualitative insights from those directly involved in family separation and child placement processes. Following a review of relevant literature and key policy documents, the research involved a total of fifty-five participants, including caregivers, National Non-Governmental Organisation (NGO) staff, and government social workers and managers with experience in residential care placements. Data were collected through semi-structured interviews and focus group discussions, and were then thematically analysed to identify recurring patterns and structural influences.Participants highlighted widespread labour precarity, high labour migration rates, a growing reliance on intergenerational kinship care arrangements and household overindebtedness as key contributors to family separation and subsequent residential care admissions. This context reflects Cambodia’s neoliberal political economy, characterised by inadequate social safety nets and weak regulation of labour and financial markets.Cambodia’s childcare reforms, aligned with global deinstitutionalisation policy models, primarily focus on institutional gatekeeping and reintegration efforts but insufficiently address the structural socioeconomic contexts that drive family separation. This paper argues for an expanded childcare deinstitutionalisation framework that includes labour policy and economic considerations alongside child protection. By incorporating structural determinants, such an approach can better prevent family separation and improve long-term outcomes for children and families. These findings contribute policy and programming insights for reforming child welfare systems in Cambodia and comparable contexts, highlighting the need to move beyond symptom-focused interventions toward addressing the underlying causes of family vulnerability.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨柬埔寨经济与劳动力市场因素如何影响家庭分离和儿童机构照料安置，指出当前去机构化改革过于关注机构层面而忽视结构性社会经济驱动因素，主张将劳动力政策和经济考量纳入儿童保护框架。
AI.research_question: 柬埔寨更广泛的经济和劳动力市场力量如何影响家庭分离和儿童机构照料安置？
AI.motivation: 柬埔寨的去机构化改革主要采取反应性和机构中心的方法，对导致家庭分离的结构性驱动因素关注有限，需要研究宏观经济因素对儿童照料实践的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新自由主义政治经济学框架，关注劳动力市场不稳定、社会安全网不足以及劳动和金融市场监管薄弱等结构性因素。
AI.method: 定性研究方法，包括文献和政策文件回顾，对55名参与者（照顾者、非政府组织工作人员、政府社会工作者和管理者）进行半结构化访谈和焦点小组讨论，然后进行主题分析。
AI.findings: 参与者强调普遍的劳动力不稳定、高劳动力迁移率、对代际亲属照料安排的日益依赖以及家庭过度负债是导致家庭分离和后续机构照料安置的关键因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个扩展的去机构化框架，将劳动力政策和经济考量纳入儿童保护，强调需要解决家庭脆弱性的根本原因而不仅仅是症状。
AI.practical_contributions: 为柬埔寨和类似背景的儿童福利系统改革提供了政策和项目见解，建议超越以症状为中心的干预措施，转向解决潜在的结构性社会经济问题。

title: Do Elite Universities Pick Sports to Pick Students? Athletic Admissions and SES Targeting
affiliations: University of Wisconsin - La Crosse and University of Oklahoma

detail.title: Do Elite Universities Pick Sports to Pick Students? Athletic Admissions and SES Targeting

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: This study investigates the extent to which U.S. universities strategically use athletic admissions to shape the socioeconomic status (SES) of their student bodies. Using a novel dataset linking NCAA roster data to neighborhood characteristics, we document substantial SES segregation across sports and universities. More selective institutions, particularly elite private universities, allocate up to 30% of enrollment to athletes who typically come from higher-SES backgrounds than their non-athlete peers. However, contrary to popular belief, we find that elite institutions enroll similarly wealthy athletes across all sports. Estimates of our structural model of sports bundle choice reveal that this SES homogeneity across sports limits universities' ability to systematically choose sports offerings to target higher-SES students. Counterfactual analyses demonstrate that athletic enrollment caps would create additional seats for non-athletes but require complementary policies to meaningfully impact socioeconomic mobility.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文研究美国大学如何通过体育生招生来形成学生群体的社会经济地位，发现精英大学体育生来自更高端的社会经济背景，但不同运动项目间经济地位差异不大，限制了大学通过运动项目选择来系统性提升学生社会经济地位的能力。
AI.research_question: 美国大学如何战略性地使用体育生招生来形成学生群体的社会经济地位？
AI.motivation: 体育生招生在美国高校占据重要位置（特别是精英私立大学可达30%），但其对学校社会经济组成的影响不明。需要了解大学是否通过选择体育项目来系统性影响学生的社会经济背景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 高等教育招生战略、社会经济分层理论、组织战略选择理论（通过体育项目组合选择来影响学生组成）
AI.method: 构建新的NCAA名单数据与社区特征数据的联合数据集，使用结构模型分析大学体育项目组合选择行为，并进行反事实分析估计政策效果
AI.findings: 1）精英大学体育生比非体育生更富有；2）不同运动项目间体育生社会经济背景相似，形成社会经济地位隔离；3）这种同质性限制了大学通过选择运动项目来系统性拿披学生社会经济组成的能力
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了高校通过体育招生影响社会经济组成的新视角，扩展了高等教育招生战略和社会分层理论，揭示了组织战略选择的限制条件
AI.practical_contributions: 指出单纯的体育生招生上限政策不足以实现社会经济流动性目标，需要配套政策支持，为高校招生政策改革提供实证基础

title: Quality, Safety, and Disparities of AI Chatbots in Managing Chronic Diseases: Experimental Evidence
affiliations: Xi'an Jiaotong University (XJTU), Xi'an Jiaotong University (XJTU), Yale School of Public Health - Department of Health Policy and Management, Washington University in St. Louis, University of New South Wales (UNSW), University of New South Wales (UNSW), University of New South Wales (UNSW), Xi'an Jiaotong University (XJTU), Xi'an Jiaotong University (XJTU), Duke Kunshan University, Luohe Medical College, Xi'an Jiaotong University (XJTU) and Zhengzhou University

detail.title: Quality, Safety, and Disparities of AI Chatbots in Managing Chronic Diseases: Experimental Evidence

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: The rapid development of AI solutions reveals opportunities to address the underdiagnosis and poor management of chronic conditions in developing settings. Using the method of simulated patients and experimental designs, we evaluate the quality, safety, and disparity of medical consultation with ERNIE Bot in China among 384 patient-AI trials. ERNIE Bot reached a diagnostic accuracy of 77.3%, correct drug prescriptions of 94.3%, but prescribed high rates of unnecessary medical tests (91.9%) and unnecessary medications (57.8%). Disparities were observed based on patient age and household economic status, with older and wealthier patients receiving more intensive care. Under standardized conditions, ERNIE Bot, ChatGPT, and DeepSeek demonstrated higher diagnostic accuracy but a greater tendency toward overprescription than human physicians. The results suggest the great potential of ERNIE Bot in empowering quality, accessibility, and affordability of healthcare provision in developing contexts but also highlight critical risks related to safety and amplification of sociodemographic disparities.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过模拟患者实验评估ERNIE Bot在中国医疗咨询中的表现，发现其诊断准确率77.3%、药物处方正确率94.3%，但存在过度检查(91.9%)和过度用药(57.8%)问题，且在年龄和经济状况上存在差异。
AI.research_question: ERNIE Bot在中国医疗咨询中的质量、安全性和公平性表现如何？
AI.motivation: AI技术的快速发展为解决发展中国家慢性病诊断不足和管理不善问题提供了机遇，需要评估AI医疗咨询的实际效果和潜在风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于医疗质量评估框架，包括诊断准确性、处方安全性、医疗资源利用效率和健康公平性等维度。
AI.method: 采用模拟患者方法和实验设计，进行了384次患者-AI交互试验，比较ERNIE Bot、ChatGPT、DeepSeek和人类医生的表现。
AI.findings: ERNIE Bot诊断准确率77.3%，正确药物处方率94.3%，但过度检查率91.9%，过度用药率57.8%；存在基于年龄和经济状况的差异；AI系统比人类医生诊断更准确但更容易过度处方。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了AI医疗咨询在发展中国家环境下的实证证据，揭示了AI在提高医疗可及性同时可能放大社会人口差异的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供AI医疗系统部署的风险评估依据，为AI系统优化提供具体改进方向（减少过度处方和检查），促进更公平的AI医疗服务发展。

title: Developing Standardized Financial Risk Metrics for Climate/Disaster Impacts in the Built Environment
affiliations: Tyche Investments - Climate Consulting Group and Indian Institute of Science (IISc) - Indian Institute of Science, Bangalore

detail.title: Developing Standardized Financial Risk Metrics for Climate/Disaster Impacts in the Built Environment
detail.abstract: The increasing frequency and severity of climate change and disaster events pose significant financial risks to the built environment, particularly in rapidly urbanizing regions like India. This study addresses the lack of standardized financial risk metrics by developing a Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis (MCDA) framework to assess climate and disaster risks for urban households, commercial buildings, and government institutions. The methodology integrates hazard exposure, structural vulnerability, adaptive capacity, and financial materiality into composite risk scores using secondary data. Results reveal distinct risk profiles: urban households face moderate-to-substantial risks due to seismic vulnerability and low insurance coverage; commercial buildings are most sensitive to climate-driven revenue losses; and government institutions are vulnerable to flooding and slow recovery times. The framework provides scalable, transparent metrics to guide climate-resilient investment, policy enforcement, and adaptation planning. Key recommendations include seismic retrofitting, insurance schemes, revenue diversification, and flood-proofing critical infrastructure. The study bridges technical hazard assessments and financial decisionmaking, offering a replicable approach for standardized risk evaluation in the built environment.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个多标准决策分析框架，为印度城市环境中的家庭、商业建筑和政府机构提供标准化的气候和灾害金融风险评估方法，填补了现有风险度量标准化的空白。
AI.research_question: 如何为快速城市化的印度建筑环境开发标准化的气候和灾害金融风险评估框架？
AI.motivation: 气候变化和灾害事件频发对建筑环境构成重大金融风险，但缺乏标准化的金融风险度量方法，特别是在印度等快速城市化地区。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多标准决策分析（MCDA）理论框架，整合灾害暴露度、结构脆弱性、适应能力和金融重要性四个维度。
AI.method: 使用二手数据，通过多标准决策分析框架将灾害暴露、结构脆弱性、适应能力和金融重要性整合为综合风险评分。
AI.findings: 城市家庭因地震脆弱性和低保险覆盖率面临中度至实质性风险；商业建筑对气候驱动的收入损失最敏感；政府机构易受洪水影响且恢复时间缓慢。
AI.theory_contributions: 弥合了技术性灾害评估与金融决策之间的鸿沟，为建筑环境提供了可复制的标准化风险评估方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供可扩展、透明的风险度量指标，指导气候韧性投资、政策执行和适应规划，具体建议包括抗震加固、保险计划、收入多元化和关键基础设施防洪。

title: Mansion Markets: Re-Evaluating the Treatment of Customs Unions in Antidumping Cases

detail.title: Mansion Markets: Re-Evaluating the Treatment of Customs Unions in Antidumping Cases
detail.abstract: Some customs unions look like glorified trade deals, while other customs unions look like nation-states in the making. Since 1979, U.S. trade law has treated both kinds of customs unions the same, but this state of affairs ignores the variety of ways in which some (though not all) modern customs unions are remarkably economically integrated. Presidents from both parties have treated the European Union as a singular entity in regulating foreign trade with their Section 232 authority, and more recently, the current presidential administration has issued ad valorem tariffs against the European Union as a bloc. But due to a statutory prohibition, similar treatment cannot be afforded to the EU, or other similarly sophisticated customs unions, when it comes to antidumping law. In this Article, I argue that in light of both increased economic integration by customs unions around the world and the treatment of some of those customs unions in other contexts, Congress should reconsider how U.S. antidumping law treats countries which are parties to sophisticated customs unions—that is, mansion markets. When a customs union has fully or nearly fully removed barriers to trade, making distinctions between the countries inside that union for trade law purposes would be like foreign countries making distinctions between different U.S. states. While not all customs unions are created equal, the purpose of some customs unions is to give products within those unions a mansion market, and American antidumping law should be clarified to recognize this distinction.

AI.tldr: 美国反倾销法应区分不同类型的关税同盟，对高度经济一体化的关税同盟（如欧盟）应视为单一实体而非分别对待，国会需要修改法律以反映现代关税同盟的经济现实。
AI.research_question: 美国反倾销法应如何调整以更好地处理高度经济一体化的关税同盟？
AI.motivation: 美国贸易法自1979年以来对所有关税同盟一视同仁，忽视了现代关税同盟（如欧盟）的高度经济一体化特征，导致法律与实践脱节。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关税同盟理论、经济一体化理论、贸易法理论，特别是关于"大厦市场"（mansion markets）的概念。
AI.method: 法律分析、政策论证、比较分析（欧盟案例）。
AI.findings: 高度一体化的关税同盟内部贸易壁垒已基本消除，应被视为单一实体；现行法律禁止这种处理方式，需要国会修改。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"大厦市场"概念，为分析不同类型关税同盟提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国国会修改反倾销法提供具体建议，使贸易政策更符合现代经济一体化现实。

title: CBDC Cross-Border Settlement Prototype: Programmable Compliance for Cross-Border CBDC Settlement Using ISO 20022 and FATF Travel Rule Automation
affiliations: UNIVERSITI TEKNOLOGI MALAYSIA

detail.title: CBDC Cross-Border Settlement Prototype: Programmable Compliance for Cross-Border CBDC Settlement Using ISO 20022 and FATF Travel Rule Automation
detail.abstract: The paper presents the CBDC-CrossBorder-Settlement-Prototype, a programmable compliance architecture for cross-border wholesale CBDC that integrates ISO 20022 structured messaging with on-chain enforcement of the FATF Travel Rule and AML/CFT controls. Unlike pilots that rely on off-chain compliance, our model executes jurisdiction-aware controls at transaction time while preserving privacy via zero-knowledge proof attestations. We formalise message-to-contract mappings, define machine-readable legal triggers, and evaluate performance on a permissioned Ethereum (Hyperledger Besu) testbed across three synthetic corridors. Results show near-baseline settlement latency, materially higher detection accuracy than off-chain checks, and large reductions in metadata exposure. We discuss legal accountability, due process, and regulator "observer node" governance, and propose policy steps toward corridor pilots.

AI.tldr: 提出了一个可编程的跨境批发CBDC合规架构原型，通过ISO 20022结构化消息与链上FATF旅行规则和AML/CFT控制的集成，实现隐私保护的实时合规执行

AI.method: 开发CBDC-CrossBorder-Settlement-Prototype原型，在许可以太坊（Hyperledger Besu）测试床上进行三个合成走廊的性能评估
AI.findings: 实现接近基准的结算延迟、显著高于链下检查的检测准确性、大幅减少元数据暴露

title: Discrimination in Retention Decisions and its Impact on Career Earnings. Evidence from the National Football League
affiliations: University of Sheffield, University College London and University of Toronto - Centre For Industrial Relations

detail.title: Discrimination in Retention Decisions and its Impact on Career Earnings. Evidence from the National Football League

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines the role that racial discrimination plays in the decision to retain or release an employee and demonstrates the implications for estimating pay gaps. Our empirical setting, professional American football players (NFL), allows us to separate the retention decision from the wage decision. For the first four years of a player’s career, wages are mechanically determined and players are under a restricted ‘rookie’ contract, during which they can be released without cost. Players who survive in the league beyond four years receive a large uptick in their remuneration upon signing their first ‘free-agency’ contract. Consequently, marginal decisions over employment retention during the rookie contract have substantial implications for earnings realised over a player’s career. We find subtle but significant differences in retention rates between Black and White players (approximately 3 percentage points) that can’t be explained by a comprehensive set of individual characteristics including their productivity. We also show that traditional wage gap estimates, which appear to show equal earnings between Black and White players conditional upon playing position and productivity, mask underlying disparities in career earnings that become apparent when adjusting for these unequal retention rates.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文通过美国职业美式足球运动员的实证研究，发现种族歧视在员工留任决策中起重要作用，导致黑人和白人球员的职业生涯收入存在隐藏差异。
AI.research_question: 种族歧视如何影响员工留任决策，以及这种影响如何造成薪酬差距估计的偏差？
AI.motivation: 传统薪酬差距研究可能涉及选择偏差，因为只考虑了在职员工的薪酬，而忽略了留任决策中的歧视问题。NFL运动员的新秀合同制度提供了分离留任决策和薪酬决策的理想实验环境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本理论、劳动力市场歧视理论、选择性留任模型
AI.method: 利用NFL运动员2007-2013年期间的数据，构建了进入联盟前四年的新秀球员样本。使用归并分析和生存分析法，控制了生产率、位置、体胸指标等多个变量来估计种族对留任率的影响。
AI.findings: 发现黑人球员在新秀合同期间的留任率比白人球员低约3个百分点，这种差异无法通过生产率等可观测量的变量解释。传统薪酬差距估计显示在控制位置和生产率后种族间薪酬平等，但调整留任率差异后发现职业生涯收入存在显著差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一种新的视角来理解劳动力市场中的种族平等问题，说明了选择性留任模型在涉及歧视问题时的重要性，并强调了在估计薪酬差距时考虑留任决策的必要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和政策制定者提供了识别和减少潜在种族歧视的实践建议，帮助更全面地评估职业平等状况，并为其他行业的类似研究提供了方法论指导。

title: Decoupling Economic Growth from Emissions: A LMDI Decomposition Analysis
affiliations: Independent, Government of India - Reserve Bank of India, Independent and Independent

detail.title: Decoupling Economic Growth from Emissions: A LMDI Decomposition Analysis
detail.abstract: This article analyses the factors driving India's CO2 emissions growth from 2012 to 2022 using LMDI decomposition. During this time, energy-related CO2 emissions increased by 706 million tons. The main contributor was economic growth (+1073 Mt), with a smaller impact from the change in fuel mix of the economy (+78 Mt). However, gains in energy efficiency (-399 Mt), structural changes (-15 Mt), and improvements in emission intensity of electricity due to increased use of renewables (-30 Mt) helped curb emissions. India's energy efficiency improved by 1.9 percent annually, exceeding the global average. Additionally, India's growth decoupled from emissions, with a decoupling elasticity of 0.59, comparable to other lower-middle income countries.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文使用LMDI分解法分析了2012-2022年印度CO2排放增长的驱动因素，发现经济增长是主要驱动因素，但能源效率提升和可再生能源使用有效减排。
AI.research_question: 什么因素驱动了2012-2022年间印度能源相关CO2排放的增长？
AI.motivation: 理解印度在经济增长过程中的碳排放驱动因素，以便制定有效的气候政策和可持续发展战略。
AI.theoretical_framework: LMDI（Logarithmic Mean Divisia Index）分解方法，用于分解碳排放变化的各种驱动因素。
AI.method: 采用LMDI分解方法，对2012-2022年间印度能源相关CO2排放数据进行定量分析，分解为经济增长、能源效率、结构变化、燃料组合和电力排放强度等因素。
AI.findings: 经济增长贡献了+1073百万吨排放增长，而能源效率提升减少了-399百万吨排放。印度能源效率每年提高1.9%，超过全球平均水平，并实现了经济增长与碳排放的触合（触合弹性为0.59）。
AI.theory_contributions: 实证验证了LMDI方法在发展中国家碳排放驱动因素分析中的适用性，为下中收入国家的绿色发展提供理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度政府制定碳中和政策提供了数据支撑，明确了能源效率提升和可再生能源发展在减排中的关键作用，为其他发展中国家提供了可参考的经验。

title: The Constitution and the War on DEI
affiliations: University of Chicago and University of Chicago - Law School

detail.title: The Constitution and the War on DEI

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Chicago Law School, Public Law & Legal Theory Research Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Chicago Law School, Public Law & Legal Theory Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This Article examines how the second Trump Administration's aggressive attacks on programs, policies, and speech loosely associated with diversity, equity, and inclusion [DEI] intersect with the constitutional guarantees of equal protection and freedom of speech. We argue first that there is little doctrinal support for the administration's pervasive efforts to justify its war on DEI by invoking the Equal Protection Clause and parallel statutory law. Instead, the administration is stretching existing colorblindness doctrine beyond recognition, into a radical vision that we label "anti-antisubordination." On this view, vindicating equality values does not only require restricting practices that treat individuals differently based on race or other identity characteristics. It precludes any conscious efforts to promote a more equitable and inclusive society, and even the expression of viewpoints that support such efforts-those that advance an antisubordination perspective or acknowledge the existence of identity-based social inequalities. Second, we show that, to avoid the conflict its viewpoint-discriminatory conception of equality law creates with the core First Amendment principle of viewpoint neutrality, the administration is in effect attempting to revive the longdead distinction between constitutional "rights" and "privileges" so that it can impose essentially any conditions it wants on federal funds and other benefits and thus dramatically limit the First Amendment's protections for private speakers and institutions. On both the equal protection and First Amendment fronts, we thus demonstrate that the administration's war on DEI entails a vision of constitutional equality that departs sharply from existing doctrine and that poses serious dangers to efforts to redress inequalities and to freedom of expression.

AI.tldr: 本文分析特朗普政府对DEI项目的攻击如何与宪法平等保护和言论自由保障相冲突，认为政府正在扭曲现有色盲原则并试图复活权利与特权区分来限制第一修正案保护。
AI.research_question: 特朗普政府攻击DEI项目的做法如何与宪法平等保护条款和第一修正案相冲突？
AI.motivation: 探讨特朗普政府反DEI政策对宪法原则的威胁，特别是对平等保护和言论自由的潜在危害。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宪法平等保护理论、第一修正案观点中立原则、反从属化理论框架
AI.method: 法律 doctrinal 分析，对政府政策与宪法原则进行对比研究
AI.findings: 政府缺乏 doctrinal 支持其反DEI立场，正在扭曲色盲原则为"反反从属化"观点，并试图复活权利与特权区分来规避第一修正案限制
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"反反从属化"概念框架，揭示政府政策与现有宪法学说的背离
AI.practical_contributions: 为法律界和公众提供对政府反DEI政策宪法风险的警示，保护平等权利和言论自由

title: Expecting Harm? The Impact of Rural Hospital Acquisitions on Maternal Health Care
affiliations: Northwestern University - Kellogg School of Management, Carnegie Mellon University and University of Georgia - C. Herman and Mary Virginia Terry College of Business - Department of Economics

detail.title: Expecting Harm? The Impact of Rural Hospital Acquisitions on Maternal Health Care

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
While numerous papers document the effects of mergers on cost and quality, the effects of hospital mergers on access to care are less certain. Merging hospitals may limit access by closing one of the affected hospitals or eliminating individual service lines. However, hospital systems may have more resources to improve care delivery. We study the impact of hospital mergers on obstetric care in rural markets, where there may be heightened concern about the availability of local care options. Using a differences-in-differences approach, we find that when rural hospitals are acquired, there are substantial increases in the probability of obstetric unit closures, with resulting large reductions in the number of births at the hospital. We find mixed effects on health outcomes: there are small increases in maternal morbidity, but no changes in newborn outcomes on average. However, there are improvements of newborns with Medicaid coverage. Additionally, we find decreases in maternal transfers and increases in procedures consistent with women delivering in more resourced hospitals.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了农村医院并购对产科护理的影响，发现并购导致产科单位关闭概率大幅增加，出生数量减少，对母婴健康结果产生混合影响，但改善了医疗补助覆盖新生儿的结果。
AI.research_question: 医院并购如何影响农村市场的产科护理可及性和健康结果？
AI.motivation: 尽管已有大量文献研究并购对成本和质量的影​​响，但医院并购对护理可及性的影响尚不明确，特别是在农村地区可能存在对当地护理选择可用性的高度担忧。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于医疗市场整合理论，探讨医院系统化可能带来的资源优化与服务缩减之间的权衡关系。
AI.method: 采用双重差分法（differences-in-differences approach）研究农村医院被收购后的变化。
AI.findings: 1) 农村医院被收购后产科单位关闭概率大幅增加，医院出生数量大幅减少；2) 对健康结果产生混合影响：孕产妇发病率小幅增加，新生儿结果平均无变化；3) 医疗补助覆盖的新生儿结果有所改善；4) 孕产妇转院减少，更多程序表明妇女在资源更丰富的医院分娩。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了医院并购理论，特别关注农村医疗市场和服务可及性维度，揭示了并购在不同患者群体中的差异化影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实证证据，帮助评估医院并购对农村产科服务的实际影响，特别是在医疗资源分配和弱势群体护理质量方面的启示。

title: The Risks of Environmental Valuation in Developing Countries: Between Monetary Interests and Capital Degradation
affiliations: Swedish School of Economics and Business Administration

detail.title: The Risks of Environmental Valuation in Developing Countries: Between Monetary Interests and Capital Degradation
detail.abstract: Policymakers increasingly aim to integrate nature’s value into economic decisions, encouraging organizations to recognize “natural capital” — a challenging goal, especially in developing countries. These nations face greater difficulty than developed ones in valuing environmental resources, raising the risk of irreversible environmental degradation. This study examines the risks and challenges of economic and financial valuation of environmental resources in developing countries, focusing on Iran. A systematic review of Iranian literature from 2000 to 2024 identified 324 articles, narrowed to those addressing valuation methods and empirical applications. Findings reveal that estimated values for natural resources often fall short of their true worth, with urban parks frequently assigned higher value than significant natural or historical sites. Factors such as inadequate valuation methods and limited public awareness of natural resources’ real value contribute to this disparity. Even high, sometimes exaggerated, estimates based on market valuations for natural resources rarely rival industrial revenues, such as those from petrochemicals. Even when similarly valued, natural resources often lose out to industrial alternatives due to delayed returns and intangible benefits, leading to the prioritization of resource-based industries over environmental protection. This study advocates moving beyond valuation-centrism toward a holistic approach integrating ecological, social, and ethical considerations essential for sustainable development.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨发展中国家环境资源经济价值评估的风险与挑战，以伊朗为例。研究发现估值方法不足和公众意识缺乏导致自然资源估值偏低，即使高估值也难以匹敌工业收益，建议采用超越估值中心主义的整体方法。
AI.research_question: 发展中国家环境资源经济价值评估面临哪些风险和挑战？
AI.motivation: 政策制定者希望将自然价值融入经济决策，但发展中国家在环境资源估值方面面临更大困难，存在不可逆转环境退化的风险

AI.method: 对2000-2024年伊朗文献进行系统综述，筛选出324篇文章，重点关注估值方法和实证应用
AI.findings: 自然资源估值往往低于真实价值；城市公园估值常高于重要自然或历史遗址；估值方法不足和公众意识缺乏导致差异；即使高估值也难以匹敌石化等工业收益；延迟回报和无形收益使自然资源在竞争中处于劣势
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统的经济估值中心主义，提出了整合生态、社会和伦理考量的整体性方法框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家环境政策制定提供实证依据，建议采用更全面的决策框架，避免过度依赖经济估值而导致环境退化

title: The Rule of 72 in Compounding: A Comprehensive Academic Analysis
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Rule of 72 in Compounding: A Comprehensive Academic Analysis
detail.abstract: The Rule of 72 is a widely adopted financial heuristic for estimating the time required to double an investment under compound interest at a given fixed rate. Though elementary in its calculation, the rule encapsulates both insightful mathematical reasoning and centuries of pragmatic usage across personal finance and professional domains. This paper offers an authoritative exploration of the Rule of 72, tracing its historical origins, laying bare its mathematical foundation, rigorously assessing its accuracy, evaluating its broad applications and limitations, and ultimately situating it as a powerful, if approximate, tool within the wider landscape of financial arithmetic. Special attention is paid to the subtle nuances underpinning the rule's effectiveness, its pedagogical value, and its ongoing relevance in a technologically advanced financial world. The discussion is substantiated with tables, illustrative charts, critical evaluation, and direct reference to established literature and contemporary expert commentary.

AI.tldr: 本文对72法则进行了权威性探讨，追溯其历史起源、揭示数学基础、严格评估准确性、分析应用与局限，将其定位为金融算术中强大但近似的工具。

detail.abstract: In broader terms, blockchain has presented a very promising technology to ensure transparency and security in financial systems, including fraud detection mechanisms. This paper explores blockchain technology and how it can be integrated into cloud-based fraud detection systems in financial services. By combining the decentralized, immutable, and transparent characteristics of blockchain, financial institutions can enhance the integrity of fraud detection systems. Foremost, the paper will address the potential benefits and hurdles that might arise for combining blockchain with cloud computing in addressing issues of security, transparency, and accountability in financial transactions. Additionally, it delves into blockchain implications for regulatory compliance and its future in secure financial transactions.

title: Money Talks: How the Digital Euro Redefines Payments and Information in the Modern Economy
affiliations: University of Glasgow, School of Law

detail.title: Money Talks: How the Digital Euro Redefines Payments and Information in the Modern Economy

publicationDetails.detailsText: European Business Law Review, volume 36, issue Issue 5, 2025[10.54648/eulr2025051]

detail.abstract:
In this paper we explore the intersection between payments and monetary symbolism in the context of the digital euro. We argue that the digital euro embeds normative values that align with the history and identity of the euro.

The analysis draws a parallel between ancient coinage, particularly Roman economic history and numismatics, and the role of information and symbolism in modern digital currency systems. Since information flows in many forms, Roman coins conveyed not just value but messages of imperial legitimacy and cultural unity. Similarly, euro banknotes communicate ideals of trust, inclusion, and economic pluralism. In this context, we will seek to identify the messages conveyed by the digital euro and compare them with the current means of payment to which the digital euro aims to be complementary, cash.

As for the current EU legislation, we will explore whether current and proposed legislation on payments are compatible with the messages conveyed by the future digital currency of the Eurosystem to understand whether they reinforce the character of the digital euro as a public good, grounded in the principles of fairness, openness, and resilience.

We situate this analysis within broader debates on the constitutionalism and semiotics of money, proposing that law plays an active role in shaping not only the functionality but also the meaning of a currency. In bringing forward a retail central bank digital currency, the ECB is not simply digitising money, but it is engaged in minting a new narrative of what it means to belong to a shared European monetary space.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨数字欧元作为支付工具与货币象征意义的交叉点，通过古罗马货币学与现代数字货币的对比分析，研究数字欧元如何承载欧元的历史身份认同价值，并评估欧盟支付立法是否支持其作为基于公平、开放、韧性原则的公共产品特性。

AI.theoretical_framework: 货币宪法主义、货币符号学、古罗马钱币学理论，强调货币不仅是经济工具更是文化符号和法律建构的产物。
AI.method: 比较分析方法：将古罗马硬币的信息传递功能（帝国合法性和文化统一性）与现代数字欧元进行平行对比；法律文本分析：评估欧盟支付立法与数字欧元象征价值的兼容性。
